Position description

As Senior Product Manager for code quality, you’ll decide how 7 million developers find problems in their code as AI writes more of it. The gap is large: 96% of developers don’t fully trust AI-generated code, yet only 48% always check it before committing (Sonar State of Code, 2026). With the engineers who build our analyzers, you’ll shape what SonarQube detects across Cloud, Server and IDE, and how teams verify code written by agents.
 

The team:

You will join the Code Quality product team, part of Sonar's Product Management group. Each Code Quality PM works with dedicated engineering squads and partners closely with UX, marketing and sales. We value collaboration, kindness and continuous improvement, and we base decisions on data and customer evidence.

What will you own: 

  • The strategy and roadmap to develop our language ecosystems, from market research and customer discovery to shipped rules and analyzers.

  • Decisions on which new languages Sonar should support, and where we should not compete.

  • New AI capabilities: how our analysis fits into the workflows of AI coding agents, and how quality gates apply to AI-generated code.

  • Day-to-day trade-offs with analyzer engineers, such as rule precision versus noise, and analysis speed.

  • Regular contact with developers and customers through calls, our community forum and conferences, and turning what you learn into roadmap decisions.


What you will do
You’ll enjoy this role if you care about well-crafted software and like owning a topic end to end.
 

  • Product vision and roadmap: research, clarify, and prioritize opportunities, and keep the roadmap effective

  • Customer interaction: engage with users on the product forum, support them, and turn their feedback into opportunities

  • Domain expertise: develop a deep understanding of code quality and how to help developers write more reliable, maintainable software

  • Cross-team work: collaborate with other PMs on cross-product features, and align with engineering and UX from problem definition through development


    • Experience and qualifications

    Must-haves

  • 5+ years in technical roles, ideally including hands-on software development.

  • 3+ years as a product manager on a technical or B2B software product, owning discovery, strategy and roadmap rather than only the backlog, preferably in an agile environment.

  • Hands-on use of AI coding assistants or agents in your own work, and an informed view of how they are changing software development.

  • Proven ability to lead a topic autonomously from start to finish, making pragmatic decisions amid change, complexity and uncertainty.

  • Fluent written and spoken English.

    • Nice to have

  • Solid understanding of code quality in at least one programming language or ecosystem.

  • Technical understanding of how code scanning and static analysis tools work.

  • Experience in developer tools, or contributions to open-source tooling such as linters, compilers or IDE plugins.

  • Experience speaking or writing for developer audiences.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Product Partnerships
jobs.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role

Perk works best when it connects seamlessly with the tools and platforms our customers

already rely on. From ERP and accounting systems to workplace software, mobility providers,

technology platforms, and emerging AI ecosystems, these third-party relationships can directly

shape the value customers get from Perk.

We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Product Partnerships to own and build those relationships.

Unlike our Growth Partnerships and Supplier Partnerships teams, this role isn’t responsible for

generating sales pipeline or supplier commission revenue. Its goal is to make Perk’s product

and customer experience stronger through the third parties we depend on and integrate with.

You’ll determine where strategic relationships can unlock the most customer value, build and

manage those partnerships, secure the access and agreements our teams need, and work

closely with Product and Engineering to turn them into successful customer-facing experiences.

This is a new role at Perk with significant opportunity to define how Product Partnerships should

work as we scale.

What You’ll Do

  • Build our product partnership strategy: Translate Perk’s product and company priorities into a clear roadmap of third-party relationships across areas such as ERP and accounting, business software, mobility, integration platforms, and AI.

  • Own strategic partner relationships: Serve as Perk’s primary relationship owner for the external platforms and technology companies that enable or enhance customer-facing product experiences.

  • Unlock Product and Engineering: Secure the developer access, API licences, programme memberships, certifications, marketplace approvals, and other partner support our teams need to build and maintain integrations.

  • Structure and negotiate partnerships: Lead commercial and strategic discussions around API access, data, licensing, marketplace participation, co-marketing, and other partnership terms, working closely with Legal, Security, Finance, Product, and Engineering.

  • Partner with Product on priorities: Bring the partner and market perspective into roadmap discussions while Product Managers own product requirements and delivery. Help determine which external relationships and integration models create the greatest customer value.

  • Own the partner lifecycle: Manage relationships from initial engagement through integration, certification, launch, ongoing roadmap alignment, escalations, programme changes, and renewals.

  • Drive adoption and customer value: Work with Product, Marketing, Customer Success, Sales, and Support to ensure partnerships aren’t simply launched—they are discoverable, useful, reliable, and adopted by customers.

  • Build the Product Partnerships playbook: Establish how Perk evaluates, prioritises, launches, measures, and manages product partnerships as this function grows.

What We’re Looking For

  • Proven experience in strategic partnerships, ecosystem partnerships, business development, or a product-adjacent role within SaaS, fintech, or B2B technology.

  • Experience building and managing complex relationships with technology or platform companies, ideally including developer, API, certification, or marketplace programmes.

  • Comfortable working with Product and Engineering and understanding technical concepts such as APIs, OAuth, data models, sandboxes, and integration dependencies without needing to be an engineer.

  • Ability to distinguish between an interesting partnership and one that will meaningfully improve Perk’s product or customer experience.

  • Strong relationship-building, negotiation, and communication skills across both external partners and senior internal stakeholders.

  • Able to move complex initiatives forward across Product, Engineering, Legal, Security, Finance, Marketing, Customer Success, Support, and Sales without relying on direct authority.

  • Comfortable defining the strategy, operating model, priorities, and processes for a new function rather than inheriting an established playbook.

  • Able to build the case for a partnership and measure its impact through adoption, customer experience, integration quality, and other relevant outcomes.

  • Based within commuting distance of our London or Barcelona hub.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with ERP, accounting, spend management, payments, travel, or fintech ecosystems.

  • Experience managing relationships with major business software, technology, mobility, or AI platforms.

  • Familiarity with unified API or integration-platform models.

  • Experience with European ERP and accounting ecosystems across markets such as DACH, Benelux, France, the Nordics, or the UK.

  • Additional European languages.

 

What We Offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

The Process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview - 30 mins - Virtual

  • Hiring Manager Interview - 30 mins - Virtual

  • Assessment Interview - 60 mins - IRL / Virtual

  • Values interview - 30 mins - Virtual

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager - Agent Builder
jobs.description:
Auditors sign their name to every conclusion. An agent can do the heavy lifting, but only if the auditor can see how each conclusion was reached and trace it back to its source.

Agent Builder is where firms turn their own procedures into agents their whole team can run, in Alwin by DataSnipper, our agentic automation platform for audit and finance. Built well, an agent makes quality a property of the procedure, not of who happened to be staffed on the engagement.

You'll own Agent Builder and the agents firms build with it. Your users are the people at firms who build agents, and the methodology and quality teams who approve them for client work.

This is a technical PM role. You'll shape the harness each agent runs in: the context it sees, the tools it uses, and where a person reviews its work. You'll own the feedback loops that improve agents after release. You'll work as a peer to the Agent Builder engineering team, and with our Agent Runtime and Evals teams here in Amsterdam.

About DataSnipper

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.

And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers. Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way.

The problems you'll own

  • A firm's procedure must become a harness an agent can follow, with the right context, tools and review points

  • Models are non-deterministic, but audit work must be defensible: traceable, attributed and reviewed

  • A firm will only rely on an agent it can test, approve and trace

  • Reviewer feedback must make agents better, with the firm's approval and without anything reaching another client

  • Methodology, models and standards all change. Agents in use must keep up without breaking work in progress

What you'll do

  • Own the Agent Builder strategy and roadmap, and make the trade-offs explicit

  • Design the harness with engineering: how context is assembled, how tools are defined and called, and where a person must review

  • Decide what builders control and what the platform sets, so agents can encode real methodology and stay consistent

  • Build the feedback loops: turn run traces and reviewer edits into eval cases, regression tests and changes the firm approves

  • Set the quality gates an agent must pass before release, and test every new model or methodology version before it reaches live work

  • Report agent quality with a stated method and sample

  • Prototype in code before you write specs. Then write short specs and decision memos that engineers can build from

  • Spend time with the firms that build and approve agents, and turn what our forward-deployed teams learn into product, not one-off fixes

What you bring

  • A technical background: software, ML or infrastructure engineering, or several years as a technical PM on developer or AI platforms

  • Hands-on experience shipping agent systems in production: context and retrieval, tool calling, orchestration, structured outputs, retries and fallbacks

  • Eval practice: building datasets, calibrating LLM judges against human labels, offline and online evaluation, and regression testing across model versions

  • Observability for LLM systems: traces, cost and latency, and classifying failures so you fix causes, not symptoms

  • System design skills: schemas, versioning, permissions, event logs and APIs. You can read a design doc and challenge it

  • PM experience on a product that other people build on

  • Prototyping in code with AI tools as part of your normal work

  • Clear, short writing

What sets you apart

  • Audit or accounting knowledge, from practice or from building products for auditors, finance teams or other experts in regulated fields

  • Document AI: extraction, OCR, grounding and citation

  • You've built an agent harness or framework, eval tooling, or LLM observability

  • You've built review workflows or feedback pipelines that turn user corrections into eval or training data

  • Experience with low-code tools, workflow designers, rule engines or DSLs

  • Design-partner programmes with large enterprise customers

What We Offer

  • Be part of one of the fastest-growing, profitable unicorn scale-ups in the Netherlands with a global impact.

  • Equity (Stock Appreciation Rights) to share in the company’s success and growth.

  • Pension plan with a 6% contribution on top of your base salary.

  • 28 vacation days per year (full-time) to support your work-life balance.

  • Hybrid work model with at least 3 days onsite in our dynamic Amsterdam office.

  • Daily, freshly prepared lunches by our in-house chef to keep you energised.

  • NS business card for easy commuting to the office.

  • A structured onboarding programme designed to set you up for success, including dedicated time to learn our product and customers before you hit the ground running.

  • Access to continuous learning and development initiatives to grow your skills.

  • Engage with a vibrant international team spread across seven global offices.

  • Company-wide events like DataSnipper GO, where global teams come together.

  • Access to OpenUp, a mental health and wellness platform supporting your wellbeing.

 

Recruitment steps

  • Recruiter screen

  • Hiring Manager interview

  • Assessment interview

  • Final conversations with the people you would work alongside

 

At DataSnipper, we believe great ideas come from different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and providing every candidate with a fair and equitable hiring experience.

Our hiring decisions are merit-based and grounded in the skills, experience, potential, and capabilities relevant to the role.

We welcome applicants regardless of age, race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes you, you.

What matters to us is what you can bring to the role, the team, and DataSnipper. 🚀

SANOVIO is the collaborative AI platform for healthcare procurement. Every euro a hospital loses in purchasing is missing in patient care. We help hospitals get good products at fair prices, with far less manual work.

We build the software. And we move the goods. SANOVIO aOS, our agentic operating system for procurement, handles master data management, portfolio management and digital procurement processing. SANOVIO Fulfillment covers global direct sourcing, quality control, warehousing and logistics.

Founded in 2024 in Munich by Noel Nosswitz, Alexander Hüttner and Yong Wang, we work with hospitals in Germany and Switzerland, purchasing groups and international suppliers. We are customer-funded: our customers are our only investors.

As Technical Product Manager, you turn real procurement problems into working software. You sit between our hospital and supplier users, our engineering team and the founders. You decide what we build next, shape how it works, and often build the first version yourself.

You work on SANOVIO aOS and the internal tools behind our fulfillment operations: AI agents that clean item master data, workflows that move an order from request to ward, and integrations with hospital and supplier systems.

A large part of the role is talking to customers. You join calls and on-site visits with hospital purchasing teams, purchasing groups and suppliers, show them what we build, take their feedback and turn it into product decisions. You are a trusted contact for our customers on everything technical.

Location: Munich (on-site, with flexibility).

jobs.title: Founding Product Manager - Claap
jobs.description:
we're hiring our first PM at Claap. You'll own the core product across three big topics in-app agentic experience, off-app agentic experience and enterprise readiness working directly with Robin, our co-founder and CEO.

About Claap

Claap is the AI-native Revenue Intelligence platform for sales and revenue teams.

What makes us different: we were the first platform in our category designed from day one to be used by both humans AND AI agents. We were also the first in our category to release an MCP, back in May 2025, over 18 months ago. Every customer conversation we capture is structured for two consumers: the rep who needs to act on it, and the agents (yours, ours, third-party) that need to feed on it to do their work.

This matters because the biggest shift we see across our customer base, from Series B startups to enterprise customers like Infopro Digital, Didomi, Dash0, and Pelico, is the move toward collaboration between humans, agents, and software. Our customers' executives are under real pressure to deploy AI across sales, business development, and customer-facing functions. Claap is often the conversation-data backbone that makes those agentic workflows possible.

Claap is now part of lempire (lemlist), giving us the ambition to build the agentic revenue platform (from prospection to closing) of the next decade.

We're a small team. Every hire matters and we are looking for our 1st PM.

As the first Product Manager at Claap, your mission is to drive the product's future developments and roadmap, working hand in hand with Robin, our co-founder and CEO, who has led product since day one.

You will work with Robin on three big topics:

- In-app agentic experience: In the past few months, we have extended our context infra. We now need to put this context at work to truly move the needle for our sales clients and help them close faster. Think next best action for the sales rep (prep meeting, build decks, contact people, follow ups & co), assisted pipeline reviews & forecasts or sales coaching.

- Off-app agentic experience: Claap is becoming headless, consumed more and more through MCP. We now need to level up our MCP integrations to make Claap fully sticky and efficient through MCP usage in 3rd party agents. Think MCP tools, plugins, embed skills or Claude artifact app.

- Enterprise readiness: our customers are moving upmarket, and enterprise accounts need governance, admin settings, permissions and configuration capabilities to roll Claap out at scale. Think SSO/SCIM, roles and permissions, data retention policies, and admin analytics.

The lemlist integration and our end-to-end sales agent roadmap will stay with Robin, which leaves you real ownership on the core Claap product (ie closing).

Your role is to understand the market and customer needs (especially in this AI era), identify the best possible product evolutions, prioritize them, work hand-in-hand with developers and designers to build an amazing product experience, and have a strong focus on go-to-market with Sales and Marketing to make sure the impact is reached.

Your scope can change over time; we are a truly agile company: we iterate a lot, even on how we organize and work together.

The PM at Claap wears different hats

- A detective/explorer hat to find unusual insights & opportunities, read between the lines of what sales teams really need, and be visionary when needed

- A chess player hat to think strategically, create good decision constraints, double down on the right things, and always have a coup d'avance

- An investor hat to make the right bets at the right time with the right amount of resources, because you sometimes need to play fast and risky, and sometimes need to play safe

- A diplomat hat to influence your teammates on what we should spend time and effort on, win their trust, and bring visibility, focus, vision and motivation

- A builder hat to get your hands dirty with AI, prototype, test and ship, instead of only writing specs about it

What you are not

jobs.title: Senior Implementation Project Manager
jobs.description:
We’re Making Travel Effortless. Join Us.

Travel is essential, whether it’s visiting family, starting a new adventure, or taking a career defining trip. Yet today, over 4 billion airline passengers rely on tech that hasn't changed in decades.

At Duffel, we’re rebuilding the infrastructure underpinning the global travel industry. Backed by top-tier investors (Benchmark, Blossom, Index Ventures, and Kima Ventures) and born out of Y Combinator (S18), we’re simplifying complex systems to build the future of travel.

Customer Success at Duffel

Customer Success owns Duffel's relationship with our customers once the contract is signed. We help them integrate, launch and grow on Duffel across Flights, Stays and more. The team brings together Customer Success Managers, Customer Success Engineers and Technical Support Engineers across London and New York, led by our VP, Customer Success. We're growing the team and building the processes that help customers go live faster and get more from Duffel.

The Role

We're hiring a Senior Project Implementation Manager to own every new customer's journey from signed contract to a live, transacting integration. This is a new, senior individual contributor role reporting to the VP, Customer Success, with a direct line of sight to the leadership team.

You'll run each onboarding as a project with a plan, a date and named owners, working with our Solutions Engineer so customers go live on time and with the right setup for their proposition. You'll also hold the view across every onboarding in flight, give the leadership team a clear, regular read on progress and risk, and work with internal teams to remove friction, automate manual steps and shorten the time it takes customers to go live.

Our customers include some of the largest fintech and software platforms in the world, building flights, stays and more on top of Duffel's API. Most of our transaction volume is in the US, so you'll work closely with US-based customer teams from London.

What You’ll be doing:

  • Own each onboarding end to end: take the handover from Sales at contract signature, run a structured kick-off, and lead the customer through to go-live and their first live bookings.

  • Build and run a project plan for every onboarding, covering commercial setup, API integration milestones, payments and finance setup, testing and launch, and be the customer's single point of contact for status.

  • Pull in the right people across Sales, Implementation, Customer Success, Engineering, Payments, Finance and Travel Operations, spot blockers early, and escalate when a date slips.

  • Keep one source of truth for every onboarding in flight, prioritise across them, and report weekly to the VP, Customer Success and monthly to the leadership team.

  • Build a repeatable onboarding playbook, track time-to-live, on-time go-live rate and time to first transaction, and feed recurring friction back to Product and Engineering.

What we're looking for:

  • 5+ years running customer onboarding, implementation or technical project delivery in B2B SaaS, fintech, payments or another API-first business, with a track record of getting several complex onboardings live on time at once.

  • Enough technical fluency to follow API-led integrations (REST APIs, webhooks, sandbox vs production, test plans) and hold your own with engineers. You don't need to write code.

  • Confidence with senior customer stakeholders, and calm, direct escalation: you raise a slipping date early, with a proposed fix and a named owner.

  • Experience building process where little exists, such as a playbook, tracker or reporting cadence, and getting other teams to adopt it, plus clear written status reports a leadership team can read in two minutes.

  • Willingness to work regular US-overlap hours. Experience in travel tech, onboarding enterprise platforms that embed a third-party API, or being the first person in a new function is a bonus.

What you'll be working on

  • In your first 30 days: getting to know every onboarding in flight, who's involved and where each one is stuck, with a single tracker in place and a first status report to leadership.

  • By 90 days: every new customer gets a kick-off, a project plan and a committed go-live date, a v1 onboarding playbook is in use, and baseline time-to-live is measured.

  • Designing the onboarding model by segment, from white-glove onboarding for large platforms to a lighter, scalable path for smaller accounts.

  • In your first year: time-to-live measurably shorter, most onboardings going live on the date agreed at kick-off, and a playbook solid enough to hand to the next hire into the team.

Why You’ll Love Working at Duffel

We believe in true ownership. That’s why every permanent employee gets equity in the business.

Perks That Actually Matter:

✈️ Travel Allowance: We literally pay you to get out of town and explore the world.

🏝️ Work From Anywhere: Flexibility is built in. Work remotely, or take advantage of our Sabbatical Policy.

Zable (formerly Lendable) is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.

  • The number one issuer of new credit cards and loans in the UK

  • Backed by Balderton Capital and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan

  • Loved by customers & our team with top reviews on Glassdoor and Trustpilot

Zable was founded on the belief that smarter technology is the solution to lower cost, more transparent consumer finance. Our proprietary foundation models analyse thousands of data points in seconds, drawing a more complete picture of individual financial behaviour. This means we can make better risk decisions, widening access and lowering prices.

The Zable credit card harnesses this technology to deliver better borrowing for three million people. Through our superapp, Zable connects this card to a single platform which makes it effortless to manage credit, get a loan, refinance existing borrowing, switch utilities, get a mobile plan and save more.

Zable is now the number one issuer of new credit cards and personal loans in the UK, but we’ve barely got started. Next, we’re taking our approach to some of the biggest markets in the world - the US and Mexico - where hundreds of millions of people are underserved by outdated bank processes.

Join us if you want to

  • Take ownership across a broad remit - you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Zable from day one

  • Work in small teams of exceptional people - who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo

  • Build the best technology in-house - using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

 

About the role

Lendable is becoming Zable. We’re rebranding the company and product, significantly increasing our D2C marketing investment, and building out a marketing function under our newly appointed CMO. It’s one of the most exciting marketing builds in UK fintech right now, backed by real financial strength, a large customer base and a product people love.

Partnerships and sponsorships will be central to how we grow, and we’re building the team to make that happen. As our Growth Partnerships Manager, you’ll shape the strategy and the budget, not just manage the day-to-day. Reporting to the Head of Growth Partnerships, you’ll define our commercial approach, decide where partnership spend goes, and take every deal from first conversation to live activation: agreeing terms, making sure campaigns land well, and keeping partners engaged. You’ll also make the case for each investment, with the data to back it, to senior leadership.

This is a senior seat for someone who enjoys both the creative and the analytical sides of partnerships. You’ll have real budget responsibility, model payback economics, and bring colleagues with you on the big calls. If you think about CPA, rev share and LTV:CAC as naturally as you think about relationships, you’ll feel at home here.

What we're looking for:

Essential:

  • 5+ years in partnerships, affiliate marketing, sponsorships, BD or growth roles for a consumer brand, including time spent shaping commercial strategy, not just executing it

  • Fluent in core acquisition performance metrics, CPA, Revenue share, LTV, ROI and blended CAC, and comfortable moving between them when structuring a deal

  • Working knowledge of channel economics: payback period, cohort behaviour, and how partnership spend compares against other acquisition channels

  • Direct experience running affiliate and/or influencer partnership end to end, including commercial negotiation (not just relationship management)

  • Track record of running activations end-to-end and delivering measurable results

  • Strong account / relationship management skills

  • Comfortable with the data, channel economics, attribution and ROI

  • Highly organised and detail-oriented, you can run multiple activations in parallel

  • Strong commercial communicator, you can hold your own with senior partners and senior internal stakeholders alike

  • Experience setting and owning a partnerships budget or channel P&L, with the judgement to reprioritise spend as performance data comes in

  • Comfortable presenting strategy and performance to senior leadership, and defending investment decisions with data

  • Demonstrable use of AI in your workflow

Desirable:

  • Experience in fintech or financial services

  • Experience with sport, entertainment, media or large brand sponsorships

  • Experience with an affiliate network or tracking platform (e.g. Impact, Awin, CJ, Partnerize) and reading platform-level reporting unassisted

  • Experience with affiliate, influencer or embedded finance partnerships

  • Some deal structuring experience

  • Experience line-managing or mentoring a more junior partnerships or affiliate executive

You’re a good fit if you’re:

  • A natural relationship-builder, partners trust you, and so does your team

  • A strategic thinker as much as a doer, you can zoom out to set the plan, then zoom back in to execute it yourself

  • Commercially literate first, relationship-led second, you measure success in growth, not vanity

  • A strong project manager, you keep things moving and on-budget

  • Data-fluent , you build your own view on what’s working from raw performance data, not just a dashboard summary

  • Hands-on and resourceful, you make things happen

  • Curious about AI and how it changes the partnerships discipline

What you'll be doing

Leadership & Strategy:

  • Set the partnerships strategy and roadmap, and own the case for investment with senior leadership

  • Mentor and support a more junior partnerships or affiliate executive

  • Represent the partnerships function in senior leadership and budget reviews

Commercial & Performance:

  • Negotiate commercial terms with affiliates, influencers and sponsorship partners – CPA, Revenue share, hybrid and flat-fee structures – and know which model fit the partner

  • Own the partnerships budget and unit economics of every live partnership: track CAC by channel and partner against LTV, and flag anything trending the wrong way before it becomes a budget problem

  • Build and maintain the channel-economics view that lets the team compare partnership spend against other acquisition channels

  • Manage affiliate network/platform relationships (tracking, reconciliation, payout accuracy) and be the first port of call when number don’t match

Activation:

  • Run sponsorship and partnership activations end-to-end, brief, plan, ship, measure

  • Manage the day-to-day with partners: planning, comms, escalations

  • Coordinate across creative, growth, lifecycle and legal

Partner Management:

  • Own the partner relationship, be the trusted operator they call first

  • Manage budgets and timelines across activations

  • Spot opportunities to expand existing partnerships based on their performance data

Performance & Optimisation:

  • Track partnership performance against targets, CPA, CAC, LTV, ROI, Rev Share payout

  • Build the playbooks and tooling that scale the function, including standard commercial terms by partner type

  • Use AI to scale research, brief-writing and reporting

Cross-functional:

  • Partner with finance and legal on contracts and accruals and commission reconciliation

Life at Zable

jobs.description:

Vision :

As a leading software-as-a-service (SaaS) provider, DiliTrust is a global company dedicated to offering an integrated suite of legal and governance products. Our vision is to digitize legal departments worldwide. With an annual growth rate of over 40% since 2020, our ambition is to become the world's leading Legal Tech company, aiming for a valuation exceeding $1 billion by 2026.

Our Impact :

From generating General Meeting reports to leveraging AI-assisted contract lifecycle management, our teams in our 8 offices across France, the US, Mexico, MEA, Germany, Spain, Italy, and Canada are the driving force behind our global success. We proudly support 2,400 customers in 64 countries, with 80% of our clientele comprising listed companies in major markets such as Europe, North America, and the Middle East.

Our Recognition :

DiliTrust has been at the forefront of Legal Tech innovation, being the first Legal Tech with AI features since 2022. The company is renowned for providing a positive and entrepreneurial work environment. We are honored to have received the "Happy at Work" and "Tech at Work" labels every year since 2019.

The role

Lini is DiliTrust's AI agent, powering Ask Lini, Risk Detector, Document Summarization, Minute Generation, and every AI capability across the suite. We are building a dedicated squad around it and are looking for the engineer who will lead it.

As Engineering Manager for the Lini AI Platform, you will report directly to the Head of Engineering and lead a squad yet to be hired, fully focused on Lini initiatives. You will own both the technical quality and the human dimension of the team, from architecture decisions to individual growth plans.

A key part of the role is coordination: you sit at the intersection of ML, product, and feature engineering, and you are accountable for making those conversations productive.

We are looking for a senior engineer who grew into leadership and kept writing code (~30% of your time), while driving delivery, standards, and culture.

We also care about how you think about AI: whether you approach it as a design question as much as an engineering one, and whether you bring genuine curiosity and opinions into product conversations.

Missions :

  • Work in close collaboration with the ML team, Product Managers, and feature squads to define and ship Lini features
  • Translate model capabilities into product requirements, negotiate scope across teams, and clear cross-team dependencies before they become blockers
  • Lead code reviews, own the squad's engineering standards, and weigh in on architecture choices
  • Own delivery end-to-end: from scoping and planning to deployment and iteration, across all Lini-powered features in the DiliTrust Suite
  • Define and evolve the integration architecture of Lini across modules, including LLM connectors and context management
  • Partner with the Head of Engineering on cross-squad initiatives, technical roadmap, and hiring
  • Run regular 1:1s, provide structured feedback, and support each engineer's career development
  • Set and maintain engineering best practices: testing, documentation, CI/CD, observability

Requirements

Experience & seniority :
  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a significant portion spent building and operating B2B SaaS platforms in production
  • 3+ years managing an engineering team or squad in a product-oriented environment
  • Proven track record of owning technical decisions: architecture, scalability, code quality (not just managing the people making them)
  • Background at the intersection of AI or ML and product engineering: you know what it takes to go from a model capability to a production user experience
  • Proven ability to coordinate across multiple teams simultaneously (ML, product, engineering)
  • Fluent in French and English
Technical expertise :
  • Strong proficiency in Node.js / TypeScript and Vue.js 3
  • Deep background in scalable web architectures and API design
  • Solid experience with LLM integration patterns in production (RAG, streaming, tool use, context management)
  • Comfortable with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices in production
Leadership & collaboration :
  • Strong sense of ownership
  • Ability to build trust, create accountability, and grow engineers into senior roles
  • Excellent communication skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • You see AI as a design question as much as an integration challenge, and bring that thinking into product conversations
  • You engage with the product, bring ideas to the table, and consider yourself a stakeholder in the solutions your squad ships

Frontend: Vue.js 3

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Optics11 is a fast-growing high-tech company based in Amsterdam, developing advanced fiber optic sensing solutions for the most demanding environments. Our technology detects the earliest signs of failure in critical assets – from high-voltage energy infrastructure to subsea and defense applications – and gives our customers precise, real-time data they can act on.

As Senior Product Marketing Manager you will build a deep understanding of the end-to-end solutions (hardware and software) across all of Underwater Security (our OptiBarrier and OptiArray product lines and our software platform), and of the markets and customers they serve. You turn that understanding into clear positioning, compelling value propositions and go-to-market plans that help our sales teams win.

Optics11 is in its scale-up phase, and product marketing in Underwater Security is starting from a basic level. You will build the product marketing function from the ground up: you set up the frameworks, processes and tools it needs, while delivering tangible commercial results along the way. You start as an individual contributor, with the opportunity to grow a small product marketing team over time.

You will be part of the Product team in Underwater Security and work closely with our solutions Product Managers for hardware and software, Sales, Business Development, Marketing, Application Engineering, Customer Projects and R&D teams.

No two weeks will look the same. You might analyze a competitor’s new seabed monitoring system, sharpen the value proposition for an anti-submarine warfare (ASW) tender, work on the launch of a new software release, train the sales team on a new product narrative, or help prepare a customer demo for a tradeshow such as UDT or Euronaval. You will own how our products are positioned, launched and sold in the market, support pricing decisions, and make sure your market insights support Optics11 product decision making.

Within your first 6–12 months, you will have evolved the foundations of product marketing in Underwater Security: clearly defined target segments and buyer personas, a positioning and messaging framework per product line, a competitive intelligence baseline, a repeatable launch process and a first sales enablement toolkit. Your work will sharpen our market focus, improve our win rate and help Optics11 scale its solutions commercially in demanding, high-stakes markets. 

Responsibilities:

  • Build the product marketing function by setting up the frameworks, processes, templates and tools for positioning, launches, competitive intelligence, sales enablement and product marketing analytics, tracking pipeline contribution and win rates, and scaling them as the organization grows.

  • Define target markets and commercialization plans by analyzing market size, trends, buying contexts and customer needs across mission profiles such as anti-submarine warfare (ASW), intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance (ISR) and critical underwater infrastructure (CUI) protection, prioritizing segments and use cases with Product Management and Business Development, and defining go-to-market approaches, channels and partnerships per segment (e.g. with prime contractors and system integrators).

  • Lead competitive intelligence and market monitoring by tracking competitors, technologies, programs and tenders, running win/loss analyses, and sharing actionable insights with Product Management to shape strategy, roadmap and business cases.

  • Own product positioning, messaging and value propositions by developing clear, differentiated propositions per product line and segment, and translating technical capabilities into operational and commercial value for defense partners and clients.

  • Support Product Management on pricing and packaging by providing market, competitor and customer insights for pricing decisions on products and end-to-end solutions, and aligning price positioning with Sales.

  • Plan and execute product launches by introducing a launch process scaled to the size of each release, coordinating launch readiness across Product, Sales and Support, and providing product messaging, content and launch input to the Marketing team.

  • Enable sales and ensure commercial readiness by creating sales narratives, pitch decks, battlecards, objection handling and training, preparing customer demos, collateral and tender input with Tech Sales & Bid Management and Application Engineering, and supporting Sales, Business Development and Marketing in key opportunities, tenders and trade shows.


Requirements:

  • Master’s degree in marketing, business or engineering.

  • 5+ years of experience in product marketing for technical B2B or B2G solutions, preferably combining hardware and software (platform) products in defense or another industrial high-tech / high-compliance environment with long, complex sales cycles such as tenders and partner-led sales.

  • Proven experience building product marketing from the ground up in a scale-up: hands-on, pragmatic and entrepreneurial, setting up processes, frameworks and tools with limited resources while delivering results.

  • Demonstrable experience in defining value propositions, positioning and go-to-market plans, and executing them through launches and sales enablement.

  • Ability to quickly understand complex technology and translate it into clear, credible customer value.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management skills at operational and management level.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, capable of presenting to technical, commercial and executive audiences.

  • Proficiency in CRM and marketing automation tools such as HubSpot, and in analytics for funnel and performance reporting.

  • Willingness to travel, including to customers and international trade shows; driver’s license B (or international equivalent).

  • Ability to pass a background / security screening by the Dutch AIVD/MIVD, as you will be working with clients in the defense industry.

Nice to Have :

  • Experience in ASW, ISR or CUI-related defense technology markets, or with underwater acoustics, is a big plus.

  • Experience with defense procurement, tenders and export-controlled products.

  • Understanding of pricing and packaging for hardware, software and recurring-revenue (license or subscription) models.

  • Experience working with prime contractors and system integrators.

  • Proficiency in tools such as Jira Product Discovery, Confluence, Miro, PowerBI.

  • Proficiency in Dutch language is a plus

Screening

You will work with clients in the defense and security sectors. Obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD, the Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service, is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. We will explain the process and guide you through the applicable requirements.

We are looking for a Senior Engineering Team Lead to take ownership of our Reporting platform and lead the team responsible for its evolution. This is a player-coach role for a staff-level data engineer who combines deep technical expertise with strong engineering leadership and people management skills.

You will help design, deploy, and evolve the data infrastructure that powers Adikteev’s reporting and analytics systems. You will be both the technical architect of the platform and the manager of the team that enables reliable, scalable, and high-value reporting for our internal and external users.

As the team lead, you won't just "execute" tasks. You will shape our technical DNA and support the growth of the team.

  • Define and drive the technical vision, architecture, and roadmap for our Reporting platform and data infrastructure.

  • Build and optimize highly scalable pipelines using Apache Airflow and Apache Spark, focusing on high reliability, performance, and cost efficiency.

  • Establish best practices for data quality, CI/CD for data, observability, technical documentation, and operational excellence.

  • Contribute to innovation efforts by exploring promising ideas from recent academic and industry work and turning them into production-grade solutions.

  • Leverage AI coding tools such as Copilot and Claude to accelerate development cycles and stay at the forefront of engineering productivity.

  • Remain hands-on where it creates the most leverage, contributing to system design, code reviews, critical implementation work, and incident resolution.

Management:

  • Lead, support, and develop the Reporting engineering team, creating the conditions for engineers to do their best work.

  • Set clear objectives, priorities, and expectations for the team, aligned with company and product goals.

  • Manage the team’s roadmap and delivery, balancing business priorities, platform reliability, technical debt, and long-term investments.

  • Provide regular feedback, coaching, and career development support to team members.

  • Mentor Data and Backend Engineers and help them grow their technical scope, ownership, and leadership skills.

  • Participate in recruitment, onboarding, performance reviews, and team planning.

  • Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous improvement, and high engineering standards.

  • Identify infrastructure bottlenecks and technical risks before they impact the business, and communicate architectural decisions clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

WHO YOU ARE

You might be a great fit for our Reporting team if you have experience in several of the following areas:

  • Experience: Proven track record as a Staff Data Engineer, Lead Data Engineer, Principal Data Engineer, or Engineering Manager with a strong data engineering background. You have worked on production systems where latency, throughput, availability, reliability, and infrastructure cost matter.

  • Data Volume: Experience working with very large-scale data systems. At Adikteev, our platforms process more than 5 billion events per day and reach over 5 million QPS on some services. You are comfortable designing systems that can handle high data volumes, demanding throughput, and strict reliability requirements.

  • Technical Stack: Hands-on expertise with Apache Spark, including tuning and scaling, as well as Apache Airflow and complex DAG orchestration. Kafka streaming, Kubernetes, and AWS are a plus.

  • Coding Skills: You are an "AI-native" developer who embraces AI tools to write better and faster code. Hands-on experience with Scala. Python and Java are a plus.

  • Data Modeling: Strong experience designing data models for reporting, analytics, and business intelligence use cases. Experience with dimensional modeling, data warehouses, or data lakes is a plus.

  • Data Transformation: Solid understanding of how to transform raw data into accurate, consistent, and easy-to-use reporting datasets. Experience building or maintaining reporting or analytics platforms is a strong plus.

  • Engineering Leadership: Experience defining technical direction, setting engineering standards, driving execution across teams, and making architectural decisions at staff level.

  • People Management: Experience managing, mentoring, and developing engineers, providing regular feedback, supporting career growth, and building a high-performing team.

  • Communication: Fluent in English and able to articulate complex architectural choices to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You are comfortable creating alignment across teams and communicating clearly at every level.

Please note that, to comply with employment regulations, applicants are required to maintain residency and be legally authorized to work in the European Union in order to be considered for this position.

jobs.title: Frontend Software Engineer
Analysis Experience Product Manager
jobs.description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. 


Position description

You will own the product vision and domain strategy for analysis experience, partnering with engineering and product leaders to align investment and delivery across teams.

Your mission is to evolve existing report processing, storage, and APIs into a shared service, so teams can submit work, process findings, and retrieve reusable artifacts and evidence without rebuilding these capabilities independently. Shape the service around static and agentic workflows, with support for additional analysis types guided by validated customer needs.

The domain covers issue-processing pipelines, durable storage, and supporting APIs and events. You will agree the scope and ownership of shared execution orchestration and other expanded capabilities with engine, infrastructure, and consuming-product teams. Engine teams retain detection logic; consuming teams retain their product workflows and acceptance criteria; workflow and Quality Gate owners retain publication, policy, and merge decisions.

Your direct customers are the technical teams building analysis engines, agent services, guidance capabilities, and other products on this service. Success is the value these teams deliver to developers and enterprises, not the number of shared capabilities shipped.


What you will do
  • Set domain strategy and investment priorities. Shape a multi-year plan across customer value, dependencies, technical debt, adoption, and cost. Align senior leaders on trade-offs and recommend where to increase, redirect, or stop investment as evidence changes.
  • Lead discovery with analysis-engine, agent-service, and consuming-product teams, and customers integrating through APIs. Use customer evidence and market and ecosystem signals to identify shared needs and opportunities for differentiation.
  • Coordinate validation across ambiguous, interdependent initiatives. Prioritize the most consequential unknowns and use prototypes, pilots, and clear outcome measures to make timely continue, pivot, or stop decisions.
  • Shape shared execution capabilities with engine and infrastructure teams, including input contracts, scheduling, dependencies, progress tracking, cancellation, retries, and resource budgets. Support different execution environments rather than require every engine to run in one place.
  • Lead product discovery for issue-processing pipelines, including ingestion, normalization, correlation, deduplication, and tracking findings across code changes. Agree contracts for issue identity and state changes with engine and workflow owners, keeping processing separate from publication and policy decisions.
  • Define how source context, findings, execution traces, proposed fixes, and verification results are stored, connected, discovered, and reused. Make freshness, provenance, coverage, and verification limits explicit so missing or incomplete checks are never treated as passes.
  • Guide investments in shared APIs, events, extensibility, documentation, and integration paths. Reduce engine and consumer onboarding effort and enable independent delivery through stable, versioned contracts.
  • Partner with engineering, infrastructure, and security on reliability, scalability, tenant isolation, access control, retention, and observability. Balance latency, coverage, compute and inference cost, and operational complexity.
  • Sequence migrations and deprecations with engineering leaders while preserving existing workflows. Prove value through complete customer workflows before generalizing, and resolve cross-team dependencies without compromising reliability or compatibility.
  • Shape launch, onboarding, and enablement for significant domain releases. Align consuming teams and customer-facing partners on documentation, operational support, and relevant pricing or packaging implications. Follow releases through to adoption and remove systemic barriers to value.
  • Guide quality and launch criteria for shared agentic processing capabilities with engineering, AI specialists, and security. Align leaders on evaluation evidence, fallback behavior, human controls, and cost and latency limits, while consuming teams retain their product-specific acceptance criteria. Lead product decisions from incident learning and establish responsible AI-enabled working practices across the domain.
  • Build domain-wide measurement and experimentation practices. Track integration effort, time to useful results, evidence reuse, reliability, and cost per workflow, connecting these measures to customer and business outcomes.

    • Experience and qualifications
  • A sustained track record of shaping strategy and delivering measurable outcomes across multiple related technical product areas, particularly developer platforms, APIs, distributed services, workflow orchestration, or data-processing systems. You have translated long-term direction into investment choices, led major transitions, and grown adoption of shared capabilities across teams.
  • Strong technical foundations, ideally developed through software engineering or a similarly hands-on role. You can read code, explore APIs, interpret traces, and build small prototypes to test assumptions.
  • Fluency in asynchronous and event-driven systems, queues, durable execution, data models, API versioning, and failure handling. You can discuss architectural trade-offs credibly without taking design ownership away from engineering.
  • An understanding of software development workflows, including repositories, branches and commits, builds, CI/CD, testing, and how analysis findings are investigated and resolved.
  • Practical understanding of AI-agent workflows and their operational implications, including tool execution, nondeterministic outcomes, context reuse, verification, and cost controls. You can guide shared quality standards and acceptable-risk decisions with specialists, learn from production failures, and establish responsible AI-enabled product practices without outsourcing judgment.
  • Strong strategic product judgment backed by discovery, market insight, and validation experience. You identify opportunities across related product areas, distinguish reusable customer needs from one-off requests, and challenge unnecessary abstraction. You balance near-term commitments with long-term differentiation and use outcome evidence and opportunity cost to guide investment.
  • Demonstrated ability to align senior leaders on domain strategy and contested investment choices, anticipate systemic risks, and resolve ownership ambiguities across teams. You raise product craft across the domain through mentoring PMs, improving decision and review practices, and removing systemic collaboration barriers.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to turn interconnected technical and customer problems into a coherent strategic narrative. You move credibly between detailed engineering discussions and senior-leadership decisions, making uncertainty and trade-offs explicit.
    •  
    Nice to have:
  • Static or dynamic analysis, application security, software composition analysis, or developer tooling.
  • Issue identity and lifecycle management across branches, repeated scans, and different analysis engines.
  • Multi-tenant processing services, sandboxed execution, or workloads with variable compute and inference costs.
  • Evolving established systems into shared services while maintaining compatibility and reliability

    • In-office culture

    We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having. 

    Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted  — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.

     

    We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

    At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

    If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date. 

    Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

jobs.description:
La mission en bref

  • Contrat — Mission freelance.

  • Démarrage prévisionnel — Mi-décembre 2026.

  • Durée initiale — 5,5 mois à temps plein.

  • Tranche optionnelle — 7 mois, à compter de juin 2027 à titre prévisionnel, sous réserve d’activation.

  • Lieu — Saint-Denis, avec possibilité de télétravail. Rythme de présence sur site à confirmer.

Contexte de la mission

ImaginePartners recherche un Product Owner Open Source pour accompagner un acteur du secteur ferroviaire dans l’ouverture d’un logiciel de signalisation. Vous piloterez la préparation de l’ouverture et construirez une feuille de route commune aux versions interne et open source. Si la tranche optionnelle est activée, vous assurerez le suivi produit des contributions externes et des publications.

Vos missions

Préparer l’ouverture du logiciel

  • Définir la vision produit, les usages cibles et les jalons d’ouverture. Construire une feuille de route qui articule les évolutions des versions interne et open source.

  • Structurer et prioriser le backlog GitLab. Rédiger les besoins, les user stories et les critères d’acceptation, puis participer aux cycles agiles.

  • Définir avec les équipes techniques le périmètre du code et de la documentation à publier. Coordonner les validations juridiques, de confidentialité et de sécurité.

  • Proposer la gouvernance et le circuit de contribution, puis préparer le dossier de candidature auprès d’OpenRail.

  • Coordonner les équipes métier, les équipes techniques et les partenaires. Suivre l’avancement, les risques et les décisions à soumettre au comité de pilotage.

Suivre les contributions et les publications si l’option est activée

  • Qualifier les contributions externes, échanger avec les contributeurs et coordonner les revues avec les mainteneurs.

  • Préparer les versions publiques et leurs notes de version, tenir à jour la feuille de route publique et animer les échanges avec la communauté.

  • Suivre les écarts entre les deux versions du logiciel et coordonner l’analyse de leurs impacts sur les exigences, les essais et la qualification.

Livrables attendus

  • Note de cadrage et plan de montée en compétence.

  • Cartographie des composants et documents à publier, à conserver en interne ou à exclure, et registre des validations.

  • Feuille de route consolidée, plan d’ouverture et backlog GitLab priorisé.

  • Gouvernance des contributions, matrice des responsabilités, dossier OpenRail et guide de contribution.

  • Dossier de préparation à l’ouverture, supports de pilotage et dossier de passation.

  • Si l’option est activée, registre des contributions, notes de version et bilan communautaire.

Profil recherché

Compétences attendues

  • Expérience de Product Owner sur un produit logiciel, avec pratique du cadrage, de la priorisation et du pilotage d’une feuille de route.

  • Expérience concrète de mise en open source d’un logiciel ou de gouvernance d’un projet open source avec des mainteneurs et des contributeurs externes.

  • Pratique de GitLab ou d’un outil équivalent pour suivre les demandes et les contributions.

  • Capacité à coordonner des interlocuteurs métier, techniques, juridiques et sécurité, et à préparer des arbitrages documentés.

Atouts

  • Expérience du ferroviaire ou d’un environnement soumis à des exigences de qualification logicielle.

  • Expérience de coordination des publications et d’animation d’une communauté open source.

Candidature

  • Votre TJM HT.

  • Votre statut (société, indépendant ou portage salarial).

  • Votre localisation.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Marketplace
Associate Product Manager (US Cards)
jobs.description:
About Zable

Zable (formerly Lendable) is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.

  • Founded in 2014, profitable since 2017, unicorn since 2021

  • The number one issuer of new credit cards and loans in the UK

  • Backed by Balderton Capital and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan

  • Loved by customers & our team with top reviews on Glassdoor and Trustpilot

Zable was founded on the belief that smarter technology is the solution to lower cost, more transparent consumer finance. Our proprietary foundation models analyse thousands of data points in seconds, drawing a more complete picture of individual financial behaviour. This means we can make better risk decisions, widening access and lowering prices.

The Zable credit card harnesses this technology to deliver better borrowing for three million people. Through our superapp, Zable connects this card to a single platform which makes it effortless to manage credit, get a loan, refinance existing borrowing, switch utilities, get a mobile plan and save more.

Zable is now the number one issuer of new credit cards and personal loans in the UK, but we’ve barely got started. Next, we’re taking our approach to some of the biggest markets in the world - the US and Mexico - where hundreds of millions of people are underserved by outdated bank processes.

Join us if you want to

  • Take ownership across a broad remit - you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Zable from day one

  • Work in small teams of exceptional people - who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo

  • Build the best technology in-house - using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

 

In six years, Zable has built a profitable, market-leading credit card in the UK. In 2023, we brought that playbook to the US and set an even higher bar. This year the US credit card business scaled rapidly: our run rate grew more than 20x in the last six months.

A lot of the work of getting customers through the door is in place. The next stage is about what happens once they’re in: helping them pay on time, giving more credit to the ones who earn it, getting people back on track when they fall behind, and ensuring an intuitive user experience across channels.

If you're excited by fintech, lending and scaling products in a fast-moving environment, this role offers real ownership, impact and room to grow.

About the role

We're hiring a Associate Product Manager to join the product team, and will cover post booking areas including payments, collections, credit limit increases, spend, and the mobile app.

No two weeks look the same. One week you might be sizing an opportunity, the next week sitting with the ops team to understand why customers are calling, or putting a rough version of an idea in front of real customers before anyone builds the proper one. We care more about how quickly we learn than how polished the first attempt looks.

What you'll work on

  • Running experiments across the customer lifecycle, such as how and when we remind people to pay, what gets them to set up autopay, and how we gamify engagement

  • Working with credit risk and data science on how to apply models to new use cases and opportunities

  • Finding cheap, fast ways to test an idea (a manual process, an email, a script) with AI before committing engineering time to it

  • Gathering customer research to get truthful and unbiased reads

  • Building tools and automations with AI that save time for you, the ops team and the wider business

  • Doing whatever it takes to get something live, including the unglamorous parts like unblocking developers, socializing with legal and compliance, or writing the guide for the ops team

What we're looking for

Don’t worry if you don’t meet all these criteria. We'd love to talk to any great candidate that is excited, inquisitive, and a go-getter.

  • 1-4 years in product, strategy, analytics, consulting or operations, with some time spent working closely to product or execution teams to deliver value

  • You ask a lot of questions and you're not satisfied until you understand why something is happening

  • You enjoy forming a hypothesis and finding the quickest way to test it, even if the first version is rough

  • You're comfortable with data: you can write SQL or Python and answer your own questions

  • You're already using AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor or Codex in your work or side projects, and you want to see how far they go

  • You're happy to pick up the small jobs, understanding that as a lean product team no job is too unworthy of our attention

  • You like days that look different from each other

  • Bonus: experience in lending, payments, fintech or a fast-growing startup

Keep in mind: you will not be a fit for this role if you're looking for a well-defined backlog to manage, or you'd rather wait until a problem is fully specified before starting on it. Much of what we work on starts as a loose question with multiple options possible.

AI at Zable

We want to build the most AI-forward financial services company in the world. PMs here make their own dashboards to answer questions that used to need an analyst, build their own agents and workflows to take care of repetitive work, and ship straightforward changes to production themselves. You don't need to be an expert on day one, but we'll expect you to keep pushing what one person can do.

Your team

You'll report to the Senior Product Manager for Customer Management, and work most closely with:

  • A developer and design team split across London and Europe, covering frontend and backend

  • A data science team building models specific to the US business

  • A credit risk team

  • A growth team

  • An operations team

The team spans our London office, remote engineers in Europe, and our office in Arlington, Virginia, near DC, which you'll visit.

Life at Zable

  • No one here is limited to their lane. If you want to pick up credit analysis, prototype a feature or fix something in ops, you will be supported.

  • Work from home Mondays and Fridays, and be in the office Tuesday to Thursday, with lunches prepared by our top-tier in-house chefs

  • Top-tier private health insurance

  • Offsites for the US Cards product and engineering team, and an annual whole-company trip abroad (previously Turkey and France)

Interview process

We respect your time and move quickly:

  1. Intro call (remote) - 30 minutes with the hiring manager

  2. Take-home exercise (remote) - a practical product challenge in your own time, followed by a video debrief with two members of the product team

  3. Final round (in our London office) - typically with the CPO and US Cards MD, Engineering Manager, Head of Product and hiring manager

Life at Zable

  • The opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

Check out our Glassdoor Reviews and blog!

Selon les missions, tu es PM IA (LLM, RAG, agents), PM Data (plateformes, produits data, pilotage par la donnée), ou les deux à la fois. Tu ne te contentes pas de piloter un backlog : tu décides de ce qui doit être construit, de ce qui est réaliste, et de ce qui rapporte.

  • Fédérer. Tu rends accessible une technologie complexe à des interlocuteurs exigeants, pour les aligner sur une vision produit claire.

Notre objectif : faire de toi un PM IA & Data de référence, capable de mener des produits intelligents jusqu'à la production, que ce soit sur l'IA, sur la donnée ou sur les deux. Selon ton appétence, ton évolution se construit vers Senior, Product Leader, Manager ou Principal.

Pourquoi rejoindre Hubvisory

  • Une rémunération lisible. De 46 à 58 K€ selon ton expérience, une part variable et l'intéressement jusqu'à 22% des profits, redistribué de façon égalitaire.

Le profil recherché

  • 2 à 5 ans d'expérience comme PM / PO sur des produits digitaux, dont au moins une expérience significative sur un produit IA ou Data. Tu as l'envie et la capacité de couvrir les deux champs. Utiliser l'IA au quotidien ne suffit pas : on attend d'avoir porté un produit et d'avoir pesé sur ses choix techniques.

Le process de recrutement

  2. Cas pratique avec un Manager : hard skills, en live (90 min)

About the role

This is a hands-on, hybrid role: operational and administrative support for the Head of Web, plus running smaller web projects of your own — more doing than overseeing.

You'll independently lead smaller website projects, coordinate designers and developers, communicate directly with clients and ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget and to our quality standards.

At the same time, you'll work closely with our Head of Web, helping coordinate larger projects, prepare client meetings, follow up on deliverables and keep day-to-day operations running smoothly.

We're looking for someone who can think ahead, bring structure to a busy environment and take things off the Head of Web's plate without needing constant direction.

The position starts at around 50% (roughly 20 hours per week), with daily check-ins and the potential to grow as responsibilities increase.


What you'll do

Project Management
