  • Act as the main point of contact for clients on your assigned projects.

  • Coordinate designers, developers and other specialists to ensure smooth project delivery.

  • Translate client requirements into clear tasks, priorities and deliverables.

  • Manage project timelines, budgets and scope, identifying potential risks early.

  • Coordinate testing, quality assurance and website launches.

  • Keep clients informed about progress, next steps and upcoming milestones.

Support the Head of Web

  • Prepare client meetings, agendas, presentations and project documentation.

  • Track open tasks, decisions and deadlines, proactively following up with clients and internal teams.

  • Help prepare project estimates, proposals and statements of work.

  • Support budget tracking, resource planning and project reporting.

  • Coordinate communication between clients, project teams and internal stakeholders.

  • Take ownership of operational and administrative tasks to free up the Head of Web for strategic priorities and client relationships.

  • Identify opportunities to improve internal processes and make project delivery more efficient.

Client Communication & Coordination

  • Follow up on outstanding client feedback, approvals and deliverables.

  • Maintain clear, friendly and professional communication with clients.

  • Support ongoing client relationships by ensuring reliable delivery and responsiveness.

  • Recognize when issues require escalation and involve the Head of Web at the right time.

Key & Essential Skills

Project Management Experience

  • Ability to independently manage smaller projects while supporting larger, more complex initiatives.

  • Strong organizing skills and the ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines and stakeholders simultaneously.

Technical & Digital Understanding

  • Basic understanding of UX, digital marketing, SEO and website analytics.

  • Ability to understand technical discussions and translate them into clear actions.

  • Experience with project management tools such as Linear, Jira, Asana or similar platforms.

Communication & Organisation

  • Excellent written communication and attention to detail.

  • Ability to communicate confidently and professionally with clients.

  • Strong prioritisation skills and a structured, solution-oriented approach.

  • Comfortable working independently while knowing when to ask questions or escalate issues.

  • Proactive in following up on tasks and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.

What makes you a fit

  • You take ownership. You don't just coordinate tasks; you make sure things actually get done.

  • You're one step ahead. You anticipate what needs to happen next and take action without waiting to be asked.

  • You bring structure. You enjoy organising information, managing priorities and keeping multiple projects moving.

  • You're a strong communicator. You know how to keep clients informed, manage expectations and communicate professionally.

  • You're detail-oriented. You notice missing information, unclear requirements and potential problems before they become bigger issues.

  • You're a team player. You're equally comfortable leading your own projects and supporting someone else in delivering larger initiatives.

  • You're adaptable. You can switch between project management, client communication and operational tasks without losing track of priorities.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys the variety of agency work, likes taking responsibility and gets satisfaction from making complex workflows run smoothly.

About Zable

Zable (formerly Lendable) is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.

  • Founded in 2014, profitable since 2017, unicorn since 2021

  • The number one issuer of new credit cards and loans in the UK

  • Backed by Balderton Capital and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan

  • Loved by customers & our team with top reviews on Glassdoor and Trustpilot

Zable was founded on the belief that smarter technology is the solution to lower cost, more transparent consumer finance. Our proprietary foundation models analyse thousands of data points in seconds, drawing a more complete picture of individual financial behaviour. This means we can make better risk decisions, widening access and lowering prices.

The Zable credit card harnesses this technology to deliver better borrowing for three million people. Through our superapp, Zable connects this card to a single platform which makes it effortless to manage credit, get a loan, refinance existing borrowing, switch utilities, get a mobile plan and save more.

Zable is now the number one issuer of new credit cards and personal loans in the UK, but we’ve barely got started. Next, we’re taking our approach to some of the biggest markets in the world - the US and Mexico - where hundreds of millions of people are underserved by outdated bank processes.

Join us if you want to

  • Take ownership across a broad remit - you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Zable from day one

  • Work in small teams of exceptional people - who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo

  • Build the best technology in-house - using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

 

In six years, Zable has built a profitable, market-leading credit card in the UK. In 2023, we brought that playbook to the US and set an even higher bar. This year the US credit card business scaled rapidly: our run rate grew more than 20x in the last six months.

A lot of the work of getting customers through the door is in place. The next stage is about what happens once they’re in: helping them pay on time, giving more credit to the ones who earn it, getting people back on track when they fall behind, and ensuring an intuitive user experience across channels.

If you're excited by fintech, lending and scaling products in a fast-moving environment, this role offers real ownership, impact and room to grow.

About the role

We're hiring a Product Manager to join the product team, and will cover post booking areas including payments, collections, credit limit increases, spend, and the mobile app.

No two weeks look the same. One week you might be sizing an opportunity, the next week sitting with the ops team to understand why customers are calling, or putting a rough version of an idea in front of real customers before anyone builds the proper one. We care more about how quickly we learn than how polished the first attempt looks.

What you'll work on

  • Running experiments across the customer lifecycle, such as how and when we remind people to pay, what gets them to set up autopay, and how we gamify engagement

  • Working with credit risk and data science on how to apply models to new use cases and opportunities

  • Finding cheap, fast ways to test an idea (a manual process, an email, a script) with AI before committing engineering time to it

  • Gathering customer research to get truthful and unbiased reads

  • Building tools and automations with AI that save time for you, the ops team and the wider business

  • Doing whatever it takes to get something live, including the unglamorous parts like unblocking developers, socializing with legal and compliance, or writing the guide for the ops team

What we're looking for

Don’t worry if you don’t meet all these criteria. We'd love to talk to any great candidate that is excited, inquisitive, and a go-getter.

  • 1-4 years in product, strategy, analytics, consulting or operations, with some time spent working closely to product or execution teams to deliver value

  • You ask a lot of questions and you're not satisfied until you understand why something is happening

  • You enjoy forming a hypothesis and finding the quickest way to test it, even if the first version is rough

  • You're comfortable with data: you can write SQL or Python and answer your own questions

  • You're already using AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor or Codex in your work or side projects, and you want to see how far they go

  • You're happy to pick up the small jobs, understanding that as a lean product team no job is too unworthy of our attention

  • You like days that look different from each other

  • Bonus: experience in lending, payments, fintech or a fast-growing startup

Keep in mind: you will not be a fit for this role if you're looking for a well-defined backlog to manage, or you'd rather wait until a problem is fully specified before starting on it. Much of what we work on starts as a loose question with multiple options possible.

AI at Zable

We want to build the most AI-forward financial services company in the world. PMs here make their own dashboards to answer questions that used to need an analyst, build their own agents and workflows to take care of repetitive work, and ship straightforward changes to production themselves. You don't need to be an expert on day one, but we'll expect you to keep pushing what one person can do.

Your team

You'll report to the Senior Product Manager for Customer Management, and work most closely with:

  • A developer and design team split across London and Europe, covering frontend and backend

  • A data science team building models specific to the US business

  • A credit risk team

  • A growth team

  • An operations team

The team spans our London office, remote engineers in Europe, and our office in Arlington, Virginia, near DC, which you'll visit.

Life at Zable

  • No one here is limited to their lane. If you want to pick up credit analysis, prototype a feature or fix something in ops, you will be supported.

  • Work from home Mondays and Fridays, and be in the office Tuesday to Thursday, with lunches prepared by our top-tier in-house chefs

  • Top-tier private health insurance

Life at Zable

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

We make industry stronger.

Manufacturing is the backbone of the European economy, and supply chains are its biggest challenge. Yet procurement in many companies still runs on Excel and legacy systems. With AI, we are fundamentally changing how manufacturers buy: measurably lower material costs and far less manual work.

Your role

You open Italy for Tacto and win the first customers that everything else builds on.

Why this role exists

Tacto is the category leader for procurement in DACH manufacturing. We have strong product-market fit and a proven playbook, and now we are taking it into the rest of Europe. Italy is one of our expansion markets. It has a broad industrial base, from automotive suppliers to machinery and food production, and the category is still wide open there. That’s where you come in: you take the market and build it from the ground up. You research the market, find what resonates and win the first customers and reference logos. What you learn becomes the blueprint for how Tacto grows in Italy from there.

  • A real greenfield. You have the freedom to shape how Tacto wins in your market, from the ICP to the first reference logos.

  • You’re not starting alone. A stellar expansion team is your sparring partner, and proven sales assets and a tested approach from DACH are your foundation.

  • You write the blueprint. What works in your first deals becomes the playbook for everyone who follows you in Italy.

  • You shape how Tacto goes international. Your insights go straight to Product, Marketing and Leadership.

What this role is and isn’t

  • Hands on: You send the first cold emails, run the first discoveries and do the early, unglamorous work where real traction is won.

  • Not a managed territory: There is no machine behind you yet. You drive your own pipeline and build the motion as you go.

Your tasks

  • Open up Italy end to end: You sharpen the ICP for Spanish manufacturing, define target accounts, win the first deals and lay the foundation for the market’s growth.

  • Hunter: You go to market proactively and drive your own pipeline

  • Builder: You turn what works into a system the next person can run

  • Thinks beyond the next deal: You lay Tacto’s foundation in your market, externally through brand, network and reference logos, internally through the playbook and the case for the market

You don’t tick every box? Apply anyway.

Our values

No fixed career path: everyone here grows their own way.

  • We stay real: Come as you are, wherever you come from.

  • Merit matters: Results count, not titles.

  • Bold ambitions: Excellence as the standard.

  • Real passion: Grit and ownership.

  • Transforming industrials: Close to our customers in manufacturing.

  • Fun built-in: We don’t take ourselves too seriously.

  • Caring is key: We help each other grow.

What we offer

What to expect

  • Building at the AI frontier: The newest models from day one, an AI Captain in every team and no limits on what you can try.

  • Growing with clear feedback: Regular feedback conversations mean you always know what it takes to reach the next step.

  • Munich’s tech ecosystem: Every week you meet leading founders and operators at our own and external events. All events: luma.com/tacto

Benefits

  • 26 + 4 days of vacation

  • €300 childcare allowance per child

  • EGYM Wellpass

  • JobRad bike leasing and public transport tickets

How you apply

Fast and transparent, with feedback after every step.

  1. Intro call with our Chief of Staff

Equal opportunity and data protection

Tacto is an equal opportunity employer. We offer everyone the same opportunities regardless of ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability or gender identity.

Please do not send us any personal data revealing your ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs or trade union membership, and no data about your health or sexual orientation.

Our Background

Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material.

Based in Munich, we are 100+ passionate builders who are in-office, with high expectations, fast growth, and a lot of fun. We are supported by >€50m from Sequoia, Index, and Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs and industry veterans.

Why It Matters

Manufacturing forms Europe's economic backbone, driving a fourth of Europe's GDP and providing over 30% of jobs. These hidden champions and global market leaders manufacture the physical world around us, from the machines that build our cities to the medical devices that save lives.

But the world is changing. The US dominates the digital world of bits. China is scaling the world of atoms, manufacturing at unprecedented speed and scale. Geopolitics are more uncertain than ever. Europe's strength lies in its deep industrial knowledge through generations of engineering. Manufacturing worldwide runs on European machines and software. But that heritage is only an advantage if we leverage it in the age of AI.

Tacto builds the AI that connects Atoms and Bits, empowering our Industrial Base to Stay Stronger and building a lighthouse for European tech.

We are smartmicro, the leading specialist in high-performance automotive and traffic radar- and radar/camera hybrid sensor technology. We design, develop and manufacture high-tech sensors for autonomous driving, intelligent traffic infrastructure and smart cities. Our mission is to make roads safer, enable autonomous driving in all-weather scenarios, optimize traffic flow for reduced travel times and enable greener, smarter cities.

We are a German company with international presence in the UK and in the US, while we are headquartered in Braunschweig for design, development and production.

We make the future of mobility a reality.

We are looking for an visionary and experienced Software Architect to lead the technical design and strategy for our entire software portfolio.

Your Tasks

  • Software Architecture: Define and maintain a comprehensive architectural roadmap for smartmicro's software products, ensuring alignment with business objectives and long-term technical vision
  • System Design: Lead the high-level design of our software systems, including embedded firmware on bare metal and Linux-based platforms, the COM HUB edge device, and cloud interfaces
  • Technical Leadership: Act as the go-to expert for architectural questions and challenges
  • Standardization & Best Practices: Establish and enforce technical standards, design patterns, and best practices across the organization - This includes defining and governing core architectural concepts like communication datagrams and interface descriptions
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product Owners, Software Engineers, Group Leads to translate requirements into robust and scalable technical solutions
  • Prototyping & Evaluation: Evaluate, prototype, and recommend new technologies, tools, and frameworks to keep our products at the cutting edge
  • Direct report to the manager of the embedded department

Your Strengths

  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field
  • Proven experience in software development, with a significant portion in a Software Architect, Principal Engineer, or similar technical leadership role
  • Extensive hands-on experience in C or C++ development for complex systems and hardware-oriented software, Python could be required for automation and scripting
  • Deep expertise in designing software for embedded systems, including both baremetal and embedded Linux (e.g., Yocto, buildroot) environments
  • Strong understanding of computer architecture, real-time operating systems, memory management, and hardware abstraction layers
  • Proficiency in designing and implementing inter-process communication (IPC) and distributed systems
  • Expert knowledge of specific RTOS environments such as FreeRTOS, VxWorks, ThreadX, PikeOS or QNX
  • Experience with ARM-based platforms, microcontrollers from NXP and TI and variety communication protocols (e.g., TCP/IP, UDP, MQTT, CAN, REST APIs, Ethernet, I2C and SPI)
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Strong leadership and mentoring capabilities
  • Good German language skills would be a plus

What you can expect from us

  • Innovation: latest technology, innovation and rapid development cycles, excellent work- and test equipment
  • Pleasant working environment: informal culture, motivated teams, short communication channels, room for active participation
  • Future-oriented workplace: modern buildings, offices and labs, permanent employment and individual training opportunities
  • Attractive location: located directly next to the highway, direct bus stop at our facilities, parking facilities for cars and bikes, free charging of electric vehicles
  • Flexible working: hybrid working (4 days office presence per week)
  • Activities: team events, gym membership and more.

The Zable credit card harnesses this technology to deliver better borrowing for three million people. Through our superapp, Zable connects this card to a single platform which makes it effortless to manage credit, get a loan, refinance existing borrowing, switch utilities, get a mobile plan and save more.

jobs.title: Defense Success Manager, France
jobs.description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As a Defense Success Manager, you own what happens to our most strategic defense and sovereign accounts after the build: you make deployed AI stick in real workflows — often in restricted or disconnected environments — keep production commitments healthy, defend renewals, and source the expansion signals that Sales closes.

Mistral's Solutions teams (Deployment Strategists and Forward Deployed Engineers) co-create high-value AI use cases with customers in these environments. Your job is to make those investments successful beyond delivery — adopting what has been built, operating it with confidence, demonstrating its impact, and scaling value across the institution. You will work with mission owners, program stakeholders, end users, security and IT teams, and across Mistral with Solutions, Product, Engineering and Support.

This is not a high-volume, ticket-queue customer success role. Portfolios are small and deep — typically one or two flagship accounts plus a small number of adjacent programs. It calls for a strategic account mindset, the technical judgment to navigate complex and constrained deployment environments, and the energy to build the customer success function as Mistral grows. Travel to customer sites, including secure facilities, is a regular part of the job.

You will join on one of two tracks (and can move between them):

  • Adoption track — embedded in flagship programs while Solutions is still delivering. You own the adoption and change-management motion around the build: user waves, enablement, champions, training programs, and the evidence that proves value is landing.

  • Operational track — you take accounts through a structured handover once Solutions completes delivery, and own the run phase end-to-end: operational health, value realization, renewals, and expansion signals.

In both tracks you operate in close partnership with Solutions: they deliver and hand over; you own post-handover; they re-engage on expansion signals. Occasionally, account teams will also pull you into late-stage pre-sales — authoring the customer training and scale-up plan that gives a buyer confidence in the rollout.


What You Will Do


Own the customer success and value plan

  • Build a clear view of each account's objectives, stakeholders, deployed use cases, commitments and risks. Translate it into a shared success plan with owners, milestones and measurable outcomes.

  • Establish a practical operating cadence with customer sponsors, business owners, IT and delivery teams. Lead success reviews that make progress, risks, decisions and next steps clear.

  • Define a baseline and track the outcomes that matter for each use case: adoption and usage against entitled seats, customer satisfaction, operational health and business impact. Turn the evidence into a clear value narrative.

Make deployment realities part of the success plan

  • Understand how each customer's deployment model — on-premises, VPC or serverless — affects the products and use cases they can access, operate and scale. Validate the specifics with the technical teams rather than assuming feature parity or identical operating models.

  • Identify the practical implications of deployment choices: security and data requirements, access and integrations, release and upgrade cadence, available features, capacity, observability and support processes. Explain the trade-offs clearly to customer and Mistral stakeholders.

  • Translate those constraints into an actionable adoption plan: align enablement and release communications with the version the customer actually runs, account for security approvals and upgrade windows, and agree how to measure usage when telemetry is limited.

  • Spot risks early, qualify their impact on adoption, renewal or value, and coordinate the right Solutions, Product, Engineering or Support owners to resolve them. Set clear expectations without making unvalidated technical or roadmap commitments.

Drive adoption, autonomy and sustained value

  • Help customer teams move from a delivered use case to regular, effective use. Identify the users, workflows and change-management needs that determine whether it sticks.

  • Coordinate onboarding, training, product updates and hands-on enablement with the right Mistral and customer teams. Develop customer champions and train-the-trainer motions so adoption scales beyond direct Mistral involvement.

  • Prepare the transition from delivery to run: clarify operational ownership, support and escalation paths, and the resources users need to succeed independently.

  • Monitor adoption and customer health, investigate where usage or value is falling short, and lead a coordinated plan to address the causes.

Defend and grow the commercial relationship

  • Own the renewal motion for your accounts: know every renewal date, the auto vs non-auto renewal terms, and the risk story behind each one. Run the renewal play early — no surprises at renewal time.

  • Track and improve account NRR. Identify new use cases, teams and expansion opportunities, and share them with the account team grounded in demonstrated value.

  • Lead business reviews with the account team: value delivered, risks owned, decisions needed, roadmap asks.

Bring the customer voice into Mistral

  • Gather and qualify feedback from users, technical teams and sponsors. Distinguish enablement needs from product gaps, deployment constraints and support issues, and route each to the right owner.

  • Track important requests and communicate progress and limitations back to the customer, while Product and Engineering retain ownership of product and technical decisions.

Build the company as well as the account

  • Create the playbooks, success plans, handover practices and measurement approaches that are missing. Test them with customers, improve them, and make them reusable across accounts.

  • Bring structure to ambiguity: identify what needs to happen, make a plan, mobilize the right people and follow through — without waiting for a perfect process or detailed instructions.

  • Roughly a fifth of your time is protected, rotating build time for exactly this work; it is part of the job, not extra to it.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience owning outcomes for enterprise or institutional customers of technical products or deployed solutions — adoption and commercial outcomes (retention, renewal, expansion), not relationship management or activity reporting.

  • Strong technical fluency in secure enterprise deployment models. You can identify what a deployment type (on-premise, disconnected, air-gapped) means for available features, telemetry, upgrades and accreditation, and you validate specifics with technical teams instead of assuming parity.

  • Ability to engage credibly with architects, engineers, IT and security stakeholders, while translating technical trade-offs into clear implications for mission owners and executives. You know when to bring in a deeper technical expert.

  • Comfort operating under security, compliance and confidentiality constraints, including restricted or classified environments and strict information-handling rules.

  • Strong ownership and builder energy. You have created structure or improved a process in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment and are motivated to build a company, not wait for clear directions.

  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management and execution skills. You align teams without formal authority, surface risks early and drive decisions through to completion

  • Analytical and commercially minded: you can define meaningful success metrics with imperfect data, assess customer health, and are comfortable carrying renewal and NRR accountability.


Nice to have

  • Experience serving defense, public sector or critical infrastructure customers, including sovereign or classified programs.

  • Experience with AI, machine learning, data platforms or complex enterprise software, including production deployments in regulated or security-sensitive environments.

  • Experience working alongside deployment, engineering or professional services teams on custom use cases, and the transition from implementation to ongoing operation.

  • Familiarity with public procurement, framework agreements and multi-year option structures.

Security & Compliance criteria

  • Eligibility: must hold citizenship in the target territory (France for now).

  • Clearable: must meet all local requirements for high-level security clearance (e.g. no criminal record, fulfillment of national service obligations).

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Influence:

Experience

About the Role

Imagine this. You are joining Destinus at a pivotal moment, helping build a Project Management Office (PMO) from the ground up while supporting multiple fast-moving aerospace and defense programs. As a Senior PMO Analyst, you will play a key role in bringing structure, visibility, and execution discipline to complex programs, ensuring our Program Managers can focus on delivering groundbreaking technologies.

Destinus is scaling multiple aerospace and defense programs in parallel, and we are looking for a proactive, hands-on professional who can take real workload off our Program Managers from day one. You will be embedded directly in our programs while helping establish the cross-functional processes, tools, and governance needed to support our growth.

Reporting to the Head of PMO and working in close collaboration with C-level leadership, you will have the opportunity to shape how our programs are planned, monitored, and delivered. From building integrated schedules and managing risks to introducing AI-powered tools and automations, your work will have a direct and visible impact across the organization.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You'll Do

Program Planning & Execution

  • Proactively step in alongside Program Managers and take ownership of core PMO activities, including integrated program plans, milestones, critical paths, and schedule control.
  • Support one or several programs simultaneously, ensuring effective coordination and acting as a connector between teams and programs.
  • Track program dependencies, budgets, and resources across multiple initiatives, identifying potential conflicts and escalating issues early.
  • Help Program Managers maintain clear visibility over progress, priorities, and delivery commitments, enabling them to focus on critical program execution.

PMO Development & Cross-Functional Processes

  • Work closely with the Head of PMO to build the PMO foundation from scratch, developing standards, templates, governance frameworks, and practical ways of working that teams actually use.
  • Lead the development and implementation of cross-functional processes spanning programs and departments, from Engineering and Supply Chain to Production, Quality, and Delivery.
  • Establish scalable processes that improve collaboration, consistency, and operational efficiency as Destinus continues to grow.
  • Help create a structured yet pragmatic PMO environment that supports fast decision-making without introducing unnecessary complexity.

Risk, Issue & Performance Management

  • Drive program risk and issue management by proactively identifying, assessing, tracking, and escalating potential challenges.
  • Coordinate and follow up on mitigation actions, ensuring risks and issues are addressed effectively and on time.
  • Prepare clear program reports, dashboards, and decision-making materials for program reviews and senior leadership.
  • Provide accurate and actionable insights into program performance, highlighting key milestones, risks, dependencies, and areas requiring management attention.

AI, Automation & Continuous Improvement

  • Develop and apply AI-supported tools and automations to make PMO activities faster, more efficient, and more reliable.
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive activities, including reporting, status consolidation, and action tracking.
  • Explore and implement practical solutions using AI tools, workflow automation, scripting, and low-code platforms where appropriate.
  • Continuously improve PMO tools, processes, and reporting methods to reduce administrative workload and increase visibility across programs.

Stakeholder Management & Leadership Collaboration

  • Work closely with Program Managers, the Head of PMO, and C-level leadership to support program execution and strategic decision-making.
  • Act as a central point of coordination across programs and functions, ensuring information, priorities, and dependencies remain aligned.
  • Translate complex program information into structured, concise, and actionable updates for different stakeholders.
  • Build strong working relationships across Engineering, Supply Chain, Production, Quality, and other business functions to drive effective collaboration.

Requirements

What You'll Need

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • At least 5 years of experience in PMO, Program Management, or Project Controls.

  • Strong command of PMO fundamentals, including scheduling, risk management, reporting, and stakeholder management.

  • A proactive, structured, and pragmatic approach to work, with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to operate at pace.

  • Confidence working from a blank page and building structure in a fast-moving, ambiguous scale-up environment.

  • Fluency in English and German, both written and spoken.

  • Familiarity with project management and collaboration tools such as MS Project, Jira, Microsoft Dynamics and other ERP systems, Smartsheet, Confluence, or similar platforms.

  • Strong Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills, with the ability to create clear reports, dashboards, and leadership presentations.

  • Eligibility to work in Switzerland.

  • Willingness to travel occasionally to other Destinus locations.

Strong Plus

  • Previous consulting experience, ideally involving PMO setup, transformation, or hands-on PMO support for client companies.

  • Practical experience using AI tools and automation technologies, including Large Language Models (LLMs), workflow automation, scripting, or low-code platforms.

  • Experience designing, implementing, and improving cross-functional business processes.

  • Understanding of hardware development and engineering environments, including product lifecycle management, gate reviews, and change management.

Nice to Have

  • Project management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, or SAFe.

  • Experience in aerospace, defense, automotive, or other complex hardware industries.

  • Technical skills in Python, SQL, Power BI, or API-based integrations.

Who You Are

  • You are proactive by nature and do not wait for instructions to make things happen. You identify what needs to be done, take ownership, and deliver results.

  • You thrive in fast-paced environments where priorities evolve quickly, ambiguity is part of the challenge, and building structure from scratch is an opportunity rather than an obstacle.

  • You combine strong analytical thinking with a practical, hands-on approach, knowing when to dive into the details and when to focus on the bigger picture.

  • You enjoy bringing clarity to complexity, transforming scattered information, competing priorities, and challenging timelines into actionable plans.

  • You are comfortable working closely with Program Managers and senior leadership, communicating confidently and turning complex program information into clear recommendations.

  • You are naturally collaborative and know how to connect people, teams, and functions to keep programs moving forward.

  • You challenge inefficient processes and actively look for smarter ways of working, especially through technology, AI, and automation.

  • You are organized, detail-oriented, and reliable, with the ability to manage multiple priorities without losing sight of deadlines or deliverables.

  • You bring a continuous improvement mindset, balancing the discipline of structured program management with the flexibility required in a rapidly growing company.

  • You are comfortable taking initiative, making decisions, and working independently while knowing when to involve others or escalate critical issues.

  • You value transparency, accountability, and teamwork, and you are motivated by making a tangible impact on complex aerospace and defense programs.

What We Offer

  • A founding role in building the PMO of a fast-growing aerospace company, with the opportunity to shape its structure and future direction.

  • The freedom to develop and influence the tools, processes, standards, and ways of working that will support our continued growth.

  • Direct access to senior leadership, including close collaboration with the Head of PMO and C-level executives, and the opportunity to make a visible impact across multiple programs.

Wat ga je doen als SEO Content Specialist
Als SEO Content Specialist ben jij samen met je collega’s verantwoordelijk voor alle teksten en blogs op de Independer website. Het schrijven en optimaliseren van flitsende teksten zit jou in het bloed. Tegelijkertijd haal je ook energie uit het verbeteren van onze contentstrategie en -planning. Je bepaalt samen met je SEO-collega’s waar de prio’s komen te liggen. Wordt jouw tekst gevonden via Google? Jij houdt de resultaten nauwlettend in de gaten. Want dat er altijd ruimte is voor verbetering begrijp jij maar al te goed.

Geen dag is hetzelfde bij Independer. Onze producten hebben betrekking op veel levensgebeurtenissen en raken zoveel mensen dat je alle kanten op kunt. De ene dag schrijf je een inhoudelijke tekst voor onze eigen website, de andere dag werk je mee aan een nieuwsbericht of onderzoek. Dat kan over van alles gaan. Van het verduurzamen van je huis tot het vinden van een goede hypotheek. Zo steek je de teksten de ene keer commercieel in en de andere keer juist informatief. Aan afwisseling geen gebrek. En je leert er inhoudelijk ook nog veel van. Mooi meegenomen, toch?

Concreet ga je aan de slag met:

Als SEO Content Specialist ben je onderdeel van het negenkoppige SEO-team, dat weer onderdeel is van het brede Independer marketingteam. We zijn als team ook onderdeel van de afdeling Online Services van DPG Media (ons moederbedrijf). Hierdoor werken we één keer per maand met zijn allen samen in Hilversum of in Amsterdam op het DPG kantoor. Tussendoor kun je altijd bij je mede-specialisten terecht met vragen en ideeën.

  • Een fijn kantoor met gratis parkeergelegenheid en station Hilversum op loopafstand

  • En natuurlijk een bedrijf vol enthousiaste collega’s!


Wat wij zoeken
Onze nieuwe collega is bovenal een supergoede schrijver. Je maakt met jouw pen ieder onderwerp boeiend, schrijft foutloos en werk gestructureerd. Daarnaast geef je feedback op teksten van je collega's. Ook houd je de contentprestaties bij in een rapportage en weet hier lessen uit te trekken. Als SEO Content Specialist heb je al de nodige SEO werkzaamheden verricht. Je blijft graag op de hoogte van de laatste ontwikkelingen en verwerkt deze ook in je werkzaamheden. Waarom juist Independer?
Omdat je bij Independer echt impact kunt maken op het leven van de klant. Samen met jouw SEO-collega’s bind en boei je klanten door middel van krachtige teksten Je krijgt veel verantwoordelijkheid en vrijheid bij ons en hierdoor is er veel ruimte voor jouw ideeën en oplossingen.

jobs.description:

Bringe Qualität auf das nächste Level – bei unseren Kunden und in deinen Projekten.
Du brennst für Softwarequalität, automatisierte Tests und moderne Tools? Du möchtest anspruchsvolle Projekte begleiten, Verantwortung übernehmen und deine Expertise im IT-Consulting einsetzen? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams!

  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Testarchitekturen und -automatisierung: Dabei konzipierst und pflegst du Automatisierungsarchitekturen, sicherst die Qualität geschäftskritischer Anwendungen und entwickelst Testprozesse weiter.
  • Du setzt moderne Automatisierungslösungen um: Mit Tools wie Playwright, REST Assured, Cucumber, Tricentis Tosca oder Cypress entwickelst du automatisierte Tests und integrierst sie nahtlos in CI/CD-Pipelines.
  • Du planst und steuerst Tests – und berätst deine Kunden: Du koordinierst Testaktivitäten, leitest kleinere Teams und unterstützt Projekt- und Fachteams bei der Entwicklung von Teststrategien, Qualitätssicherung und Best Practices.
  • Du analysierst und berichtest Ergebnisse: Du bewertest Testergebnisse, dokumentierst Abweichungen, beobachtest den Testfortschritt und leitest Optimierungen ein.
  • Du arbeitest an vielfältigen Themen: Ob agile Teams, DevOps-Umfelder, Cloud- oder Mobile-Testing – du bringst deine Expertise ein und bleibst technologisch am Puls der Zeit.

Was du mitbringst

  • Du hast mindestens 3-5 Jahre Praxiserfahrung im Bereich Softwaretest, Testautomatisierung oder Qualitätssicherung – idealerweise in einer beratenden Rolle.
  • Du beherrschst mehrere Programmiersprachen – z. B. Java, Python, JavaScript oder Typescript – und fühlst dich sicher im Umgang mit Test- und Performance-Tools wie Playwright, Cucumber, JUnit, REST Assured, Tricentis Tosca, JMeter oder Gatling.
  • Du kennst moderne Testkonzepte und -standards: Agiles Testen, risikobasierte Strategien oder exploratives Testdesign sind dir vertraut und eine ISTQB-Zertifizierung bringst du bereits mit.
  • Idealerweise verfügst du zudem über Erfahrung im Bereich Barrierefreiheit (Accessibility Testing) sowie im Testen von und mit KI-basierten Anwendungen und Systemen.
  • Du kommunizierst klar und adressatengerecht: Ob mit Entwicklern, Product Ownern oder Stakeholdern – du kannst Anforderungen aufnehmen, Ergebnisse präsentieren und Empfehlungen aussprechen. Erfahrung mit REST/SOAP-APIs ist ein Plus.
  • Du bringst Teamgeist und Führungserfahrung mit: Du hast bereits kleinere Teams gesteuert oder Kolleg:innen fachlich begleitet und weiterentwickelt.
  • Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und die Kommunikation auf Englisch stellt für dich kein Problem dar.

Worauf du dich freuen kannst - unsere Benefits

  • Spannende Projekte: Du arbeitest an vielseitigen Kundenprojekten in einem professionellen Beratungsumfeld, in dem du deine Erfahrung und eigene Ideen einbringst, Verantwortung übernimmst und mit deinen Impulsen zum Game Changer im Projekt werden kannst.

Mit unserer wöchentlichen „Bewegten Pause“ bringst du außerdem Bewegung und Mobilisierung in deinen Arbeitsalltag – im Büro oder im Homeoffice.

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Founded in 2010 in the Netherlands, AnywhereNow is a global leader in Enterprise Dialogue Management, with a vision to ensure every employee and customer feels heard, understood, and valued.

Today, our team of approximately 240 employees spans 22 countries, supporting more than 2,000 organisations worldwide. We partner with leading enterprises including Mazda, the UN International Organization for Migration, The Adecco Group, and the University of Cape Town to deliver exceptional customer and employee experiences through the power of Microsoft Teams and AI-driven innovation.

Driven by our commitment to innovation, customer focus, accountability, and continuous improvement, we help organisations modernise communication and customer engagement across complex enterprise environments.

Our portfolio includes:

  • Dialogue Cloud – our enterprise dialogue management platform built for Microsoft Teams.

  • Deepdesk – AI-powered Agent Assist technology that helps service teams work faster and smarter.

  • Tendfor – a customer engagement and contact centre solution designed for Microsoft Teams environments.

Together, these solutions enable organisations to create more intelligent, efficient, and personalised experiences for both customers and employees.

As we continue to accelerate our AI-first strategy, we're investing heavily in the next generation of agentic solutions, creating exciting opportunities for engineers who want to help shape the future of enterprise AI.


About the Role

We're looking for an AI Engineer to help build the next generation of AI-powered enterprise solutions.

This is a hands-on engineering role focused on designing, building, and scaling intelligent agents across the Microsoft ecosystem. You'll transform defined business use cases into production-ready agentic solutions, leveraging modern AI technologies, Azure services, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) architecture.

As part of the Agent Factory team, you'll develop agents that can securely access enterprise systems, interact with business tools, manage context and memory effectively, and operate reliably at scale. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, QA, and AI leadership to ensure every solution delivers real business value while meeting enterprise standards for security, performance, and governance.

Beyond technical delivery, you'll bring product thinking and commercial awareness, helping to identify meaningful customer challenges, emerging AI opportunities, and relevant market trends. Your insights will contribute to shaping and refining the Agent Factory roadmap and backlog.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building practical AI applications and can take solutions from concept through to production deployment.

What You'll Be Doing

Build and Deliver Intelligent Agents

  • Design, build and deploy AI agents that solve real customer and business problems.

  • Create agents that deliver value independently while contributing insights to a broader intelligence ecosystem.

  • Translate product requirements and use cases into scalable, production-ready solutions.

Develop MCP-Based Integrations

  • Build and operate Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that provide agents with secure access to tools, systems and enterprise data.

  • Define and implement tool interfaces, authentication mechanisms and resource access patterns.

  • Ensure agents can interact with enterprise services in a structured, secure and reliable way.

Integrate Enterprise Systems

  • Connect agents with business-critical platforms including:

    • Microsoft Dynamics 365

    • Microsoft Graph

    • Dataverse

    • ServiceNow

    • Contact Centre and Customer Experience platforms

    • Internal and third-party APIs

Design Context, Memory & Intelligence

  • Define how agents manage memory, context and decision-making patterns.

  • Implement retrieval, reasoning and tool-use strategies that promote consistent and predictable behaviour.

  • Design guardrails that enable agents to operate safely and effectively within enterprise environments.

Contribute to the Agent Ecosystem

  • Develop supporting services including adapters, event processing capabilities and integration layers.

  • Enable agents to share insights and consume intelligence from a wider ecosystem of interconnected solutions.

  • Help shape future product direction by contributing technical expertise, customer insights and market observations.

What You'll Bring

  • Microsoft Technology Expertise

  • Strong software engineering experience using C# and .NET.

  • Hands-on experience with Azure services, including:

    • Azure Functions

    • Azure App Service

    • Azure OpenAI Service

    • Azure AI Foundry / AI Studio

  • Experience integrating with Microsoft business platforms such as:

    • Dynamics 365

    • Dataverse

    • Microsoft Graph

    • Power Platform

  • Knowledge of Azure security and identity services, including:

    • Microsoft Entra ID

    • Managed Identities

    • Azure Key Vault

Agentic AI & MCP Experience

  • Practical experience building or consuming MCP servers.

  • Knowledge of agent frameworks and orchestration technologies such as:

    • Semantic Kernel

    • AutoGen

    • Microsoft AI SDKs

  • Experience with:

    • Function and tool calling

    • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

    • Vector databases

    • Context and memory management

  • Ability to design clear, reliable and secure agent interactions.#

Broader Engineering Skills

  • Strong API integration experience, including REST APIs, webhooks and event-driven architectures.

  • Experience with cloud-native deployment, CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code approaches.

  • Understanding of performance, latency, reliability and cost considerations when working with Large Language Models in production.

  • Commitment to software quality, testing and continuous improvement.

  • Ability to work closely with QA teams on agent evaluation, testing and quality assurance.

Who You Are

You'll be successful in this role if you are:

  • A pragmatic builder who can take ideas from concept to production.

  • Passionate about applying AI to solve real-world business challenges.

  • Comfortable working independently while collaborating with cross-functional teams.

  • A systems thinker who understands how individual components contribute to larger platforms and architectures.

  • Security-conscious and focused on building reliable enterprise-grade solutions.

  • Excited by emerging AI technologies and eager to learn as the landscape evolves.

Nice to Have

While not essential, we'd be particularly interested in candidates with experience in:

  • Multi-agent architectures and agent-to-agent communication.

  • Delivering AI solutions within enterprise or regulated environments.

  • LLM observability, monitoring, tracing, and evaluation frameworks.

  • Contact Centre, Customer Experience, or enterprise workflow automation platforms.

Why Join Us?

This is an opportunity to help shape the future of AI within a rapidly evolving product organisation. You'll work with cutting-edge Microsoft AI technologies, contribute directly to innovative agentic solutions, and play a key role in building scalable AI capabilities that deliver measurable value to customers. If you're passionate about building intelligent systems and want to be at the forefront of enterprise AI innovation, we'd love to hear from you.

Information Security Responsibilities

At AnywhereNow, information security is everyone's responsibility. All employees are expected to actively support and maintain the organisation's information security standards and contribute to protecting the confidentiality, integrity and availability of company and customer information.

This includes:

  • Adhering to all applicable information security policies, procedures and guidelines at all times.

  • Protecting company, customer and partner data from unauthorised access, disclosure, alteration or loss.

  • Using company systems, devices and networks in a secure and compliant manner.

  • Promptly reporting any suspected or actual security incidents, breaches or vulnerabilities to the appropriate team.

  • Completing mandatory information security and data protection training as required.

  • Ensuring that confidential information is handled and stored securely in accordance with company policies and applicable legal requirements.

Failure to comply with information security responsibilities may result in disciplinary action.

UX Designer
jobs.description:
AI doesn't run in one place anymore. It runs in the browser tab, the desktop app, the agent your engineers kicked off, and the copilot embedded in the tools you already pay for. Harmonic Security governs all of it.

Our AI Governance and Control (AIGC) platform sits on the device, inside the interaction, at the moment of action, reading what AI is actually doing (not just the traffic around it) and acting in real time. Security teams get full visibility and control across every AI surface, including the agentic and MCP layer that traditional tools can't see. Their people get to innovate without guardrails slowing them down.

We're gaining serious traction at the intersection of AI and cybersecurity, and backed by investors who know the space: N47, Ten Eleven Ventures, and In-Q-Tel. As AI adoption inside the enterprise accelerates, the ability to safely observe, control, and enforce policy in real time isn't a nice-to-have. It's mission-critical infrastructure. That's what we build.

How We Work: AI-First by Design

Harmonic exists to help enterprises adopt AI safely and at scale. We hold ourselves to that same standard. Everyone here actively leverages AI tools to perform their best work, from deep research and writing to building robust processes and automating complex workflows. We expect every new hire to bring a genuine curiosity for AI and a commitment to using it to work smarter, faster, and with greater creativity.

For some, this involves tinkering and remaining open to emerging tools; for others, it means architecting entirely new systems with AI at the core. We will be transparent about expectations for every role and provide the tools and support needed for you to thrive.

About the Team

Our Product Delivery team is the engine that turns vision into impact. We ship early and often, getting valuable features into the hands of customers quickly and iterating from there. We work in the open by default, sharing progress and ideas, and we trust each other to own outcomes. We’re a small but mighty crew where every person plays a critical role and we’re committed to using AI to work smarter and faster.

About the Role

We're looking for a UX Designer to join our Product Delivery division, reporting to our Lead Product Designer. You'll move between delivery teams as the roadmap needs you, designing the features that help security teams see and control how AI is used across their organisation.

You'll take problems from research through flows, wireframes and prototypes to designs engineers can build, working inside our design system and alongside product managers and engineers.

What You'll Do

  • Design roadmap features end to end, from research and user flows to prototypes and handover

  • Own and document design decisions, explaining the reasoning behind patterns rather than simply repeating them

  • Define patterns for AI behaviour and fluency within the product

  • Move between delivery teams as priorities change, getting up to speed quickly

  • Use and contribute to the evolution of our design system to create consistent, accessible experiences

  • Test designs with users and use evidence to inform your solutions

  • Make complex security and AI data clear and actionable to a breadth of customer personas and company segments

  • Improve existing product experiences and use AI to explore and prototype faster

  • Write clear, plain US English UI copy using approved product terminology

What You Bring

  • Experience designing software products, ideally B2B SaaS

  • A portfolio that shows your reasoning, trade-offs and learning

  • Strong interaction design and information architecture for data-heavy interfaces

  • Hands-on research and usability testing skills

  • Fluency in Figma and shared design systems

  • Ability to collaborate with engineering, product and senior stakeholders, communicating design decisions clearly and efficiently

  • Accessibility experience to WCAG 2.1 AA, including designing for colour vision deficiency

  • Strong written communication, ideally including UI copy in US English

You Might Be a Fit if You

  • Think commercially, considering what resonates with customers and leadership as well as what works on screen

  • Design AI features that earn trust through explanations, human-centric checkpoints and user journeys, not just polished concepts

  • Have designed for technical users, such as security, IT, data or developer teams

  • Ask questions, make assumptions explicit and seek existing patterns first

  • Share unfinished work, welcome feedback and iterate openly

  • Have designed for AI products and understand uncertainty, error and loading states

  • Use AI thoughtfully in your design workflow

  • Care about practical accessibility and thrive in a fast-paced startup environment

Why Join Us

This isn't just a job - it's a chance to help define a category. Harmonic Security was named to the Rising in Cyber 2026 list, and we're just getting started. We're building at the intersection of AI and security, carving out an emerging market where the rules haven't been written yet, and the people who join now will write them.

We believe today's talent is tomorrow's success, and we're committed to creating an environment where you can do the best work of your life.

  • Recognized momentum - We made the Rising in Cyber 2026 list, a signal that the market is taking notice

  • Rare market opportunity - Join early in a category-defining company at the convergence of AI and security, where your work directly shapes how enterprises tackle one of the biggest unsolved problems in tech

  • Competitive pay and meaningful equity - A real stake in Harmonic's success, not a token gesture

  • Comprehensive benefits - pension plan and flexible hybrid work

  • A small, high-trust team that values transparency, creativity, and continuous learning - no politics, no bureaucracy

  • Thoughtful leadership - that cares deeply about your growth, not just your output

  • Annual global off-sites - past trips include Lisbon, Portugal and Nashville, TN

  • Real ownership - you'll shape the product, the culture, and the direction of the company from day one

Harmonic's Core Values

🌱 Flourish in the Unknown

We embrace new, unfamiliar situations that require initiative and rapid decision-making. We orient ourselves quickly and deliver results with minimal guidance.

🔥 Never Full

We raise our hands, take on challenges, and assist others whenever possible. We hunger for opportunities to learn and do more.

🤝 Perfect Harmony

We support one another to create cohesion and unity. We collaborate openly, share feedback honestly, and help everyone produce their best work

jobs.description:
Who We Are

You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today.

We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover.

Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI.

Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.

Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.

The Opportunity

The CPO office at Prosus is deliberately small. Nalden sets the direction: what we build and why. Jons, as Chief of Staff, creates the traction: the operating model, the portfolio, the prioritisation, and the decisions that turn direction into shipped product. Around them sit product managers, product marketing, growth, brand, content and design, and three product pods that do the building.

What holds those two ends together is the work itself: every initiative visible, owned and moving, and every decision captured before it evaporates. That is this job. As Program Manager you run Nalden_OS — the operating loop of the CPO portfolio — day to day. You do not own the initiatives; you make sure each one has someone who does.

You join while that loop is being built rather than maintained, so you shape it: what gets tracked, how reviews run, what a decision record looks like, and which reporting we stop doing because nobody reads it.

In this role you will

  • Keep the whole portfolio visible, with an explicit owner on every line of work in flight across the CPO office and the product pods.

  • Prepare the decisions: shape ambiguous work until it is ready to be decided on, and prepare the prioritisation calls and operating reviews for the CPO and the Chief of Staff.

  • Make it move: track progress and dependencies across teams, surface blockers early, and escalate with a recommendation rather than a status update.

  • Make it stick: capture decisions and the reasoning behind them, keep the information people rely on accurate, and turn what teams learn into knowledge someone will reuse.

  • Build the view: a clean, reliable portfolio in slides, backed by a tracking system people actually update — assembled with AI so it takes an hour, not a week.

  • Be the honest signal: say early where the plan and reality have diverged, including when the useful version is the uncomfortable one.

What This Role Is Not

You do not make product decisions, approve teams' work, or become a reporting layer between teams and leadership. If teams spend more time updating you than shipping, the role is failing — and you would be the first to say so.

Who You Are

You are the person others trust in a messy week. When priorities shift and work stalls, you stay level, name what is actually happening, and get the loop closed. You follow up without nagging, and an unowned item bothers you until somebody picks it up.


You like order, but you fit the system to the work rather than the other way round. You build trust quickly across designers, engineers and executives, and you carry influence without authority: you move work through people who do not report to you. You are direct enough to raise the awkward problem early, and low-ego enough to let someone else take the credit when it lands.

What You Bring

  • 8 to 10 years running cross-team program execution in digital commerce, technology product management, consumer facing technology, with an earlier career in management consulting.

  • You have owned outcomes across teams without owning the teams. Titles vary — program manager, strategy manager, operations lead, product operations — but the pattern is the same: you were accountable for work you moved through people who did not report to you.

  • Fluent in product work: you know how discovery, design and shipping actually run, and you can talk to designers and engineers without a translator.

  • Comfortable with data and tools: you build a clean portfolio view and a tracking system people trust, and you use AI to do the assembly faster than most.

  • Experience working closely with senior leaders, ideally from an executive office or chief-of-staff environment; experience inside a larger corporate group around a small, fast team is a real advantage.

  • Comfortable at both altitudes: you can run a room of executives in the morning and fix the tracking sheet in the afternoon.

  • Excellent written and spoken English. Dutch is a plus, not a requirement.

  • Not a classic PMO profile. We want someone who clears the path, not someone who produces process.

What We Offer

  • Global Impact: Play a crucial role in shaping the future of global commerce. Be part of a dynamic ecosystem of tech-led companies across markets, from emerging disruptors to established platforms, all working to create positive change at scale.

  • Growth Opportunities: Expand your expertise through high-stakes challenges within our diverse portfolio. You will gain access to a network of businesses, leaders, and learning opportunities that span continents and industries.

  • Innovative Culture: Join a forward-thinking team that values strategic insights and bold ideas. You will operate at the intersection of venture-building, innovation, and investment, where experimentation is encouraged and cross-company collaboration drives breakthroughs.

  • Creative Environment: Engage in work that encourages creativity and constant improvement. We challenge assumptions, explore new frontiers, and believe great ideas can come from anywhere in our ecosystem.

  • Collaborative Atmosphere: Benefit from autonomy and self-management in a supportive, outcome-driven workspace. You will work alongside sharp, motivated peers across our portfolio, all united by a shared ambition to move the needle.

  • Hybrid Work: Experience the satisfaction of our flexible model tailored to balance work and life.

  • Competitive Compensation: Enjoy a salary package that reflects your skills and contributions.

  • Comprehensive Benefits: From health and wellness to learning, commuting, and everyday perks, we offer a well-rounded package designed to help you thrive at work and beyond.

Why Prosus?

At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next.

Own the impact. Work the ecosystem. Earn your growth. Build with backing.

Our Diversity & Inclusion Commitment

We respect the dignity and human rights of individuals and communities wherever we operate in the world. Building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and can thrive is critical for us. We provide access to education, which helps everyone understand the important role they play and the positive impact they can have.

You will work with financial institutions to understand complex compliance challenges, design solutions using Dotfile’s platform and AI agents, and turn them into successful production deployments.

You will own the technical customer journey from pre-sales through implementation: leading discovery, designing solution architectures, delivering compelling demonstrations and proofs of concept, and guiding customers through integration and go-live. As Dotfile moves toward increasingly autonomous compliance, you will help customers rethink manual processes, identify opportunities for automation, and deploy our AI capabilities into real-world compliance workflows.

We believe AI should transform not only our product, but also how we work. You will be expected to use AI extensively to work faster, automate repetitive tasks, improve customer delivery, and help us build a more scalable Solutions Consulting organization.

You will report directly to the Director of Solutions Consulting.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the sales process, partnering with Sales to understand customer challenges and design solutions that address them

  • Lead technical discovery with prospects to understand their compliance workflows, technical architecture, data sources and integration requirements

  • Design and deliver tailored product demonstrations and proofs of concept that show how Dotfile can solve complex, real-world compliance challenges

  • Architect end-to-end solutions using Dotfile’s platform, APIs, integrations and AI capabilities, and clearly communicate them to both technical and business stakeholders

  • Own the technical success of customer implementations, from solution design and configuration through integration, testing and go-live

  • Help customers identify opportunities to automate manual compliance processes and deploy Dotfile’s AI capabilities into production workflows

  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering, bringing customer insights into product decisions and helping shape what we build next

  • Use AI extensively in your own work to automate repetitive tasks, accelerate solution design and documentation, and continuously improve how the Solutions Consulting team operates

About you

  • You have 3+ years of experience in Solutions Consulting, Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, or another technical customer-facing role, ideally in B2B SaaS, fintech or RegTech

  • You are technically strong and comfortable working with APIs, webhooks, authentication, data flows and modern integration architectures

  • You can quickly understand complex business processes and translate them into clear technical solutions and automation opportunities

  • You are equally comfortable discussing architecture with engineers, redesigning workflows with operations teams, and presenting solutions to senior executives

  • You are excited about AI and already use AI tools extensively in your work. You naturally look for opportunities to automate repetitive work and improve how things are done

  • You thrive in a fast-moving environment with high standards and strong ownership. You can manage several opportunities and implementations in parallel

  • Experience in financial services, compliance or RegTech is a plus, but not required
