jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - AI Technical Lead
jobs.description:
Be yourself at Protolabs 
Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification.  We are an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to building a diverse team that feels they are valued in the workplace.  So do you feel you do not meet every single requirement but still intrigued? We encourage you to still apply!  You can help make our company even better.  We do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender, age, mental or physical ability, or any way you represent yourself.  We strongly believe diversity makes for more successful teams. 

Why Protolabs? 
We are the leaders in digital manufacturing.  We hire doers, makers, and creative thinkers who tackle our roles with an entrepreneurial spirit.  Our culture is centered around meaningful work that brings new and innovative products to market at unprecedented speeds.  We are a diverse team that comes from all walks of life and take pride in our team who is smart, genuine, humble, and passionate about what we do.  It’s our people who fuel our creativity and make our culture feel like home. 

Join our team as a

Senior Machine Learning Engineer - AI Technical Lead!

This is a hybrid role, and we are currently considering candidates based in the Netherlands.
 
Protolabs is a digital manufacturing company that turns CAD files and technical drawings into physical parts  fast and at scale. Our AI team builds systems that empower workflows in digital manufacturing such as finding similar parts, geometry understanding, and automated routing of work to the right expert.
 
We are looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to act as Technical Lead for our horizontal innovation work, the foundational technical building blocks that serve multiple use cases across the value chain.

The work is distinct in that the technology often comes first and the use case follows: this is true innovation, where you prove a capability is possible and then drive it into business value. You will be the single technical point of contact for these initiatives, driving core development of transformative capabilities. You will observe the market, bring new innovations into the organization, and partner across engineering and business teams to turn technology into measurable impact — mentoring and influencing engineers inside and outside your own team without formal authority.

What You Will Do:
Technical leadership & core development
  • Drive core development of transformative capabilities.
  • Take over full technical ownership as the primary technical contact for product management, engineering management, and partner teams on the delivery and roadmap of these initiatives.
  • Create, maintain, and review the technical roadmap together with product and engineering management.
  • Provide architectural guidance for ML systems on inference, agentic approaches and hybrid AI systems; industrialize and maintain proven-value use cases.
    • Technical implementation across a broad range of AI use cases
  • Implement progressive ML solutions for various business domains in agile, crossfunctional teams; rapidly prototype to validate feasibility and value in a scalable manner.
  • Co-develop use cases with domain software teams in temporary cross-functional setups.
    • Market observation & innovation
  • Observe the market and propose new innovations based on technologies emerging outside the company.
  • Evaluate build vs. buy vs. adapt decisions based on cost, effort, risk, and long-term maintainability.
  • Produce written technology-evaluation recommendations (opportunity, feasibility, effort, fit) and find ways to multiply exploration speed by involving other engineers.
  • Identify opportunities where new technology could add business value; hand clear tech ideas to product and business teams to review and validate; identify integration requirements.
    • Cross-organisation delivery & architecture
  • Partner with other engineering teams to deliver business impact through integrating new technologies and new solutions.
  • Draft, share, and align architectural designs for each building block across the organisation, obtaining sign-off from affected teams before integration starts; bring designs to architecture board review.
    • Platform & environment
  • Contribute to foundational environments for (Gen)AI experimentation, model development, evaluation, and deployment.
  • Collaborate with global platform counterparts to implement MLOps, CI/CD, data pipelines, and observability.
  • Advocate for reusable components, shared libraries, and internal tooling to accelerate usecase delivery.
    • Mentoring & influencing
  • Mentor and coach engineers across the organisation — inside and outside your own team— through PR reviews, work scoping, design reviews, and documentation reviews.
  • Proactively surface in-team and cross-team barriers to leadership as they arise, with suggestions on how to resolve them.
  • Identify needs and tech-stack gaps blocking engineers from delivering, and raise them for prioritization.

    • What You Bring:
    Technical
  • 7+ years of hands-on AI/ML engineering experience, with strong depth in machine learning and deep learning — modeling, data pipelines, evaluation, and shipping models to production using state-of-the-art frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow/Keras, scikit-learn, XGBoost).
  • Proven ability to build models that serve as autonomous decision systems — applied to critical business problems with large, heterogeneous data.
  • Strong Python engineering fundamentals: clean, modular, testable code; data pipelines; model versioning; CI/CD for ML; packaging for production (e.g. Docker, service wrappers).
  • Solid ML experimentation practice: experiment tracking set up from scratch (e.g. Weights & Biases, MLflow), model evaluation, and iterative improvement tied to measurable business outcomes.
  • Solid understanding of data transformation techniques, languages, and libraries (e.g. Pandas, Polars, SQL, dbt).
  • Familiarity with modern GenAI — LLMs, transformers, vector stores, retrieval techniques (RAG), embedding strategies, and agentic workflows — and GenAI stacks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, and OpenAI/Azure/AWS SDKs.
  • Cloud-native, building scalable, secure, and compliant production systems.
  • MLOps background: CI/CD, model deployment, monitoring/observability, IaC, and workflow orchestration (e.g. Prefect, Weights & Biases, or equivalents).
  • Familiarity with backend systems principles, including API serving, containerization, distributed compute, security considerations.
    • Leadership & Collaboration
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technically without formal authority: mentoring engineers, design/PR/documentation reviews, and aligning stakeholders across teams.
  • Experience owning architecture end-to-end: drafting, sharing, and driving sign-off of architectural designs across multiple teams.
  • Experience working in Agile environments — contributing to Scrum ceremonies, breaking work into increments, and collaborating closely with product and engineering management in iterative delivery.
  • Ability to lead through ambiguity and early-stage environments; proactive, systematic problem solving.
  • Ability to translate emerging technology into business value — framing opportunities, scoping with product and engineering partners, and identifying integration requirements.
  • Excellent communication skills across global departments: able to align engineers, product/engineering management, and leadership, and to present technical opportunities to both engineering and business audiences.
    • Mindset
  • Builder mentality: pragmatic, resourceful, iterative.
  • Curiosity and willingness to experiment while ensuring quality and security.
  • Critical thinking in uncertain or rapidly evolving contexts

    • Bonus Points If You Have :
  • Experience with AWS managed services. 
  • Experience with manufacturing/industrial ML applications. 
  • Experience with geometric/spatial data: point clouds, meshes, voxel grids, or CAD - derived representations. 
  • Experience with vector databases, scalable retrieval architectures, guard railing LLMs, and prompt engineering. 
  • Experience collaborating in international teams across time zones. 

    • What's In It For You:
  • Part of our incredible journey is clearly down to our amazing team, and we strongly believe in giving people a space to truly, authentically be themselves. We also believe that treating our employees well and sprinkling a great place to work with some nice perks can make work a little sweeter.
  • Annual company bonus. We celebrate success together! Employees are not only rewarded for their achievements but also for contributing to the overall success of the business.
  • Wellness and well-being with access to OpenUp psychologists, practice mindfulness with Headspace and tons more.
  • Doggo-friendly office. We are big pet lovers and fully encourage hanging out with your (and your colleagues’) furry friends in the office
  • Daily Lunch and snacks are provided in the office; it's a moment for our teams to connect and recharge. Shared meals strengthen our bonds and fuel collaboration.
  • We offer learning and development days to be used for training or on volunteering, money to spend on learning courses, events, trainings, Access to our in-house LEARN platform with diverse courses, training, and workshops, In-house 3D Printing and much more!
  • Follow us on Instagram to see what Life at Protolabs is all about!

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Sales UKI
jobs.description:
About Pleo

At Pleo, we believe that finance is the strategic force at the heart of how every business runs. When a finance team leads with its craft, they make better decisions and steer the business with more confidence. In order to do that, the busywork that comes with expense management needs to move out the way.

That’s why we built a spend management platform that streamlines the whole process, from employee spending to approvals and reconciliation. Finance teams get clarity and control of all the numbers and data in one place and employees get an experience that they actually enjoy.

The word “Pleo” in Greek means “more than you’d expect,” and that mindset has driven our growth since 2015 and our 40,000+ customers. Today we’re 750+ people from over 65 nationalities who take pride in understanding customer needs, turning complex problems into simple solutions, challenging the way things are done, and aiming for the highest outcome. We haven’t got everything figured out, but we’re committed to developing and delivering an experience as elevated as the craft of finance.

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Sales Manager to join our commercial team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help drive hyper-growth across the UK/I market, lead and scale our high-performing Mid-Market sales organisation, and be part of our commercial leadership team as we scale our smart company spending platform. If you're excited about leading an entrepreneurial sales engine, empowering reps through coaching and frameworks like MEDDIC, and are passionate about the future of corporate spend management and Fintech, then this is the opportunity for you!

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You’ll report to our Director of Sales and work closely with teams in Sales Development, Revenue Operations, Customer Success, Marketing and Product. Our sales leaders and account executives are highly collaborative and dedicated to expanding our UKI market share and delivering exceptional revenue growth.

What you’ll be doing

As a Senior Sales Manager, you will:

  • Lead and executive the UKI GTM strategy to hit ambitious targets, expanding our reach within our mid-market segment

  • Hire, develop, and mentor high-potential sales professionals across all stages of the sales cycle, from prospecting to complex closes

  • Instill rigour through MEDDIPICC and value-based selling frameworks, while personally stepping into high-stakes deal cycles to help reps close

  • Represent Pleo’s commercial function in the fion, championing our vision, brand, and product across the industry.

  • Partner with Marketing, RevOps, and Product to align pipeline generation, process efficiency, and product feedback loop with market demand

To put things into context, we’re currently scaling our mid-market footprint across UKI and optimising cross-functional GTM alignment on our roadmap. You can expect to work with the following tech stack: HubSpot, Gong, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Claude.

What you bring

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • Proven track record leading sales teams to consistently hit revenue targets in a high-growth SaaS environment

  • Expertise in embedding MEDDPICC, value- based selling, and structured pipeline management across a sales organization

  • Passion for hiring, coaching, and developing talent while maintaining a culture of accountability and healthy competition

  • Hands-on approach with the confidence to jump into complex deal discussions and coach on objection handling or closing strategies

  • Deep knowledge of closing deals with UKI mid-market decision makers in fintech, SaaS, or finance tech.

  • Background in B2B SaaS, fintech, or scaling scale-up commercial organisations

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You thrive on building, coaching, and elevating high-potential sales talent into high performers

  • You love being both strategic and hands-on, willing to hop on high-value calls alongside your reps to close deals

  • You want to be the executive face of a hyper-growth product with an incredible culture

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You prefer hands-off management and delegate all coaching or pipeline reviews

  • You do not use structure frameworks like MEDDPICC to guide sales forecasts and deal execution

  • You prefer a rigid corporate structure over a dynamic, fast-paced scale up environment

How you’ll develop in this role
In your first 6 to 12 months at Pleo, you’ll:

  • Lead the UKI sales organisation to drive hyper-growth in revenue and team headcount

  • Collaborate with RevOps and Marketing to optimise pipeline velocity and deal conversion metrics

  • Grow your leadership trajectory, taking ownership of larger regional strategies as Pleo continues its global scale

Please note: We can hire on a hybrid set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

Show me the benefits

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

  • We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

  • For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

  • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work

The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  2. Hiring Manager Interview: 45 mins interview with the Hiring Manager to go deeper on your experience and how your profile can fit to the role

  3. Pleo Challenge and Panel Interview: We will send you a take home test and invite you to present it during a 60 mins team interview. This is an opportunity to show us how you would handle the day to day of the role

  4. Final Interview: A final interview with a Senior Leader

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired for this role, we received a vast number of applications but only a few were selected for an intro call. With this in mind, we want to help you understand what we really care about when reviewing your application:

  • We receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you—not AI—know from your previous experience. jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
The Challenge 
Much of what Talk360 users see and touch is built with web technology - onboarding, buying credit, Shop360 and calling in the browser - on top of a Ruby on Rails platform. Every change you ship reaches hundreds of thousands of people in more than 190 countries, often on older devices, limited data plans and unreliable networks. For them, a checkout that won’t load isn’t a UX inconvenience. It’s a call home that doesn’t happen. 

Talk360 is profitable, our B2B2C platform is expanding, and we’re building an AI-first engineering team. We’re looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer with frontend as their home base: someone who builds excellent web experiences and is just as willing to go into our Rails backend to make them work end-to-end. 

What You'll Do 

Lead on frontend 

  • Build and improve our web experiences in React: onboarding, buying credit, Shop360 and account features 

  • Help evolve our web dialer and the web side of our embedded calling product, used by partners to bring Talk360 calling into their own platforms 

  • Shape frontend architecture and technical direction, working closely with the Tech Lead and the rest of the team 

  • Bring our design system to the web with consistent, accessible components across all our apps 

  • Own frontend quality: performance on low-end devices and slow networks, releases, monitoring and error tracking 

Work across the stack 

  • Take features end-to-end: build the Rails API and data model your frontend needs, instead of waiting for it 

  • Contribute to our Ruby on Rails platform, the backend behind our mobile apps, web apps and partner integrations 

  • Strengthen automated testing, CI/CD and tooling so we can ship often and with confidence 

  • Raise the level of the team through technical designs, code reviews and sharing what you know 

Learn from customers, build AI-first 

  • Ship features and experiments on the journeys that matter most to our users, from first open to buying credit 

  • Use data, error reports and user feedback to find and fix what hurts users most 

  • Work with Product and Design before implementation to shape solutions, not just execute them 

  • Use AI tooling throughout your workflow to raise quality and speed, and help shape how we work as an AI-first engineering team 

The Team 

You'll be working alongside Isah (Frontend), Oleg (Full Stack), Alex (Backend), Yahaya (VoIP and Data Platform), Igor (iOS and Mobile Lead), David (Android), and Tom (Tech Lead). The wider tech team you'll collaborate with includes Michal & Ali (QA). On the product side, you'll work closely with Quintin and Kseniia (Product) and Cameron (Design). 

Talk360 is a lean company, around 30 people globally, which means you'll interact regularly across functions: ops, support, data, and marketing. That cross-functional visibility is one of the things that makes the work here interesting and your impact visible. 


Tech Stack 

Must have 

  • React and TypeScript in production 

  • Modern HTML and CSS, responsive and mobile-first 

  • Web performance: making apps fast on low-end devices and slow networks 

  • Solid backend experience with Ruby on Rails: API design and relational databases (we use MySQL) 

  • Experience owning production applications end-to-end, from technical design to operations 

  • Experience implementing automated tests (unit, component and end-to-end) and working with CI/CD 

  • Git 

  • Actively using AI throughout your development workflow 

Nice to have 

  • Building or maintaining a design system or component library 

  • WebRTC, VoIP or real-time communication 

  • Payment and checkout flows 

  • Infrastructure experience: AWS (ECS, RDS), Docker, infrastructure as code 

  • Observability and analytics tooling (Sentry, Graylog, Mixpanel or similar) 

Who You Are 

  • You're a generalist with a frontend heart: you care about what users see and touch, and you'd rather own a problem end-to-end than stay in one layer of the stack. 

  • You naturally take ownership without waiting for permission. 

  • You enjoy solving hard technical problems while thinking about the bigger picture. 

  • You care deeply about software craftsmanship and user experience. 

  • You can explain the trade-offs behind your technical choices. 

  • You enjoy partnering with product teams and learning directly from customer feedback. 

  • You share what you know and help others improve and become stronger. 

  • You're pragmatic. You know when perfection matters and when shipping matters more. 

  • You're excited about building software that genuinely changes people's lives. 

  • You're based in or around Amsterdam and able to come to our office two to three times a week.

     

What You Get 

Competitive compensation 

  • 80,000 - 85,000 euros all-in gross annually

Learning and growth 

  • €1,500 annual personal development budget, plus access to company-wide training sessions to keep learning and evolving. 

Time to recharge 

  • 25 vacation days 

  • Option to swap two public holidays per year for days that better reflect your culture or beliefs 

  • Recharge Fridays, unlocked when team targets are met (we'll tell you more during the interview) 

Work from anywhere 

  • As a global and diverse team, we encourage you to work from another city or country for up to 2 weeks per year, gain fresh perspectives and spark new ideas. 

A team you'll actually want to be part of 

  • Weekly team lunch every Thursday 

  • Regular team moments and outings 

  • An international and diverse team, with colleagues from the Netherlands, South Africa, Nigeria, Suriname, Turkey, Egypt, Kenya, Ukraine and beyond 

Set up for success 

  • Company laptop and all the tools you need to do your best work 

  • Monthly phone allowance and commuting allowance 

An environment to grow and make impact 

  • A collaborative environment where you can learn from others, take ownership, and contribute to a meaningful mission. 

About Talk360 

Talk360 has grown into a global communications platform connecting more than 6 million people worldwide. We've successfully spun off our payments business into NjiaPay, stepped into the gap left by Skype, and built a profitable, sustainable business.  We're now expanding beyond our own consumer app through our SDK, enabling partners to integrate Talk360's calling infrastructure directly into their own products. 

Our ambition is simple: To become the world's most trusted way to call any phone number. 

Here's what our users say: 

“I like Talk360 because it saves me a lot of money. I used to call from Zimbabwe for 15 rands a minute. Talk360 came to the rescue. Now I can call my mother for hours.”  - Google Play, South Africa  ★★★★★ 

“Talk360 is a simple and reliable app for cheap international calls. It works even if the receiver has no internet, offers good call quality, and has transparent pricing.”  - Google Play, United States  ★★★★★ 

“It is a flawless experience with no hustles at all and the tariffs are more than just fair.”  - Trustpilot, United Kingdom  ★★★★★

jobs.title: Senior Salesforce Administrator
Growth Manager - Business Expansion (Berlin)
jobs.description:
Our bar is high, and this is the best place for ambitious builders.

Bootstrapped and profitable from day one, Almedia is Germany’s fastest-growing company (FT1000). Join us as we build the global leader in rewards, at a $1bn+ revenue run rate and climbing fast.

At Almedia, you’ll:

  • Own way more, way earlier — you’ll be trusted with responsibility fast.

  • Push harder, get further — this isn’t a 9–5. We highly reward intensity.

  • Join a rare environment — you will work with ambitious high-speed, high-ownership people.

  • Fully present — we’re 5 days a week in the office to build the energising momentum we need.

Growth Manager - Business Expansion (Berlin)

Salary Range: €50k-€65k

At a Glance

You'll win new advertisers and turn their first campaigns into growing, long-term partnerships with Almedia. You'll own the journey from prospecting and closing to campaign launch, optimization, and initial scale-up.

This is a hands-on sales role with clear revenue ownership. Closing the deal is the starting point: you'll learn Almedia’s products in depth, understand what drives campaign performance, and help advertisers build the confidence to commit larger budgets.

 

What You’ll Do 🎯

  • Win new business. Identify and engage advertisers, and publishers. Build your pipeline through targeted outreach, referrals, industry events, and your network.

  • Own the full sales cycle. Lead discovery, pitches, proposals, negotiations, and closing. Understand each advertiser’s goals, buying process, and performance expectations.

  • Learn the product deeply. Build a working understanding of Almedia’s platform, campaign setup, targeting, reward structures, reporting, and optimization tools. Use that knowledge to propose campaigns that can deliver.

  • Own the first campaigns. Coordinate setup and launch with advertisers and internal teams. Agree on test budgets, performance targets, measurement, and clear criteria for scaling.

  • Optimize and scale. Monitor early campaign performance, identify what limits delivery or returns, and take action. Use Almedia’s internal tools to adjust campaign settings and ROAS targets, working with Growth and algorithm teams to improve results.

  • Turn results into larger budgets. Translate campaign data into clear recommendations. Secure budget increases, expand into new geographies or operating systems, and move successful tests into sustained spending.

  • Solve problems early. Spot underdelivery, attribution discrepancies, or performance issues before they damage advertiser confidence. Coordinate resolution and keep the advertiser informed.

  • Deliver revenue targets. Take responsibility for new advertiser acquisition and the revenue generated as their initial campaigns scale. Prioritize opportunities with meaningful commercial potential.

  • Keep a reliable forecast. Maintain an accurate pipeline and a clear view of launch readiness, campaign progress, and expected budget growth.

What Your First 90 Days Look Like

  • Days 1–30: Learn Almedia’s products, sales process, and campaign optimization fundamentals. Shadow sales and campaign reviews, build your target-account list, and begin outreach.

  • Days 31–60: Own discovery calls, pitches, and proposals. Build a qualified pipeline and work alongside experienced Growth Managers on campaign setup, performance analysis, and optimization decisions.

  • Days 61–90: Close your first advertiser partnerships and own their initial campaign launches. Identify performance improvements, make optimization recommendations, and secure budget increases where results support scaling.

  • Beyond 90 days: Build a repeatable record of winning advertisers and growing their spend. Take on larger opportunities and contribute to Almedia’s commercial growth.

What You’ll Bring 💡

  • A record of winning business. You've acquired customers, negotiated agreements, and delivered measurable revenue results in sales, business development, or a commercially focused growth role.

  • The drive to create opportunities. You're comfortable opening doors, reaching decision-makers, and building a pipeline through your own initiative.

  • A consultative sales approach. You ask sharp questions, understand advertiser priorities, and connect your proposal to a clear business outcome.

  • Campaign optimization skills. You can read performance data, diagnose why a campaign is underperforming, and propose changes to improve delivery and returns. You're comfortable forming a hypothesis, running a test, and deciding whether to scale.

  • The ability to learn a technical product. You want to understand how Almedia works in practice. You can learn its tools and explain campaign mechanics clearly to advertisers.

  • Confidence with performance metrics. You understand ROAS, LTV, retention, ARPU, and cohort performance—and how they influence optimization decisions and advertiser budgets.

  • Commercial judgment. You know how to balance an advertiser’s performance goals with a sustainable commercial outcome for Almedia.

  • Ownership and discipline. You follow through, keep your forecast honest, and take responsibility for both closing deals and helping initial campaigns succeed.

     

Bonus Points If You

  • You speak Russian or Turkish on a native level, have ideally worked in this market before and understand the market specifics.

  • Have sold performance marketing, mobile advertising, adtech, or user acquisition solutions.

  • Have hands-on experience optimizing mobile gaming, app, or rewarded user acquisition campaigns.

  • Have relationships with studios, app publishers, agencies, or advertisers expanding internationally.

  • Have turned small campaign tests into significant, sustained advertiser spending.

 

What Makes You a Great Fit 🌟

  • Own Everything: Get It Done. You stay involved from the first conversation through launch and initial scale-up. You bring the right people together and keep progress moving.

  • Take Initiative: Be Proactive. You find promising advertisers and spot opportunities to improve their campaigns before they ask.

  • Move Fast: Start Simple, Iterate Quickly. You launch focused tests, respect the time needed to evaluate results, and make timely decisions based on what you learn.

  • Focus on Impact: Deliver What Matters Most. You prioritize advertisers and campaign improvements with the greatest potential to generate sustainable revenue.

  • Raise the Bar: Have High Standards. You make credible commitments, understand the product you sell, and use each campaign to improve the next one.

 

We believe in fostering talent, evaluating all skill levels during the hiring process, and providing a clear path for growth. Almedia is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity, and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

Compensation: €50K – €65K

  • • €50K – €65K

jobs.description:
💡 We're looking for a Product Operations Specialist to join our Product Operations team - the team that makes sure the regulatory intelligence our customers depend on is complete, current and correct.

Medical device manufacturers use Flinn to stay on top of every standard, guidance and regulation they're legally required to follow. When an auditor asks them to prove they caught a change, our data is the evidence. Product Operations is what stands behind that promise: we curate and verify the regulatory data at the core of the product, set up and quality-assure every new customer account, and turn what we learn into better automation.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role in a fast-moving environment. You'll work across Customer Success, Product and Engineering, and you'll have real influence on the roadmap - the improvements our team surfaces are a major driver of what gets built. It's a strong fit if you're precise by nature, energised by making messy processes work properly, and genuinely interested in using AI and automation to replace manual effort rather than accept it.

Why Flinn?

  • We are building a truly exceptional culture: While many companies claim to have a great culture, we invite you to discover what truly sets ours apart. Visit our career page, speak with our team, listen to our founders’ podcast, or experience our culture first-hand during the interview process.

  • Make a Meaningful Impact: Your work at Flinn contributes directly to solutions that improve people’s health and lives by making high-quality health products accessible for everyone.

  • Experienced, well-funded, highly professional: As well-funded startup veterans, we know how to sustain long-term business health and success, ensuring an environment for continuous personal growth.

What’s in it for you?

  • Join a fast-growing, well-funded European startup backed by experienced founders and investors.

  • Be part of a mission-driven health-tech company whose work directly improves people’s lives.

  • Take end-to-end ownership of core operational processes that keep the company running.

  • Play a key role in scaling Flinn, shaping how operations work as we grow.

  • Work in a high-trust, low-ego environment with autonomy and clear ownership.

  • Enjoy flexible working hours, remote flexibility, and regular team time in Vienna.

  • Work in a net-zero company where all unavoidable CO₂ emissions are compensated with carefully selected, high-quality removal certificates.

  • Receive one of the most employee-friendly equity packages, including fair vesting terms and profit-sharing opportunities.

  • Grow in a professional, high-standard environment that supports long-term personal and career development.

Your Contributions to Our Journey:

  • Take ownership of the quality and completeness of the regulatory data at the heart of our product - the foundation our customers' compliance and audit readiness rests on

  • Own the recurring monitoring and verification cycles that keep our regulatory coverage current, and be accountable for getting them done accurately and on time

  • Set up and maintain customer configurations end to end, and run the final quality gate before a customer goes live

  • Act as the connective tissue between Customer Success, Product and Engineering - surfacing issues early, translating operational reality into clear requirements, and escalating with evidence

  • Identify what's slow, manual or error-prone in how we work, and drive it toward automation together with Product and Engineering

  • Document and improve the processes and knowledge base the team runs on, so quality doesn't depend on who happens to be doing the work

What You Need to Be Successful:

Must-Have

  • 2+ years in operations, data operations, quality, project coordination, regulatory affairs or a comparable role. You're at home working through large volumes of structured information, cross-checking records against their original sources until they're right

  • Exceptional attention to detail combined with real pace. You work precisely without getting lost in the detail

  • Proactive communication with internal stakeholders - you keep Product, Engineering and Customer Success in the loop and flag blockers early instead of absorbing them

  • Strong prioritisation and organisational skills, and an agile mindset: priorities here shift, and you re-plan calmly and communicate clearly when they do

  • A drive to improve and automate - you've made a process better rather than just followed one, and you're genuinely interested in using AI and automation to eliminate manual work

Strong Plus

  • Interest in or familiarity with regulatory data and standards - in MedTech, pharma or another regulated industry, or through a life-science, regulatory affairs or quality management background

Senior Financial Analyst, FP&A
jobs.description:
Why Coda
Coda is a global growth engine for commerce, connecting people, digital products, and payments through trusted monetization and distribution solutions.

With 600+ people from 57 nationalities across 23 locations, we’re a truly global team headquartered in Singapore, with offices in Amsterdam, Dubai, Bristol, Shanghai, Eindhoven, and across Southeast Asia.

We power global commerce through a dual model. Our B2B solutions, Codapay, Coda Webstore, Coda Links, Coda Distribution, and Giftcloud, enable publishers and brands to monetize and distribute digital content globally. On the consumer side, we operate a portfolio of trusted storefronts including  Codashop, Recharge.com, Startselect.com, and mobiletopup.co.uk, that give customers secure and easy access to game top-ups, digital credits, vouchers, gift cards and prepaid products in over 70 markets.

Our culture is built on respect, ownership, and collaboration. We move fast, support each other, and celebrate wins together.

If you’re looking to grow your career and make a real impact in a global team, Coda is the place for you. 


The Opportunity
As Senior Financial Analyst at Coda, you'll play a key role in shaping how we plan, forecast, and steer our financial performance. You'll coordinate our budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning cycles, bringing together our B2B and B2C businesses into one clear financial outlook. You'll also take ownership of our planning and reporting processes in Aleph and manage the group's non-personnel fixed operating expenses.

Reporting to the Director of FP&A, this is a hands-on role with high visibility and real impact. Your work will directly inform decisions made by our CFO, executive team, and Board, giving you the opportunity to influence how Coda plans for the future.


What You'll Do
  • Planning: Own the annual budget, regular forecasts and long-term financial planning process across the Group.
  • Consolidation: Integrate B2B and B2C forecasts into a comprehensive Group P&L, balance sheet and cash flow outlook.
  • Quality: Own key financial assumptions, challenge business drivers and ensure consistency, accuracy and reliability across forecasts.
  • Strategic Insights: Develop financial scenarios, sensitivity analyses and product profitability insights to support executive decision-making.
  • Ownership: Lead the development of our financial planning platform, streamlining forecasting, consolidations and reporting into one efficient process.
  • Automation and AI: Identify and implement smarter ways of working to improve efficiency, accuracy and scalability across FP&A.
  • Budgeting: Own the budget for non-personnel operating expenses, set cost centre targets and oversee approvals for unbudgeted spending.
  • Reporting: Prepare and review high-quality financial analyses, Board materials, investor updates and lender reporting, including covenant calculations.
  • Partner: Work closely with the Director FP&A and step in to lead planning and reporting cycles when required.
  • Collaboration: Partner with Accounting, Treasury and Business Control teams across Amsterdam, Singapore and Jakarta to drive alignment and financial performance.

    • What You'll Bring
  • FP&A expertise: 6-8 years of experience in FP&A, corporate finance or a related field, including at least 3 years leading budgeting and forecasting cycles.
  • Planning & consolidation: Proven experience managing and consolidating forecasts across multiple entities, markets or business units.
  • Financial modelling: Strong three-statement modelling skills and a solid understanding of cash flow and working capital.
  • Systems & analytical skills: Advanced Excel or Google Sheets proficiency and hands-on experience with planning tools such as Aleph, Anaplan, Adaptive, Pigment or similar.
  • Stakeholder management: Confidence to collaborate with, influence and constructively challenge senior stakeholders across finance and the wider business.
  • Communication & education: Excellent written and verbal English communication skills and a degree in finance, economics, econometrics or a related field.
  • Business environment: Experience in a high-growth, international or investor-backed organisation is a strong advantage.
  • Strategic finance exposure: Familiarity with Board, investor or lender reporting, including financial covenants. A background in Big 4, transaction services or investment banking is a plus.
  • Process improvement & innovation: A track record of building scalable finance processes, implementing or improving planning systems, or leveraging AI tools to drive efficiency is highly valued.
  • Mindset & ownership: Structured, pragmatic and proactive, with a strong sense of ownership, the ability to deliver under pressure and confidence working across international teams and time zones.

If you don't hear from us, rest assured there may be another opportunity at Coda that aligns better with your unique abilities. Remember to check our Careers Page for more exciting job openings!

jobs.title: Senior Finance & Controlling Officer (gn) - Focus Africa
jobs.description:
About The Position:

As Senior Finance & Controlling Officer, you will play a pivotal role in strengthening financial management across FZS's conservation programs in Africa. Working closely with local project teams, the Africa Department and headquarters, you will help develop effective financial structures, strengthen governance and establish sustainable processes that support the successful delivery of conservation objectives.
 
Through collaboration, capacity building and the promotion of best practices, you will contribute to the continuous development of finance functions across the organization. Alongside this strategic focus, you will remain actively involved in selected controlling, accounting and reporting activities, providing hands-on support to project and program teams. Regular travel to African project countries is an integral part of your job.
  
The position is part of the Finance Department at our headquarters in Frankfurt. After an initial onboarding period of approximately one year there, you will be permanently based at our office in Lusaka, Zambia, while staying closely connected to line management and processes in Frankfurt.


Your Tasks:

  • You analyze, optimize and harmonize finance, accounting, controlling and reporting processes across FZS's African project locations. 
  • You develop and implement practical standards, procedures, internal controls and best practices, while supporting continuous improvement and digitalization initiatives. 
  • You advise and support project managers and local finance teams on financial management, budget monitoring and reporting requirements. 
  • You review financial data and accounting records, coordinate international accounting processes and serve as a key contact for the ABACUS accounting system.

Zable was founded on the belief that smarter technology is the solution to lower cost, more transparent consumer finance. Our proprietary foundation models analyse thousands of data points in seconds, drawing a more complete picture of individual financial behaviour. This means we can make better risk decisions, widening access and lowering prices.

The Zable credit card harnesses this technology to deliver better borrowing for three million people. Through our superapp, Zable connects this card to a single platform which makes it effortless to manage credit, get a loan, refinance existing borrowing, switch utilities, get a mobile plan and save more.

Zable is now the number one issuer of new credit cards and personal loans in the UK, but we’ve barely got started. Next, we’re taking our approach to some of the biggest markets in the world - the US and Mexico - where hundreds of millions of people are underserved by outdated bank processes.

  • Work in small teams of exceptional people - who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo

  • Build the best technology in-house - using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

 

About the role

Engineering Managers at Zable are a unique group of amazing humans that combine strategic insight, hands-on technical leadership, and strong people management to shape and evolve our engineering teams. They operate at the convergence of business goals, technical execution, and team coaching, ensuring that every project and process aligns seamlessly with our mission and values. They build a resilient foundation for sustained success by focusing on team growth and technical innovation.

We’re looking for an experienced Engineering Manager to lead one of the teams delivering our Zable App, used by over 1 million customers on iOS and Android. In this role, you’ll act as both a visionary and a hands-on leader, driving the team’s delivery efficiency, technical excellence, and cross-functional collaboration. You’ll own and refine the delivery process, balancing feature development with technical investments and maintaining high team development standards. With a proactive approach, you’ll guide the team to meet our business goals while nurturing a collaborative and growth-oriented culture.

There’s much to accomplish as an Engineering Manager at Zable. You’ll help create a high-performing, resilient team that achieves today’s objectives while building a foundation for long-term success. From enhancing delivery quality to developing a robust, valuable platform, your work will ensure we deliver impactful solutions that meet the needs of our customers and stakeholders alike.

Our Tech Stack

The backend of our Zable app is Kotlin, AWS & GraphQL and the frontend is React Native with TypeScript, and NextJS. Across the rest of Zable we also use PHP 8, Symfony, MySQL, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, Docker, Kubernetes, React, ArgoCD, Behat, PHPUnit, Jest, and Maestro.

About myTomorrows 

myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options.   

We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem.   

We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection.   

With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business.  

Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. 

The Opportunity: Senior Engineering Manager

As an Engineering Manager at myTomorrows, you will lead Backend, Frontend, Full Stack and QA engineers building the platforms that help patients find their treatment options.

Our Expanded Access Program (EAP) platform and Clinical Trials (CT) platform connect patients and healthcare professionals with treatments in development and give our BioPharma Partners the tools to run their programs and trials. You’ll shape how these platforms grow, building a high-performing team that ships well-designed, scalable, secure and compliant software, and delivers it on time.

You won’t do it alone. You’ll partner closely with Product, Design, EAP and CT Operations, and our Platform colleagues in DevOps, Security and Data. Together, you’ll turn ambitious company goals into product outcomes that make a real difference in patients’ lives.

Given that most of our team is located in the Netherlands, we only consider candidates for this position who live within commuting distance of our office in Amsterdam.

What you’ll do in this role:

  • Lead, mentor and manage a team of Backend, Frontend, Full Stack and QA engineers. Foster a collaborative, inclusive and high-performing culture.

  • Own engineering delivery for your areas of the EAP and CT platforms, from discovery through to release and operation in production.

  • Partner with Product Managers and Designers to shape the roadmap, refine priorities, and plan and execute features and improvements.

  • Provide technical leadership in architecture and design, ensuring solutions are robust, maintainable, scalable and secure. Work with engineers on decisions about tools, frameworks and approaches.

  • Champion engineering best practices: proactive exploration AI-enabled and agentic development, code quality, testing, code review, API design, observability, documentation and secure development.

  • Ensure quality and compliance requirements are built into how the team works. This includes data privacy and the regulatory context of healthcare.

  • Build a culture of ownership, experimentation and continuous improvement, including healthy team rituals and retrospectives.

  • Partner with Recruitment to attract, hire and onboard top talent.

What you bring to the table:

  • A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 6+ years of experience in software engineering, with a solid background in backend, frontend or full stack development.

  • 5+ years of experience leading or managing engineering teams.

  • A proven track record of delivering high-quality web products and developing engineers.

  • Hands-on familiarity with modern backend and frontend technologies. Experience with Python and Angular is a plus.

  • A strong understanding of Agile ways of working, product development and engineering best practices.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally and influence stakeholders at all levels.

  • A passion for working in a mission-driven organisation focused on improving patient outcomes.

  • Experience in a regulated domain such as healthcare or life sciences or in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, is a plus.

What success looks like in the first 6 months:

  • You’ve built trust within your team and with Product, Design and Operations, and established clear ownership across your areas of the EAP and CT platforms.

  • Delivery is predictable and transparent. The team ships valuable increments regularly, with a clear link to product goals.

  • Code quality, test coverage and release reliability are visibly improving.

  • Every team member has clear expectations and a development plan, and you’ve addressed any key gaps in team composition.

  • The team works with autonomy and accountability, and collaborates well with Platform and other engineering teams.

  • You’ve identified and started executing key technical or organisational improvements that enhance scalability and team effectiveness.

  • You’re seen as a trusted technical and people leader, balancing strategic direction with hands-on support where needed.

Our current tech stack:

  • We are fully cloud-native on AWS. We follow a lean, API-first product development approach.

  • Our platform services, both microservices and AI, are built in Python.

  • Our frontends are built with Angular.

  • We use GitHub Actions for CI/CD to EKS and Terraform for IaC, with staging/production parity, continuous deployment and Grafana for observability.

  • Security is built in through managed secrets, SSO, dependency scanning, end-to-end encryption and periodic pen-tests.

Equal opportunities

myTomorrows is an Equal Opportunity Employer and, beyond upholding discrimination-free practices, we are committed to cultivating a workplace where difference and diversity are protected and celebrated. The best work comes from our best selves, and we go to great lengths in supporting our team members to be just that.

jobs.title: AI & Data Engineer
jobs.description:
AI & Data Engineer

Remote (UK-based) | Full-Time

About Us

Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year (Risk.net). Our network handles over $75 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 60+ of the world's leading liquidity providers.

We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what's technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems.

The Role

We're looking for a polyglot engineer who is comfortable across the data stack. This is someone who can build AI-powered tools and data infrastructure that make our platform smarter, our people more effective, and our operations more scalable.

This is not a research role. You'll build real systems that people use every day — Slack bots that investigate production incidents, data pipelines that surface anomalies before clients notice them, and AI agents that turn hours of manual trawling into seconds of guided investigation. You'll work across the full stack: Python and TypeScript for AI tooling and integrations, Go for backend services, and SQL for data analysis and pipeline work.

The person we're looking for ships working software, cares about making people's lives easier, and is energised by the pace of the AI landscape. You don't need to have built LLM applications before — but you should be curious, practical, and comfortable learning fast.

You'll work closely with our TechOps, Connectivity, and Data teams to understand their workflows, pain points, and knowledge gaps — then build the tools and infrastructure that solve them. This is a high-leverage role: the systems you build will multiply the effectiveness of every engineer and operator in the company.

What You'll Work On

  • AI-powered investigation tools — Slack-based bots and agents that automatically analyse support tickets, query production logs, and surface relevant context for incident response

  • MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers — authenticated access to ClickHouse, Kubernetes, Atlassian, and GitHub, enabling AI agents to interact with real systems safely

  • Data infrastructure — ClickHouse analytics pipelines, real-time anomaly detection, and platform health monitoring (our "Radar" initiative)

  • AI agent development — constrained, repeatable diagnosis agents that follow investigation playbooks, produce structured outputs, and operate with appropriate guardrails

  • Knowledge engineering — building and curating the corpus that makes our AI tools accurate: documentation, training material, structured metadata, and feedback loops

  • Internal tooling — full-stack applications that bridge the gap between data, AI, and the people who need answers

What We Need

Technical:

  • Strong Python — your primary language for AI tooling, data pipelines, and backend services

  • Systems design – you have extensive experience building data-intensive systems. You can consider tradeoffs and manage system complexity

  • TypeScript / JavaScript — for Slack integrations, web interfaces, and full-stack tooling

  • Go experience is a bonus — we use Go extensively for backend services and CLI tooling

  • SQL — comfortable writing analytical queries against large datasets (ClickHouse, PostgreSQL, or similar)

  • Familiarity with LLM APIs and tooling — Claude, OpenAI, or similar; prompt engineering, function calling, tool use

  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS — your tools will run in production infrastructure

  • Git and Linux fundamentals

  • Experience in financial services is a plus but not essential — domain knowledge can be learned; engineering instinct cannot

How you work:

  • You ship. You're delivery-focused — you iterate quickly, you get things in front of users, you improve based on feedback

  • You bridge domains. You're comfortable moving between AI, data, infrastructure, and product. You don't wait for someone else to define the interface — you go and understand the problem yourself

  • You own it. When you build something, you take responsibility for its behaviour in production. You monitor it, you fix it, you make it better

  • You write things down. Documentation is how we scale knowledge across a distributed team. Good documentation also makes our AI tools better — every well-written page becomes training material

  • You communicate. We're a distributed team across multiple time zones. Clear, proactive communication is essential

  • You embrace AI as a tool. You use AI to amplify your own productivity — and you build tools that do the same for others

What You Get

  • Growth — this role sits at the intersection of AI, data, and platform engineering. As the company scales, so does the opportunity. This is a new pod with an exciting remit

  • Remote-friendly — work from home with flexibility. We trust our people to deliver

  • Greenfield AI work — you're not maintaining legacy systems; you're building the next generation of intelligent tooling for a trading platform

  • Real impact — the tools you build will be used daily by engineers, operators, and eventually clients. This is not a side project

  • An excellent team — senior engineers who care about craft, collaborate openly, and hold each other to high standards

  • Ownership — small teams, clear accountability, direct impact on the platform and our people

  • Competitive package — up to 30 days leave + bank holidays, private health insurance, pension, life insurance, dental/optical cashback, cycle to work, socials and offsites

  • Sustainable pace — we work hard, but we don't burn people out. Balance is how we stay sharp

We believe in transparency, honest feedback, and writing things down. We celebrate delivery, not activity. We frame AI as empowering people — removing toil, amplifying capability, enabling higher-value work.

Our Hiring Process

We keep our process focused and respectful of your time. Our process follows three stages.

Stage 1: Initial Conversation with Talent Acquisition
Format: Video call, ~30-45 minutes

Stage 2: Technical Interview with a member of the relevant engineering team
Format: Video call, interactive session. ~60 minutes

Stage 3: Leadership Conversation with our CTO
Format: Video call, ~60 minutes

What to expect in each stage will be explained by Talent Acquisition if you're invited to interview. Throughout the process, we aim to keep momentum with no unnecessary delays between stages, and feedback typically comes within a few business days.

How to Apply

Please apply directly via this job posting — all applications, including those submitted via LinkedIn, are managed through our applicant tracking system, so you'll always land in the same place regardless of where you found this role.

Right to Work: Candidates must have the existing right to work in the UK. We are not currently able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Equal Opportunities: Reactive Markets is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

Reasonable Adjustments: If you need any adjustments or support during the application or interview process, please let us know — we're happy to accommodate.

Data Protection: By applying, you consent to Reactive Markets processing your personal data for recruitment purposes, in line with our privacy policy.

jobs.title: Client Delivery Lead
jobs.description:
About Kernel

Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?

Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.

Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.

Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent KERN ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Checkout already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them.

We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 10x YoY.

⚠️ This role may not be for you if you:

jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Engineer
jobs.description:
About Dotfile

Dotfile is building the AI-native Compliance Operating System for financial institutions. Our mission is to make compliance simple, safe and smart, helping financial institutions onboard customers, manage risk and operate globally.

Compliance remains one of the most manual functions in financial services. While most institutions still rely on fragmented tools and human-driven workflows, we believe AI is enabling a fundamental shift toward autonomous compliance. Our ambition is to build Level 5 Compliance: software that can gather evidence, investigate complex situations, assess risk and execute defensible decisions under defined policies.

Dotfile has grown into one of Europe’s fastest-growing compliance technology companies. Today, 100+ financial institutions across 15 countries rely on Dotfile for critical compliance operations, with a rapidly growing presence in the US.

We recently raised our Series A from leading US and European investors and software operators. We’re now entering our next chapter: investing heavily in product and AI, expanding internationally, and building the team that can make Dotfile the global standard for compliance infrastructure.

About the role

You’ll join an AI-native engineering team where AI is central to how we design, build and ship software. We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer who understands software deeply, uses AI to build better software faster, and wants to help improve how the whole team works.

You will own projects from understanding the customer problem to shipping a solution and improving it in production. Working closely with engineering and product, you will help decide what we build, how we build it, and where to invest as the platform grows.

This is a hands-on role with broad ownership. Your focus will reflect your strengths and the team’s priorities, whether that means building product experiences, developing backend services, or solving challenges across the platform. We value engineers who bring depth in their area and curiosity beyond it.

What you’ll do

  • Own projects from discovery and technical design through implementation, testing, deployment and follow-up.

  • Work closely with product and other engineers to understand customer needs, challenge assumptions and turn complex requirements into clear, usable software.

  • Build and improve the interfaces, APIs and services that financial institutions rely on for their compliance operations.

  • Make pragmatic technical decisions, balancing delivery speed with reliability, security and maintainability.

  • Investigate production issues and improve performance, observability and resilience as the platform grows.

  • Raise the engineering bar through knowledge sharing and improvements to how we develop and ship software.

  • Contribute to the evolution of our platform as we build more AI-powered compliance capabilities.

About you

  • You have 5+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of delivering and maintaining software in production.

  • You understand software in depth. You bring strong fundamentals and depth in backend or full-stack development. You can reason about data, concurrency, performance and failure modes, and investigate unfamiliar systems beyond the surface.

  • AI coding agents are central to how you work. You use tools such as Codex or Claude Code extensively to explore, build, test and review software. You keep experimenting with ways to make yourself more effective.

  • You bring the judgment that makes AI-assisted development work. You frame problems clearly, provide useful context, challenge assumptions and verify the resulting behavior. You can explain why a solution works and take responsibility for what you ship.

  • You take ownership. You can turn an ambiguous problem into a practical plan, follow through on delivery and improve the result in production. You are comfortable learning new technologies and working beyond your usual area when a problem calls for it.

  • You care about the product as much as the implementation. You want to understand who you are building for, challenge requirements when needed and assess whether your work solves the original problem.

  • You value simple, well-designed solutions. You know when to move quickly and when reliability, security or long-term maintenance require more care.

  • You communicate clearly in English and enjoy collaborating. You explain your technical choices, welcome constructive disagreement and share what you learn with your teammates.

  • You want to help shape an AI-native engineering team. You enjoy improving how software gets built, from reusable agent workflows to better testing and feedback loops, and turning your own discoveries into practices that make the whole team more effective.

Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech or compliance is a plus.

Our technology

Our main language is TypeScript. Our stack includes:

  • Frontend: React, Apollo GraphQL and Storybook.

  • Backend: Node.js, NestJS, GraphQL and PostgreSQL.

  • Infrastructure: AWS and Kubernetes.

  • Development and testing: Nx, GitLab CI, Playwright.

You do not need experience with every part of our stack. We care about your engineering judgment, your ability to learn and the quality of the software you build.

Why join us

  • Join a company with traction and room to shape its future. With 100+ financial institutions using Dotfile and a recent Series A, you’ll help define the next stage of the product and engineering team.

  • Help shape how an AI-native team works. Experiment with new approaches, improve your own workflow and turn what you learn into practices that make the whole team more effective.

  • Put your engineering depth to work. Solve demanding problems in automation, AI, data and reliability, building software that financial institutions depend on every day.

  • Have a direct say in what you build. Influence technical decisions, own projects through to production, and see how your work changes the customer experience.


Our hiring process

  1. CTO conversation — 30-60 minutes : Discuss your background, explore the role and how our engineering team works, and answer technical questions to assess your engineering knowledge and problem-solving approach.

  2. Case study — 60 minutes : Design the architecture of a project we provide, or present the architecture of a past project you led. Walk us through your reasoning, technical decisions and trade-offs.

  3. Raise the bar — 30 minutes: Meet someone from Product or Solutions Consulting to discuss how you collaborate across teams, understand customer needs and approach problems together.

  4. Founder discussion — 15-30 minutes: Meet our CEO to discuss Dotfile’s ambition, what motivates you and the contribution you could make.

jobs.title: Clinical Lead, Women's Health
jobs.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

💜 The role

Women's bodies are different, yet medicine still treats them the same. Women get diagnosed about 4 years later than men on average across 700+ types of disease. In France, 51% of women say a health professional has played down their symptoms at least once.

We want to change that. We are building the health system women never had: one that listens to women, anticipates their needs at every stage of life instead of waiting for problems to appear, and gives them care they can trust. To do this, we combine the latest evidence, digital tools, AI and carefully selected health professionals with our strength as an insurer.

We are looking for a doctor who wants to do medicine differently: to build products that thousands of women use and that address their needs; to move care towards prevention; and to work every day with people who think differently, such as product managers, designers, engineers and marketers.

As our Clinical Lead for Women's Health, you make this clinically credible and effective. You own the clinical choices, and you are an essential and active contributor in the product team.

A few things to know before you apply

  • This is a clinical role inside a product team, at an early stage. You own the clinical choices and you build the product with project builder, engineers, designers, ... A good product combines many factors, and the clinical side is one of them. There is a lot to build, to test and to change, and not everything is proven yet. For example, we measure how much our services are used much better than the health outcomes they achieve: building that measurement, honestly, is part of the job.

  • You work outside the usual medical world. Most of your colleagues are not health professionals. You will confront perspectives, explain clinical constraints in simple words, listen to product and business constraints, and find solutions together. Decisions are discussed and made as a team.

  • It takes real time. We prefer 80% or more; at least 60% is possible.

What you will do

You will be the clinical lead of our Women's Health offer, and you will help turn it into a product that women use and trust.

  • Build the product with the team. Work closely with product managers, designers and engineers, and bring the clinical view early, when it shapes decisions, not at the end. With AI tools, you can also build simple things yourself, without knowing how to code.

  • Own the clinical choices. Define our clinical positions based on evidence, design protocols and care pathways, and hold a few clear, explained red lines. When something doesn't work, you help find a safe and relevant alternative.

  • Make our AI safe and accurate on women's health. Work with the product team on how Mo, our AI-powered health companion, handles women's health topics, and help evaluate and improve it.

  • Show the value for women. Help define how we measure the impact on women's health, using evidence-based tools and value-based healthcare principles.

  • Work with our Clinic team. Work hand in hand with Alan's doctors, midwives and other health professionals: help train and support them, and be the person they turn to for difficult cases.

  • Feed and endorse our medical communication. Make sure what we say about women's health is accurate and evidence-based, and help explain it in simple words. Over time, you may represent Alan on these topics.

What success looks like in 6 months

  • Product: you are a core member of the product team, and the first member journeys reflect your clinical input from the start.

  • Protocols in use: the clinical protocols and care pathways of our first women's health program are validated and applied by the Clinic team.

  • Clinic team: midwives and doctors on the program are trained on the protocols, clinical staffing is under way, and you supervise complex cases.

  • Health outcomes: the program's health outcomes are defined and tracked.

  • AI quality: you have helped us make sure our AI handles women's health safely and accurately.

What this role is not

  • Not a medical advisor or reviewer who comes in at the end, nor the person who decides alone.

  • Not the person who runs all the consultations: our midwives and doctors do that, and you design, pilot and supervise.

  • Not an expert on every topic: you bring in other health professionals when needed.

A dynamic, international community of health professionals

You don't work alone. You join Alan's health professionals community: a large network of doctors, midwives, psychologists and other clinicians in France, Spain, Belgium and Canada, and a small core team of Alaners, other clinical leads working on different health programs or services. It is a community with high standards, direct and caring feedback, and a lot of room to shape things.

Beyond Women's Health, you will:

  • Share your practice and learn from others through case reviews and community sessions;

  • Help set common standards across programs;

  • Help welcome, train and mentor new health professionals joining Alan;

  • Help other teams at Alan understand key health concepts, such as evidence-based care;

  • Over time, contribute to other health topics beyond Women's Health.

👀 Is it you we're looking for?

Must-haves

  • You are a gynecologist (OB-GYN) or a GP with solid training in women's health, for example a university diploma (DU or DIU) in gynecology, or several years of regular gynecological follow-up in your practice. You can come from private practice, a hospital, a clinic or a health tech company.

  • At least 5 years of post-residency experience, with solid clinical judgment and evidence-based prescribing.

  • Clinical experience across several areas of women's health, for example contraception, fertility, endometriosis, menopause or hormone treatments.

  • An open, pragmatic mindset: you enjoy working with non-medical teams, you make trade-offs when they are legitimate while defending evidence-based rigor, and you are curious about what AI and digital tools change in medicine.

  • Outcomes thinking: you care about the results that matter to patients compared with what care costs (value-based healthcare), and about prevention, not only treatment.

  • A great understanding of the French healthcare system.

  • Fluency in both French and English.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience training or supervising other health professionals is a plus, and a collaborative approach with midwives, dietitians, therapists, …

  • Experience in digital health, a start-up, a healthcare project or teleconsultation.

  • Experience writing or contributing to a clinical protocol or guideline.

🤝 How we work

  • Contract: you join Alan as an employee, ideally at 80% or more, and at least 60%. You can keep some clinical practice outside Alan.

  • Team: you are part of the Women's Health product team and of Alan's health professionals community.

  • Location: our headquarters are in Paris. You can be based abroad, as long as you speak French fluently and know the French healthcare system well.

  • Remote work: we offer remote work flexibility, but we value in-person collaboration.

🔄 What to expect from our recruitment process

  1. Application Review: we read your CV and application.

  2. Screening interview (45 to 60 minutes): your path, your motivation for this role, and practical points such as your availability.

  3. Technical interview: a short written case at home (60 to 90 minutes), including a situation where clinical and product needs conflict, then a live discussion of your answers.

  4. Alaner Fit interview: a conversation about how we work at Alan and whether it suits you.

  5. Alan Day: an on-site day where you prepare concrete use cases, present them to a panel and meet the people you would work with.

  6. Reference calls, including at least one with a non-medical colleague you have worked with.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

💡 You want to know more about Alan?

  • Perks & Benefits: Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

  • A strong culture: People joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work.

  • Check out our About Alan and Career pages for more info.
