jobs.description:
ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE :

École du ministère en charge de l'industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines- Télécom, 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. À l'avant-garde des enjeux industriels et académiques sur la scène internationale, elle agit comme un moteur scientifique et économique territorial en combinant ses 4 missions - former des ingénieurs en intégrant la dynamique du développement durable, faire de la recherche scientifique, contribuer au développement économique et diffuser la culture des sciences, des techniques et de l'innovation - en un cercle vertueux et porteur d'innovation.

Son positionnement en matière de formation et de recherche la place IMT Mines Albi comme école de référence sur trois des quatre thématiques de l’IMT, à savoir l’industrie du futur responsable, l’énergie, économie circulaire et société ainsi que l’ingénierie, santé et bien-être.

IMT Mines Albi s‘est dotée en 2023 et pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en 7 grandes actions, répondant ainsi aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT à laquelle elle appartient.

Au sein d’IMT Mines Albi, la Direction de la Recherche, du Doctorat, de l’Innovation et de l’Entrepreneuriat (DRDIE) définit et porte la stratégie scientifique, d’innovation et d’entrepreneuriat de l’école. Elle coordonne les moyens nécessaires à sa mise en œuvre, de la recherche amont à sa valorisation en innovations pour les filières industrielles, veille à leur adéquation avec les ambitions fixées et s’assure de la bonne exécution par les centres, qui contribuent à la dynamique collective.

 

DESCRIPTION DU POSTE :

En qualité de Responsable de la Valorisation & Accompagnement Deeptech, et sous la responsabilité du Directeur Adjoint Recherche, Doctorat, Innovation & Entrepreneuriat, vous portez l’offre de valorisation de technologies et d’entrepreneuriat deeptech de l’école. Vos principales missions consisteront à :

·         développer le portefeuille de technologies à valoriser issues des résultats de recherche des centres et des partenaires ;

·         convertir ces technologies en transferts vers des entreprises installées ou en création ;

·         promouvoir l’offre « valorisation de technologies & entrepreneuriat deeptech » ;

·         former et accompagner les personnels de recherche dans la conversion des résultats de recherche en innovations, les entrepreneurs dans leur projet de création d’entreprise technologique et les étudiants dans le domaine de l’innovation, dans le cadre de leur formation initiale.

Dans ce cadre, vous serez notamment amené(e) à :

Développer le portefeuille de technologies à valoriser

·         structurer et piloter l’activité : analyse tactique, définition du process et des outils, actions opérationnelles, suivi de la performance, animation d’un réseau d’experts et mesure de la satisfaction ;

·         organiser et professionnaliser l’« Innovathon », dispositif de valorisation de la recherche à destination des filières industrielles, hybridé avec la formation à l’innovation et à l’entrepreneuriat ;

·         alimenter le catalogue de technologies à potentiel issues des centres et des partenaires de l’écosystème : construire le modèle, identifier et mobiliser les acteurs internes et externes, assurer le sourcing des résultats de la recherche, caractériser leur potentiel et proposer le mode de valorisation le plus pertinent.

Convertir ces technologies en transferts vers des entreprises installées ou en création

·         structurer et piloter cette activité de transfert selon la même démarche (process, outils, suivi de la performance, réseau d’experts, satisfaction) ;

·         développer les dispositifs de prospection auprès des clients industriels pour le transfert des technologies du portefeuille ;

·         identifier et activer les sources de financement utiles à l’activité ;

·         initier des projets de (pré)maturation de ces technologies, ou de transfert vers des candidats à la (pré)incubation et vers les industriels.

Promouvoir l’offre « valorisation de technologies & entrepreneuriat deeptech »

·         mobiliser les réseaux institutionnels, académiques et industriels afin de recruter des candidats aux parcours de (pré)incubation, de repérer des technologies à valoriser et d’identifier des prospects industriels ;

·         concevoir et organiser les événements annuels dédiés à la valorisation, à l’innovation et à l’entrepreneuriat ;

·         organiser les animations de l’« Espace Start-Up Territorial ».

Accompagner les personnels de recherche, selon leur maturité, dans la conversion des résultats de recherche en innovations

·         sensibiliser les personnels de recherche à la valorisation et à l’entrepreneuriat, avec une attention particulière pour les doctorants et post-doctorants ; coordonner les dispositifs internes dédiés ainsi que la participation aux dispositifs de l’écosystème ;

·         organiser, en coordination avec RED, un parcours valorisant et incitatif de sensibilisation, de formation et de détection dédié aux doctorants ;

·         identifier et « recruter » les chercheurs-valorisateurs (doctorants, personnels temporaires de recherche, personnels permanents) pour des projets de valorisation ou d’incubation ;

·         déployer des actions de mise en visibilité des chercheurs-valorisateurs.

Accompagner les entrepreneurs dans leur projet de création d’entreprise technologique

·         opérer l’un des deux parcours étudiant-entrepreneur du programme de pré-incubation et proposer des pistes d’amélioration ou de complément ;

·         accompagner les incubés, selon leur maturité, avec un focus fort sur la définition et la validation du besoin des cibles identifiées, de la proposition de valeur et du marché applicatif, sur le design fonctionnel de la solution et sur la consolidation de l’équipe porteuse du projet de création ;

·         les accompagner dans le montage de collaborations avec les centres et dans la recherche de financements.

Piloter le module de sensibilisation à l’innovation « Dynamiques d’innovation et entrepreneuriat » (IFIE1)

·         concevoir la maquette pédagogique et coordonner son déploiement ;

·         ancrer le module dans le continuum innovation & entrepreneuriat, dans une perspective de recrutement pour le parcours étudiant-entrepreneur.

 

Le poste nécessite des déplacements de courte durée, ainsi que l’organisation ou la participation à des événements en soirée.

 

CAPACITÉ ET ATTITUDES :

·         Vous disposez des compétences, connaissances et expériences suivantes :

o    maîtrise des approches et postures d’accompagnement dans le domaine de l’entrepreneuriat ;

o    approches structurantes de créativité et de conception innovante centrée utilisateurs ; approches de résolution de problèmes ;

o    méthodologies et outils de gestion de projets de recherche ou d’innovation ;

o    connaissance de l’écosystème institutionnel et académique de la recherche, de l’innovation et de la création d’entreprise ;

o    maîtrise des financements publics et privés dédiés à la valorisation de la recherche et à l’entrepreneuriat ;

o    maîtrise des processus de création et de développement d’une start-up, et bonne connaissance du processus de création d’une offre produit ; approche processus ;

o    capacité à déployer une approche d’accompagnement en entrepreneuriat, à commercialiser une offre B2B, à construire et développer un portefeuille de produits et à élaborer un plan de promotion de l’activité ;

o    capacité à déployer une méthode de créativité structurante, à analyser ou élaborer une roadmap produit et à mobiliser les réseaux ;

o    capacité à évaluer et hiérarchiser les besoins pour maîtriser la charge d’activité, et à gérer les aléas ;

o    aisance dans les échanges en anglais.

·         Les caractéristiques suivantes vous ressemblent :

o    organisation dans la conduite de votre activité et capacité à rendre compte de façon différenciée et adaptée à la situation ;

o    force de proposition et prise d’initiative ;

o    posture d’accompagnant adaptée au niveau de maturité du bénéficiaire ;

o    capacité de compréhension et d’influence d’écosystèmes complexes ;

o    aptitude à analyser des objets technologiques dans une perspective applicative, en réponse à un besoin utilisateur ;

o    adaptabilité aux différents interlocuteurs et situations dans un écosystème interculturel, politique et complexe ;

o    méthode, rigueur et fiabilité d’exécution.

 

PROFIL RECHERCHE :

·         Vous êtes titulaire d’un Master II et bénéficiez d’au moins 5 ans d’expérience dans le domaine de la recherche et de l’innovation.[1]

 

AU-DELÀ DE L’ENVIRONNEMENT PROFESSIONNEL, POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE ? :

  • Un cadre de travail agréable sur un campus de 22 hectares ;

  • un forfait cadre avec 49 jours de congés annuels (congés + RTT) ;

INFORMATIONS COMPLÉMENTAIRES :

·       Nature et durée du contrat : CDI

  • Fourchette de rémunération proposée de 31 700 € brut annuel à 37 600 € brut annuel, selon le profil.

jobs.description:
The company

Smart Electric Vehicle Charging Solutions. That’s the business we are in!

GreenFlux offers a cloud-based charge point management SaaS solution. This software platform connects Charge Point Operators (CPOs) and e-Mobility Service Providers (eMSPs – offering charging services to EV drivers), and enables them to successfully launch their businesses. With its offering, GreenFlux plays a pivotal role in facilitating the uptake of electric mobility and the renewable energy revolution. To keep up with the rapid market and business expansion and to support the company’s dynamic growth, we are looking for new ambitious colleagues.

GreenFlux is part of DKV Mobility Group, a major European Mobility company, and we play a leading role in the transition towards sustainable mobility for our ‘own’ customers and those of the Group.

The job

You will be part of an agile, end-to-end team operating within a product area that benefits from well-defined and transparent processes. Your team is self-organized and adaptive. Your role will involve working with unique, complex, and non-trivial algorithms, and handling a significant amount of data from various sources. You will have the opportunity to contribute to every part of the product. This presents a challenge, but also numerous opportunities for growth, supported by a highly collaborative team. We place great emphasis on quality control and documentation.

Technologies We Use:

  • Microservices architecture utilizing the latest versions of C#/.NET.

  • Vue.js, Nuxt, Razor, JavaScript and typescript.

  • Cloud-native services deployed on Azure.

  • Serverless and event-driven architecture (Azure Functions, Service Bus, Event Grid).

  • Cloud-native storage technologies (Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Redis).

  • Elasticsearch and Kibana.

  • Azure DevOps.

jobs.description:
Über uns

Odoo entwickelt eine Suite von Open-Source-Betriebsanwendungen, die Unternehmensprozesse von CRM und E-Commerce bis hin zu Buchhaltung und Lagerhaltung abdecken. Das Ziel ist es, einer der weltweit führenden Open-Source-Anbieter zu sein und Software bereitzustellen, die gleichzeitig einfach zu bedienen und voll integriert ist.

Deine Aufgaben

Als Business Analyst:in und Expert:in für Fertigung analysierst du die Geschäftsprozesse unserer Kund:innen und berätst sie hinsichtlich ihrer Anforderungen. Durch die Implementierung der passenden Odoo-Apps und deine Expertise optimierst du ihre Produktionsabläufe von Grund auf.

Wofür bist du verantwortlich?

  • Bedarfsanalyse & Konzeption: Du analysierst die geschäftlichen und technischen Anforderungen unserer Kund:innen und entwirfst passgenaue Lösungskonzepte.

  • Implementierung & Konfiguration: Du designst und konfigurierst spezifisch-zugeschnittene Lösungen in Odoo und implementierst diese in den Unternehmen unserer Kund:innen. Dabei liegt dein Fokus auf dem Bereich rund um Fertigung.

  • Projektsteuerung: Du behältst Zeitplan und Budget fest im Blick, kommunizierst transparent den Projektstatus und sorgst für ein reibungsloses Go Live.

  • Schulung & Befähigung: Du trainierst Kund:innen sowie unsere Partner:innen im Umgang mit Odoo und machst sie zu echten Expert:innen.

  • Coaching im Team: Du fungierst als zentrale Anlaufstelle für andere Business Analyst:innen und unterstützt sie durch gezieltes Mentoring und Trainings.

  • Schnittstelle zum Produkt: Du bündelst das Feedback aus der Praxis und gibst wertvolle Impulse direkt an unsere Product Owner weiter.

  • Repräsentation & Networking: Du vertrittst Odoo auf Messen und Branchenevents und begeisterst das Fachpublikum für unsere Lösungen.

Das bringst du mit

Bei Odoo schätzen wir deine Fähigkeiten mehr als den Lebenslauf.Ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag mit einer 38-Stunden-Woche und einer 6-monatigen Probezeit.

  • Berufserfahrung im Bereich Fertigung oder Produktion sowie Erfahrung in der Implementierung oder im Umgang mit ERP-Systemen.

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Fertigungsthemen wie MRP (Materialbedarfsplanung), Kostenrechnung, MES, Produktionsplanung und Forecasting.

  • Nice-to-have: Erste Erfolge mit Lean Manufacturing oder Six Sigma und Erfahrung im Bereich Instandhaltung

Das bringst du mit

jobs.title: Senior Campaign Manager (Temp Contract)
jobs.description:
About Pleo

At Pleo, we believe that finance is the strategic force at the heart of how every business runs. When a finance team leads with its craft, they make better decisions and steer the business with more confidence. In order to do that, the busywork that comes with expense management needs to move out the way.

That’s why we built a spend management platform that streamlines the whole process, from employee spending to approvals and reconciliation. Finance teams get clarity and control of all the numbers and data in one place and employees get an experience that they actually enjoy.

The word “Pleo” in Greek means “more than you’d expect,” and that mindset has driven our growth since 2015 and our 40,000+ customers. Today we’re 750+ people from over 65 nationalities who take pride in understanding customer needs, turning complex problems into simple solutions, challenging the way things are done, and aiming for the highest outcome. We haven’t got everything figured out, but we’re committed to developing and delivering an experience as elevated as the craft of finance.

About the role

We're looking for a Senior Integrated Campaign Manager, Brand & GTM to join our Integrated Marketing team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help architect, roll out, project manage, and drive the Go-To-Market (GTM) execution for our major 2027 brand marketing strategy and campaigns and be part of turning brand strategy, positioning, and creative concepts into operational GTM blueprints as we scale our multi-segment (SMB, Mid-Market, Enterprise) reach across 6 key European markets. If you're excited about high-visibility, full-funnel orchestration and balancing long-term brand equity building with full-funnel conversion, and are passionate about integrated brand and GTM marketing in high-growth B2B SaaS, then this is the opportunity for you!

Please bear in mind this role is a temporary contract of 1 year.

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You’ll report to our Director of Integrated Marketing and work closely with teams in Brand Marketing, Digital, Field/Events, Content, PR, Product Marketing (PMM), Marketing Ops, Data, and Sales/Growth channels. Our team is highly collaborative and dedicated to bridging top-of-funnel brand awareness with lower-funnel acquisition, ensuring every campaign moment translates into market salience, customer engagement, and measurable business impact. You’ll also have the chance to partner with teams across country teams, local market stakeholders, Sales Leadership, SDRs, and Field squads to ensure success.

What you’ll be doing

As a Senior Campaign Manager, you will:

  • Integrated GTM Architecture & Strategic Planning: Translate the overarching 2027 brand strategy into actionable, full-funnel GTM campaign blueprints across SMB, Mid-Market, and Enterprise segments, architecting campaign flighting and distribution models across 6 European markets.

  • The "Master Brief" & Cross-Functional Squad Leadership: Own and author comprehensive Integrated Campaign Master Briefs, leading the operational rhythm of cross-functional squads to execute multi-channel strategies (OOH, Paid Social, VIP activations, Digital, ABM) on time and within scope.

  • Localization & Regional Adaptation: Partner with country teams and local market stakeholders to ensure master campaign frameworks balance global consistency with local relevance and execution precision.

  • Strategic Brand Partnership & Enablement: Serve as the strategic execution peer to the Brand Marketing Lead, while partnering with Sales Leadership, SDRs, and Field teams to equip customer-facing squads with the stories, tools, and campaign momentum needed to capitalize on campaign-generated intent.

  • Campaign Operations, Budget & ROI Accountability: Maintain and protect the integrated campaign master calendar, manage and allocate the multi-country integrated campaign budget, and partner with Marketing Ops, Data, and Brand Intelligence to track brand lift, consideration, pipeline growth, and closed-won impact.

What you bring


You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • A proven track record leading multi-million dollar, multi-country, full-funnel integrated campaigns in high-growth B2B SaaS or tech environments.

  • Deep experience taking high-level brand frameworks and translating them into multi-channel GTM blueprints across varied audience segments (SMB to Enterprise).

  • High proficiency in aligning cross-functional teams (Creative, Digital, PR, Ops, Sales) and holding squads accountable to tight deadlines and complex campaign launches.

  • Deep understanding of how to run campaigns across diverse European markets, with a clear perspective on modular campaign design and local adaptation.

  • Experience with tracking brand-to-pipeline performance metrics, campaign flighting dynamics, brand lift, consideration, and total ROI.

  • A background in integrated marketing, GTM campaign management, or brand marketing orchestration within B2B technology or SaaS.

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You thrive as the operational bridge between high-level brand strategy and lower-funnel demand generation, turning concepts into structured GTM blueprints.

  • You love leading cross-functional squads across multiple international markets, balancing consistency with local nuances across 6 key European countries.

  • You take pride in end-to-end accountability, from authoring master briefs and handling multi-country budgets to tracking downstream pipeline velocity and closed-won revenue impact.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You prefer focusing purely on high-level creative ideation, copy, or audience insight development without building the operational execution machinery.

  • You prefer running single-channel or single-market marketing initiatives rather than orchestrating complex, multi-segment (SMB to Enterprise), multi-channel matrices.

  • You are uncomfortable navigating data, campaign flighting performance, budget allocations, and downstream pipeline attribution alongside brand metrics.

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll:

  • Lead the architecture and rollout of the 2027 integrated brand campaign calendar across all target European markets.

  • Collaborate with the Brand Marketing Lead, country teams, and Marketing Ops to stand up the Master Briefing framework and streamline cross-functional execution rhythms.

  • Grow your skills in full-funnel orchestration and multi-market scale, driving measurable brand lift, consideration, and downstream pipeline velocity as Pleo continues to expand.

The location


Please note: We can hire on a hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

Show me the benefits!

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

  • 25 days of annual leave + public holidays (additional days may apply in select countries based on local standards).

  • For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

  • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  2. Hiring Manager Interview: A 45 minute chat to deep dive into your experience

  3. Challenge & Team Interview: We will send you a take home test and invite you to present during a 60 minute team interview. This is an opportunity to show us how you would handle the day to day of the role

  4. Final Interview: A final interview with a senior leader

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired for this role, we received a total vast number of applications but only a few were selected for an intro call.Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:

  • CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

  • Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

jobs.title: Analytics Engineer
jobs.description:
About Zable

Zable (formerly Lendable) is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.

  • Founded in 2014, profitable since 2017, unicorn since 2021

  • The number one issuer of new credit cards and loans in the UK

  • Backed by Balderton Capital and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan

  • Loved by customers & our team with top reviews on Glassdoor and Trustpilot

Zable was founded on the belief that smarter technology is the solution to lower cost, more transparent consumer finance. Our proprietary foundation models analyse thousands of data points in seconds, drawing a more complete picture of individual financial behaviour. This means we can make better risk decisions, widening access and lowering prices.

The Zable credit card harnesses this technology to deliver better borrowing for three million people. Through our superapp, Zable connects this card to a single platform which makes it effortless to manage credit, get a loan, refinance existing borrowing, switch utilities, get a mobile plan and save more.

Zable is now the number one issuer of new credit cards and personal loans in the UK, but we’ve barely got started. Next, we’re taking our approach to some of the biggest markets in the world - the US and Mexico - where hundreds of millions of people are underserved by outdated bank processes.

Join us if you want to

  • Take ownership across a broad remit - you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Zable from day one

  • Work in small teams of exceptional people - who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo

  • Build the best technology in-house - using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

 

About the role

We're looking for an analytics engineer to contribute to the analytical foundation of the UK Cards team, a growing area of the business.

You’ll work closely with analysts, product teams, backend engineers, and business stakeholders to improve how data is structured, transformed, and consumed across the company.

The role is fundamentally about building a strong analytical foundation: making it easier for teams to move from question to insight quickly, while maintaining high standards around data quality, scalability, and maintainability.

You'll contribute to the modelling layer, help improve how the business work with data, and support the team in keeping our warehouse a reliable, strategic asset for the business.

What you'll be doing

  • Building and improving the data models that support lending decisions, pricing, portfolio analysis, and investor reporting.

  • Championing standards and contributing to the improvement of our analytics engineering culture.

  • Supporting and collaborating with analysts at different technical levels,helping translate requirements into robust pipelines

  • Helping triage and resolve issues that affect the analytics pipeline or reduce trust in downstream datasets, and contributing ideas to improve the efficiency, reliability, and cost-effectiveness of our transformation pipeline over time.

Our modern data stack

You’ll work with a modern analytics stack centred around SQL, Snowflake, dbt, Fivetran and Claude.

What we're looking for

We’re looking for someone with solid analytics engineering fundamentals and the ability to apply them pragmatically in a fast-moving environment and explain tradeoffs to stakeholders with varying technical depth.

  • Strong DBT and SQL is a must

  • Strong data modelling skills and a good understanding of how analytical datasets should be structured for reliability and usability.

  • Strong experience with ELT pipelines and transformation at scale, ideally using dbt.

  • Experience with Snowflake or another modern cloud data warehouse.

  • Proactiveness in raising areas of data workflows that could be improved and suggesting solutions.

  • A collaborative working style and clear communication across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Comfort using AI tools effectively to move faster, improve quality, and strengthen day-to-day analytical and engineering workflows

Interview process

  1. 15 minute cognitive assessment

  2. Initial chat

  3. 30 minute chat with hiring manager

  4. 60 minute technical interview

  5. 60 minute culture interview

Please note that unfortunately we're unable to sponsor for this position

Life at Zable

  • The opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

Check out our Glassdoor Reviews and blog!

jobs.title: Sales Enablement Manager | French Market (Paris)
jobs.description:
À propos de Lexroom

Chez Lexroom, nous développons l'état de l'art de la recherche juridique agentique. Notre plateforme décompose chaque question juridique en sous-questions précises, puis mobilise des agents spécialisés pour explorer en parallèle les codes, jurisprudences, doctrines et textes européens. Chaque source est minutieusement analysée, les liens implicites entre principes sont identifiés, et toutes les informations sont synthétisées dans un rapport structuré, avec chaque affirmation soigneusement sourcée. Ce qui, auparavant, demandait une semaine à une équipe se réalise désormais pendant une pause café.

Notre mission : rendre le droit plus rapide, plus clair et plus fiable, afin que les avocats et les directions juridiques puissent se concentrer sur l'essentiel.

Nous construisons l'équipe commerciale en France, et nous cherchons la personne qui va la former, l'accompagner et la faire monter en compétence à travers la Lexroom Sales Academy.

Pourquoi rejoindre Lexroom ?

  • Un produit qui tient ses promesses : nos démos sont impactantes et convainquent dès la première session, pas besoin de six mois de POC.

  • Un marché en pleine effervescence : tous les cabinets français recherchent une solution IA, et les usages sont encore à inventer.

  • Un avantage concurrentiel fort : vous ne formez pas des commerciaux à vendre un assistant IA de plus, mais une approche radicalement nouvelle que les prospects n'ont jamais vue.

  • Un impact direct : la qualité de l'équipe commerciale française dépendra de ce que vous construisez.

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

 

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

The Consumer SEO & AEO team helps people discover Kraken through search engines and AI answers, understand our products and become customers. We connect content, technical SEO, international growth and automation to measurable acquisition, working with Product, Web, Engineering, Data and Compliance.

You will report to the Head of SEO & AEO and work closely with our SEO & AEO Content Lead. Together, they set priorities and provide strategy, briefs and guidance; you help turn those plans into shipped improvements across the website. Your focus is hands-on SEO/AEO delivery and always-on work, giving both leaders more capacity for GTM, strategy and content direction.

 

The opportunity

  • Own the delivery of SEO and AEO improvements across the website, helping turn the team’s strategy into live changes quickly and accurately.

  • Work hands-on in the CMS and other tools to update metadata, internal links, page content, technical SEO and localised pages.

  • Check changes in the CMS and on the live site, including links, metadata, formatting and mobile presentation, and follow through on anything that is missing or incorrect.

  • Work cross-functionally with Legal, Compliance, Web, Engineering and Localisation to unblock work, manage feedback and get changes over the line.

  • Use approved AI tools and agents to speed up delivery, while checking outputs, flagging bugs and suggesting improvements to tools and workflows.

  • Compare agreed plans with what is live on the site, spot gaps and opportunities, and keep prioritised work moving when the wider team is busy.

  • Create and refresh evergreen educational content from SEO and Content briefs, making sure it is useful, search-optimised, accurate and in Kraken’s voice.

  • Keep Jira and the publishing queue up to date, with clear visibility on what has shipped, what is blocked, what needs a decision and what happens next.

 
 
 

What you bring

  • 2+ years of hands-on SEO experience, including implementing website improvements through a CMS, with examples of changes you personally shipped, checked and followed through to completion.

  • You understand search intent, metadata, internal linking, on-page optimisation and the basics of crawling, indexing, canonical URLs and structured data. You can implement agreed changes and recognise when specialist support is needed.

  • You can update, build and check pages yourself, and learn unfamiliar publishing and website editing tools with guidance.

  • High attention to detail. You check instructions against the CMS and live website, catch inconsistencies and take responsibility for getting the details right.

  • You manage agreed priorities, spot gaps, suggest improvements and follow up until work moves forward. You ask questions and seek help early when something is unclear or blocked.

  • You use AI tools to accelerate research, implementation and content work, verify their outputs and give useful feedback when something does not work.

  • An understanding of AEO. You understand how AI search systems find and cite information, why accuracy matters and how to check whether changes improve Kraken’s visibility.

  • Strong writing, editing and fact-checking skills. You can turn a brief or AI-generated draft into useful, search-optimised content that follows brand guidance. You verify product claims and incorporate detailed review feedback accurately.

  • Clear communication and delivery reporting. You keep tasks current, coordinate with reviewers and technical teams, and explain what has shipped, what is blocked and what needs to happen next. You can use performance data to help assess completed work.

 
 
 

Nice to haves

  • Experience with Sanity, our content management system, or comparable CMS platforms.

  • Familiarity with Surfer SEO for content optimisation, Ahrefs for SEO research, Google Search Console for search performance, or equivalent tools.

  • Experience with Profound or another platform for tracking visibility and citations in AI-generated answers.

  • Experience in crypto, fintech or regulated financial services, including working through Compliance approvals. Familiarity with Adclear, a marketing compliance review tool, is useful.

  • Experience implementing localised content and metadata across multiple markets, using AI-assisted workflows alongside language and Compliance reviewers.

  • Experience improving repeatable workflows through AI agents or automation, including testing outputs, identifying problems and suggesting practical fixes.

Who is Sonar?

Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. 


Position description

The Business Technology team is composed of passionate technologists who are fully engaged in delivering the best products that help teams deliver their best work. We are focused on reducing friction and getting the most value from solutions to enhance outcomes. We want to expand our Business Technology landscape to manage more systems in a predictable way that accounts for scalability, resilience, and performance.

This role sits at the intersection of AI-native operations, enterprise platform engineering, and IT service management. You will own how Sonar designs, builds, and operationalizes AI-augmented systems across its internal technology ecosystem — engineering AI agents and connectors, automating workflows end-to-end, and integrating our enterprise tool stack, with Jira Service Management and the Atlassian suite as one core platform among several.

While Jira Service Management and the broader Atlassian suite form a core part of your platform footprint, your scope extends well beyond it: you will build and maintain integrations across our enterprise tool stack, engineer automation pipelines that eliminate manual work at scale, and operationalize AI-native capabilities (Enterprise Apps connectors, Claude MCP integrations, Rovo agents) that put Sonar ahead of the curve in AI-driven internal operations.

Your success will directly enable every internal team at Sonar to work faster, smarter, and with less friction — and will give leadership real-time visibility, consistent governance, and a platform that scales effortlessly with the company's global growth.


What you will do

You are confident in owning and evolving a multi-platform internal technology ecosystem for a fast-growing, multi-site, multinational organization. You bring deep expertise in building AI-native systems and automations, and you are equally at home administering and evolving ITSM platforms — especially Atlassian — that anchor Sonar's internal operations.

You bring proven, multi-year experience in:

  • AI Systems & Agent Engineering (primary focus): Designing, building, and operationalizing AI-native capabilities across Sonar's internal stack — Claude MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations, custom Claude skills, Rovo agents, and Enterprise Apps connectors. You prototype on the frontier, then harden what works into reliable, governed production systems that internal teams depend on daily.

  • CMDB & Asset Management: Owning JSM Assets configuration, data integrity, and lifecycle management across IT hardware, software licenses, and configuration items (CIs) — ensuring a reliable, audit-ready source of truth.

  • ITSM Process Governance: Defining and enforcing ITIL-aligned processes including incident management, change management, problem management, and access management — translating business needs into governed, automated workflows.

  • Security, Compliance & Audit Support: Ensuring platform configurations adhere to SonarSource's data protection, access control, and audit requirements. Supporting external audit engagements (KPMG, PwC) with documentation and evidence packages.

  • Stakeholder Enablement: Partnering with all internal teams (HR, Finance, Legal, IT, Security, GTM) to identify automation opportunities, gather requirements, and deliver continuous improvements — acting as a true internal platform consultant.

  • AI Engineering (Required): Hands-on experience with AI-native platforms and building on them — Claude/Anthropic, MCP, agent frameworks (Rovo or equivalent), connectors, and prompt-based workflows. You've built and shipped something real, not just experimented.

We don't need deep expertise in all of them, but curiosity and adaptability across the stack matters.

  • Security & Compliance Awareness: Understanding of IT General Controls (ITGC), access governance, and audit-readiness requirements. Experience supporting external audit engagements is a plus.

  • Atlassian Certifications (Plus): ACP-620 (Jira Service Management), ACP-120 (Jira Administrator), or ACP-420 (Confluence Administrator) are highly valued.

    • Leadership & Soft Skills

  • Exceptional analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving abilities — you see patterns others miss and turn complexity into clean solutions.

Document Intelligence, part of our AI Engines team, reads them, understands them and connects them to the right transaction, with in-house trained models and fine-tuned LLMs. Our North Star is the share of documents handled end to end, with no human touch. You will report to Benjamin Wolter, Head of AI Engines.


➡️ What you'll do

  • Lead and grow your team: you start with 2 ML engineers and build to 5 in 2027. You run the 1:1s and growth plans, set the hiring bar, hire and onboard.

  • Own your stream end to end: new document types, fields and internal flows for internal domains around banking, accounting, cash-flow management, plus performance improvement of the flows customers already rely on.

  • Stay hands-on: you design, train and deploy models into production yourself, next to your team. Frontier LLM, fine-tuned model or purpose-built extractor? You benchmark them per document type and per field on real production data, and ship what gives customers the best accuracy at the latency they need.

  • Plan with your stakeholders: you build the stream's plan with your Product Manager and align with backend and data engineers across product teams.

  • Own production and guide technical decisions: when a model drifts or breaks, your team knows first and fixes it. Architecture, standards and the roadmap are decided as a team with our Staff MLEs, and you help steer them.

  • People management: 2+ years with at least 2 direct reports. You have hired, coached and managed performance, from growing strong performers to closing gaps.

  • Technical mastery: 6+ years as an ML engineer, with model architectures you designed and shipped yourself. You have kept models healthy in production: monitoring, retraining, rollback.

  • Delivery in a large, living system: you have delivered complex ML projects with many stakeholders, not only on greenfield projects.

  • Hands-on by choice: leading doesn't mean you stop building. You write Python you would be proud to see in production.

  • A sense for the right tool: you have worked with generative AI and with classical ML, and you know when each one wins. Nice to have: fine-tuning transformer models, document understanding (OCR, layout, extraction), fintech or accounting.


➡️ What we can offer you

  • A team you build: from 2 to 5 engineers in 2027, with your own hiring bar, onboarding and rituals.

  • One of Qonto's core AI platforms: AI Engines gathers 16 ML and data engineers who build shared engines that every product team plugs into, held to the reliability a bank needs. Your scope widens from invoices and receipts to bank and financial statements and legal documents.

  • A real stack: Python, FastAPI, AWS (SageMaker, Bedrock), MLflow, Airflow, Kafka, Kubernetes, Snowflake, PostgreSQL, Prometheus, ArgoCD, GitHub, Cursor, Claude Code. You can test any tool that helps us reach the target.

  • Strong peers: you work next to our Staff MLEs, and technical decisions are taken as a team.

  • Room to grow and visible impact: your scope and your team grow from day one, on the management track of our ML career framework. Our north star, automation rate, is felt by customers every day and reported to Product and Tech leadership.


➡️ Your future manager

Your Future Manager will be Benjamin, Head of AI Products.

His background?

After earning his PhD in Physics and leading ML Engineering and Data Science teams in established tech companies across last-mile logistics and digital marketing, Benjamin joined Qonto to lead our AI Products team!

What does he bring to the team?

With deep technical expertise in machine learning and data science, he brings practical experience in building scalable ML systems and guiding teams through complex technical challenges. Benjamin is committed to creating an environment of ownership and autonomy, supporting team members in their growth and development.

jobs.title: GTM Engineer
jobs.description:
Can you help us fix the world's most broken supply chain?

The fashion industry produces over 100 billion garments a year. 60% end up in landfill, not because people don't want these clothes, but because the supply chain that moves them from donation to resale is offline, manual and broken.

Fleek is fixing this. Our mission is to make secondhand the first choice. We run a B2B marketplace where resellers and stores buy clothing in bulk, and we build the AI systems that digitise the supply chain behind it.

Our buyers sell on eBay, Vinted, Depop, Whatnot, eBay Live and TikTok Shop, or run vintage stores from Brick Lane to Paris to New York. They source graded stock from wholesalers and rag houses across many countries. Our key enabler is FleekSort, an AI model fine-tuned on secondhand fashion that can grade, price and categorise an item from a single photo.

We are now going well beyond vintage. Live sellers can sell almost anything, and there is an opportunity for Fleek to be the backend for B2B resale. We've now started onboarding customers alongside supply from Japan, South Korea, the Philippines and Thailand.

Since 2022, we've saved 9 million items from landfill and tripled in size year on year. We've raised ~$50M from a16z, Y Combinator, HV Capital and others, and recently closed our Series B. Our advisors and private investors include operators behind Depop, Shopify and Postmates.

We're looking for people who want to build something that matters, and move fast doing it.

About the role

You'll join the GTM team as our GTM Engineer, reporting to our GTM lead and working day to day with the new business team. You'll own the system we use to find and win customers, on both sides of the marketplace.

On the demand side, that means online resellers, live sellers and physical stores in the UK, Europe and the US, buying vintage, deadstock, new with tags and luxury. On the supply side, it means the brands, brokers, wholesalers and rag houses who sell to them. As we add new categories and markets, the system has to find those customers too.

We already have pipelines that scrape marketplaces and load leads into our CRM. The next step is everything after that: putting the right leads first, reaching them well, and learning from every outcome. You'll own the engine end to end, from the first scrape to the revenue each new customer brings in.

This is not a typical B2B SaaS GTM engineering role. You won't spend your days wiring a CRM to a LinkedIn sequencer or building dashboards. Everyone on our commercial team builds their own tools with AI. You'll take on the problems they can't: systems that improve themselves, infrastructure that scales, and outreach that works within limits set by platforms like Meta.

The role is part engineer, part product manager and part commercial. You won't carry a closes target, but you'll own every metric that moves it.

The problem you'll solve

We want a system that finds the right customers, puts them in order, reaches out, and gets better every week. It runs as a loop:

  1. Find. Source leads across marketplaces and social platforms, for every segment and market we sell into.

  2. Prioritise. Score each lead on the signals that predict a good customer, not just a likely reply.

  3. Reach out. Contact them on Instagram, WhatsApp, email, phone or LinkedIn, personalised by AI and handed to a rep at the right moment.

  4. Learn. Feed every outcome back into scoring. If a store replied but wasn't a fit, similar leads drop down the list, so we stop spending tokens and rep time on them. Then back to step 1.

To make that loop work, you'll build a second brain for GTM: one layer that holds everything we know about a customer, with models and agents running on top. That includes the messages we sent and how they replied, how fast they replied and closed, what they sell and where, what they click and search for in our app, what they told our reps on calls, and how much they spend and how well they retain.

The same data powers our account management team, who look after customers once they've placed their first orders. Matching each buyer with the right supply is one of their next big problems, and you'll help solve it.

What you'll do

  • Own the acquisition engine. Learn how our current pipelines work and improve them. If a rebuild is the right call, make the case for it, and keep leads flowing to the reps while you build.

  • Source at scale in new segments. Find vintage stores, live sellers, deadstock and luxury buyers, and new suppliers, in every market we enter.

  • Build the scoring and feedback loop. Define what a good lead looks like for each segment, then keep refining it on what actually closes and what actually spends.

  • Engineer multi-channel outreach. Instagram, WhatsApp, email, calls and LinkedIn, personalised by AI and built around real limits like Instagram DM caps and Meta restrictions.

  • Own the funnel numbers. Leads sourced per day on each platform, reply rate, conversion rate and GMV per close by source. Use them to decide what to fix next.

  • Sit with the reps and talk to customers. Learn why a lead is good and how each segment wants to be sold to. Then automate the repetitive parts of the rep's day.

  • Turn repeat work into agents. Qualification, first messages, reply handling, dedupe and CRM hygiene should run without a person.

  • Keep it efficient. Every system you build should make sense on cost per lead and unit economics.

  • Connect acquisition to retention. Make sure new customers land cleanly with account management, and help build the buyer-to-supply matching they rely on.

What you bring

  • A strong technical background. You've built and run real systems, such as data pipelines, scrapers, models or production infrastructure. You've done more than configure tools.

  • An AI-first mindset, a step ahead. You build with Claude and other models every day and know where agents work and where they break. Our commercial team is very AI-literate, and you'll push them further.

  • Curiosity about the customer. You want to know why one lead closes and another doesn't, and how each segment wants to be sold to. You're happy on a call with a reseller.

  • Problem solving over playbooks. You take an ambiguous problem, form your own view and ship something that works. We'd rather hire someone who works it out than someone repeating what worked elsewhere.

  • Ownership. You challenge how things are done, bring your own recommendations and explain why.

  • Rigour with numbers. You track honest metrics, know where your funnel leaks and judge your systems on results.

  • Excitement about the space. You see how big the opportunity is and want to build it.

Nice to have

  • GTM, growth or RevOps experience, including outbound you've run yourself

  • Founder or early-startup experience where you owned growth end to end

  • Experience building ranking, scoring or recommendation models

  • Experience building for marketplaces, resellers, live selling or independent retail

  • Familiarity with secondhand, vintage, deadstock or luxury fashion

  • Running multi-channel outbound under platform limits (DM caps, deliverability, warm-up)

What good looks like

  • First 30 days: you know the current pipelines inside out, have sat with the reps and have shipped your first improvements, with leads still flowing. You've shared your plan to improve what's there or rebuild it, and why.

  • 3 months: one data layer joins outreach, replies, closes, app activity, call notes and spend. Scoring runs on it, and the loop from outcome back to scoring is live for at least one segment.

  • 6 months: the system improves itself. Each week it sources more leads, and better ones, across our segments and markets, and conversion and GMV per close are rising.

  • 12 months: the engine is the backbone of acquisition across vintage, deadstock and luxury, on both demand and supply. Agents run the repeat work, and you focus on what to build next.

What you'll get

  • Competitive salary plus a performance bonus tied to qualified pipeline

  • Generous equity: being on Fleek means you'll own a part of it

  • Comprehensive healthcare coverage

  • A collaborative team in a lovely office in the heart of East London

  • Access to founders. We're a small team and they're heavily involved (and good fun!)

  • Exclusive employee discounts to buy on Fleek

  • Access to borrow any item from our collection of vintage and reworks in the office

  • A disproportionate level of responsibility and the chance to drive massive impact

How we work

High ownership, non-hierarchical and fast-moving. We hire problem solvers, not order takers. If you have a better way to do something, and it moves the numbers at a sensible cost, go for it.

Our commercial team builds its own tools, so each new hire starts more effective than the last. People who deliver get more scope quickly. You'll work embedded with the GTM team, ship fast and see your work in the pipeline within days, not quarters.

The practicalities

  • Location: London HQ, E1, Spitalfields / Shoreditch

  • Work model: in person, with trust-based flexibility

  • Stage: post-Series B, hyper-growth

  • Team: a GTM team of 5 AEs in new business and 3 AMs in account management, within 100+ people across London, India and Pakistan

  • Process: an intro call, then an in-person case study in two parts: one on the business with our GTM lead, one technical with our engineers

Our values

Five values shape how we work at Fleek:

  • Dream Big and Disrupt Yourself: Push the most ambitious version of what you're building. Step out of your comfort zone. Nothing is out of reach.

  • Absolute Ownership: The buck stops with you. Drive initiatives to completion. Experiment, learn, persevere. The job isn't done until the job is done.

  • Curiosity Leads the Way: Don't accept anything at face value. Ask questions you don't know the answer to. That's how you innovate.

  • Talk to the Customer: Deeply understand their challenges, motivations and ambitions. Every decision starts with the customer at the centre.

  • Embrace Diversity: A global team building for a global supply chain. Bring your authentic self and embrace the diversity of everyone you encounter.

Ready to build the infrastructure for the world's fastest-growing fashion economy? If you want to work on genuinely hard problems, with a world-class team, at a company that's tripling annually, we'd love to hear from you.

The role

This is a broad, hands-on role covering regulatory change, compliance processes, governance and risk across the UK and US. The successful candidate will work closely with the CEO, our Compliance Officer and MLRO, the senior leadership team, external legal and regulatory advisers, and sophisticated institutional clients and counterparties.

Experience in trading, markets, payments or digital assets is desirable. A strong working knowledge of UK regulatory frameworks, sound regulatory judgement and the ability to translate regulatory requirements into practical business processes will be essential. Exposure to US regulation would be an advantage.

You should have:

  • Experience of compliance frameworks, policies and monitoring, including working with or overseeing outsourced compliance providers.

  • Experience managing regulatory change and assessing the regulatory impact of new products or business activities.

  • Excellent written communication skills, including drafting clear policies, procedures and reports.

About Rivia

Rivia is a technology company building a data engine that powers the future of clinical trial intelligence. Rivia was founded on the belief that new drugs can be brought to market more successfully with a fraction of today's capital.

Biotechs are the source of most therapeutic innovation, yet clinical development is constantly constrained by fragmented data and outdated tooling. Rivia unifies clinical trial data at scale through a core engine built as a reusable intelligence layer, comprising hundreds of configurations and trial-specific logic, independent of source structure. This vertical stack of data engine, workflows, and agents creates a distinct advantage in how trials are operated.

Over the past two years, European and US based biotechs running global clinical trials on Rivia have demonstrated measurable impact, from earlier understanding of therapeutic potential to significantly more efficient trial execution. In March 2026, Rivia raised its $15M Series A led by Earlybird Venture Capital.

Rivia’s ambition is to become the standard infrastructure for modern drug development, transforming how trials are executed end-to-end.

We are looking for a hands-on Marketing Lead to establish Rivia’s marketing function and build a reliable channel for qualified pipeline generation. What excites us:

The Technical Account Manager owns the day-to-day operational relationship with operator and aggregator clients from go-live onward. They give each client a single technical contact who knows their setup, freeing Account Management to focus on commercial growth. They are accountable for the quality of client configurations and for making changes quickly and accurately, within the standards set by Operations and Compliance, escalating any exceptions.

This is not a commercial, first-line support or approval role: the TAM carries no revenue target, handles complex and recurring tickets rather than all of them, and follows published configuration standards rather than setting them.

Client ownership after go-live

Operational configuration and change

Issue resolution and escalation

Process and improvement

Nice to have

What does success in the first 6 months looks like:

jobs.title: Events Supplier Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role
The Events Supplier Manager owns Perk Events' global supplier relationships and commercial agreements. Suppliers are the venues, hotels, agencies and event services behind every event we sell: venues, hotel groups, DMCs, catering, AV, transport, entertainment and activities. Most of the focus for this role will be on hotels to start, but with room to expand scope as we grow.

Today, most supplier deals are negotiated event by event by our Events Specialists and Customer Success Managers. This role builds the layer above that. You set the global supplier strategy, secure preferred agreements, build supplier relationships and give the team better rates, terms and margin on every event.

This is a global role, split roughly as follows:

  • Supplier strategy and agreements (60%): decide which suppliers we focus on, negotiate preferred agreements and run the supplier programme.

  • Deal support and performance (40%): help the team win and deliver large or complex events with the best rates/terms possible, and track how suppliers perform.

What You’ll Do

Supplier strategy

  • Build and own our preferred supplier programme across our key event markets globally.

  • Decide where we need more supply, using data on what customers ask for and where we lose deals

  • Set clear supplier tiers, with defined benefits for the suppliers that bring us the most business

  • Partner with Perk Supplier Relations team to ensure we have a consistent supplier strategy across transient and Groups/MICE business

Negotiation and agreements

  • Negotiate preferred agreements with venues, hotel groups, DMCs and other suppliers: rates, commission, payment terms, cancellation and attrition terms, and added extras for customers

  • Agree group and room block terms, working with the Hotel Supplier Partnerships team so hotel partners hear from one Perk

  • Manage renewals and renegotiate when terms or volumes change

  • Own contract templates and keep supplier terms consistent

Supporting the team

  • Join negotiations on large or complex events when Events Specialists and CSMs need support

  • Give the team a simple guide to preferred suppliers and the best deal for each type of event

  • Provide training to upskill our Events Specialists and CSMs on supplier negotiation

  • Pass on supplier feedback and market changes (pricing, availability, new venues) to keep the Events team informed

  • Partner with our dedicated Builders squad to shape our product, ensuring that your work with suppliers connects with customer experience in the product

Supplier performance

  • Track each supplier's volume, margin, commission, customer feedback and delivery quality

  • Run regular reviews with top suppliers, provide reporting, feedback and act when quality drops

  • Check new suppliers before we work with them: insurance, licences, financial stability

  • Report on supplier results and opportunities to the Perk Events leadership team

  • Lead Perk Events supplier days, partnering with the Supplier Relations team

Relationships and presence

  • Build long-term relationships with senior contacts at key suppliers

  • Represent Perk Events at industry events, trade shows and supplier visits, with some travel

KPIs

  • Margin and commission earned from suppliers

  • Share of events booked with preferred suppliers

  • Value of savings and extras secured for customers

  • Supplier quality and customer feedback scores

What We’re Looking For

  • 4 to 6+ years in Hotels, MICE, corporate events, hospitality sales, venue sourcing or supplier management

  • Proven record of negotiating commercial agreements with hotels (required), and venues, DMCs or event suppliers (plus)

  • Strong with numbers: comfortable working out margin, commission and the real cost of a deal in Excel or Google Sheets

  • Clear communicator who builds trust with suppliers and colleagues

  • Able to manage many suppliers and deadlines at once, with little supervision

  • Fluent English, written and spoken

  • Willing to travel to supplier meetings and industry events

Nice to have

  • Experience in an events agency, TMC, hotel sales team or event technology company

  • Salesforce and Cvent experience

  • Event certifications (for example CMP or CMM)

  • Spanish or another European language

  • Strong knowledge of venues and destinations in Europe or North America

What makes you succesfull here?

  • Commercial: you know what a good deal looks like and push for it

  • Relationship-focused: suppliers want to work with you

  • Practical: you build simple processes the team actually uses, you are ready to build a new program from scratch

  • An owner: you take responsibility for supplier results, good and bad

  • Collaborative: you work as one team with Events Specialists, CSMs, Account Managers and Hotel Supplier Partnerships

  • Ready to build: comfortable in a scale-up that moves fast, you are excited to proactively define new processes rather than being given a playbook.

Why Perk Events?

  • Build the supplier programme for a new and growing part of Perk

  • See your work in the numbers: better margin, better rates, happier customers

  • Work alongside Events, Account Management and Hotel Supplier Partnerships as one connected group

What we offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

jobs.description:
About Dotfile

Dotfile is building the AI-native Compliance Operating System for financial institutions. Our mission is to make compliance simple, safe and smart, helping financial institutions onboard customers, manage risk and operate globally.

 

Compliance remains one of the most manual functions in financial services. While most institutions still rely on fragmented tools and human-driven workflows, we believe AI is enabling a fundamental shift toward autonomous compliance. Our ambition is to build Level 5 Compliance: software that can gather evidence, investigate complex situations, assess risk and execute defensible decisions under defined policies.

 

Dotfile has grown into one of Europe’s fastest-growing compliance technology companies. Today, 100+ financial institutions across 15 countries rely on Dotfile for critical compliance operations, with a rapidly growing presence in the US.

 

We recently raised our Series A from leading US and European investors and software operators. We’re now entering our next chapter: investing heavily in product and AI, expanding internationally, and building the team that can make Dotfile the global standard for compliance infrastructure.

Role Overview

We are looking for a highly analytical, technical and hands-on Growth Lead to build and scale Dotfile’s growth engine.

You will own how we identify target accounts, capture buying signals, reach the right people with the right message, experiment with new channels, and turn what works into scalable systems. You will work closely with Marketing and Sales to generate qualified pipeline across our key markets, with a particular focus on our expansion in the US.

This is a builder role. You will combine strong growth instincts with data, automation and AI to build workflows for account research, enrichment, segmentation, personalization, campaign execution and analysis. You will own the full experimentation loop: finding opportunities, launching experiments quickly, measuring their impact on pipeline and revenue, and scaling the ones that work.

You will be expected to remain deeply hands-on with the tools and systems behind our growth engine. We want to build a small, highly leveraged growth team where technology replaces repetitive work and allows us to experiment faster and operate at greater scale.

You will report directly to the VP of Marketing.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own Dotfile’s growth strategy and pipeline generation across our key markets, working closely with Marketing and Sales

  • Build systems to identify target accounts and buying signals, enrich them with relevant data, and turn them into actionable growth opportunities

  • Design and execute highly targeted outbound and account-based campaigns across channels, using AI and automation to operate at scale without sacrificing relevance

  • Build workflows and agents for research, enrichment, segmentation, personalization, campaign execution and analysis

  • Develop a high-velocity experimentation engine: identify new audiences, messages, channels and tactics, launch tests quickly, measure their impact and scale what works

  • Own the growth stack and connect our CRM, data providers, automation tools, AI models and other systems to continuously improve how we generate pipeline

  • Own growth analytics and performance, developing a clear understanding of funnel conversion, pipeline contribution, CAC and channel effectiveness

  • Partner closely with Sales and Marketing to turn learnings from prospects, customers and campaign performance into better targeting, messaging and go-to-market decisions

About you

  • You have 5+ years of experience in Growth, Growth Engineering, Demand Generation, Marketing Operations or another highly analytical role in B2B SaaS

  • You have a track record of building growth programs that generated measurable pipeline and revenue, not just traffic, leads or engagement

  • You are technically strong and comfortable working with data, APIs, webhooks, CRM systems, enrichment providers and automation tools

  • AI is already part of how you work. You use LLMs and agents to research, build, analyze and execute, and naturally look for new things to automate

  • You are a builder. You are comfortable connecting tools, creating workflows, manipulating data and prototyping solutions yourself rather than relying on others to do it for you

  • You combine strong growth intuition with analytical rigor and can move comfortably between an idea, a dataset, an experiment and its impact on pipeline

  • You thrive in a fast-moving environment with high standards and strong ownership. You are comfortable building from scratch, running multiple experiments in parallel and quickly changing direction when the data tells you to

  • Experience growing an enterprise B2B SaaS business internationally, particularly in the US, is a plus

The interview process

Round 1: First conversation to get to know you, understand what drives you, and explore why this role excites you.

Round 2: Two-part discussion where you’ll walk us through your career journey and the choices that shaped it, followed by a values-based interview.

Round 3: Deep dive into one of your key projects with someone from a different team, offering a fresh, cross-functional perspective on how you work.

Round 4: Practical exercise, case study tailored to the role, giving you the opportunity to showcase your skills on a real-world challenge.

Round 5: Final conversation with our founder.
