jobs.title: Working Student MDR
jobs.description:
About the Role

Every month, hundreds of potential customers show interest in Trengo. They start a free trial, request a demo, or leave their contact details. But not everyone gets the personal follow-up they need to take the next step.

That's where you come in.

As our Marketing Development Representative (MDR), you'll be the first personal point of contact for potential customers, helping them find the right way to get started with Trengo.

You'll join our Growth Marketing team and work closely with Sales, sitting right at the intersection of marketing and sales. You'll turn the demand we generate into real business opportunities, whether that's booking a meeting with an Account Executive or helping someone become a paying customer through our self-serve journey.

This is a hands-on junior role where you'll get to learn how a fast-moving AI SaaS company turns marketing efforts into revenue, with plenty of room to experiment, develop your skills, and make a measurable impact.

It's an 8-month contract with the possibility of extension.

About Trengo

Welcome to the forefront of AI-driven communication. At Trengo, we’re redefining the industry by replacing repetitive work with meaningful conversations through our AI-powered customer engagement platform. We unify communication channels and leverage agentic AI to deliver proactive, human-like service, boosting efficiency for thousands of businesses worldwide.

As a fast-moving Dutch scale-up, backed by a $36M Series A and an official WhatsApp Business Solutions Provider, we thrive on acceleration. Your expertise will drive growth: you’ll make a strategic impact, champion AI innovation, and help shape the product roadmap. You’ll do this alongside an international team guided by our Dynamic pace, Future-proof mindset, Ownership, and Open culture.

What your role looks like:

Turn inbound interest into opportunities

  • Be the first personal point of contact for new inbound leads, reaching out through calls and personalised emails, ideally within the same working day.

  • Follow up with qualified free-trial sign-ups, demo requests and prospects who have expressed interest but haven't booked a meeting.

  • Re-engage prospects whose meetings weren't booked, were cancelled or resulted in a no-show, and help them take the next step.

  • Connect qualified prospects with the right Account Executive, making sure they have the context needed for a productive conversation.

Help prospects become self-serve customers

  • Reach out to prospects who might not be the right fit for a sales conversation but could still benefit from Trengo.

  • Understand what they're looking for, answer initial questions and guide them towards the right self-serve plan.

  • Follow up with free-trial users to help them get started and encourage them to take the next step towards becoming customers.

Improve how we engage with leads

  • Experiment with different outreach messages, sequences and follow-up approaches to understand what converts best.

  • Share insights with Marketing and Sales about common objections, lead quality and what prospects are looking for.

  • Keep HubSpot accurate and up to date by logging interactions, tracking outcomes and maintaining clean lead data.

How we'll measure success

You'll have a direct impact on our growth, with clear results you can track:

  • Speed of follow-up: Making sure inbound prospects receive timely, personal attention.

  • Meetings generated: Booking qualified meetings that turn into conversations with our Account Executives.

  • Self-serve conversions: Helping prospects progress from initial interest to becoming paying customers.

  • Continuous improvement: Finding better ways to engage prospects and sharing insights that help our Marketing and Sales teams improve.

The tools you'll work with

You'll get hands-on experience with our commercial and AI toolkit:

  • HubSpot: CRM, lead management, outreach sequences and calling.

  • RevenueHero: Lead routing and meeting booking.

  • Fathom: Call recordings, feedback and coaching.

  • Slack & Notion: Team collaboration, processes and playbooks.

  • AI tools: Researching prospects, personalising outreach and experimenting with smarter ways of working.

What you’ll bring

  • 1-2 years of experience, ideally through an internship or an early-career role in sales, marketing, customer success or a customer-facing environment.

  • Fluent English, both written and spoken. Dutch is a big plus.

  • Confidence in communication: You're comfortable picking up the phone, writing personalised emails and starting conversations with people you haven't met.

  • A proactive mindset: You don't wait for someone to tell you what to do next. You spot opportunities and take initiative.

  • An organised way of working: You can manage multiple conversations, prioritise your day and follow through on commitments.

  • Curiosity and willingness to learn: You're interested in SaaS, AI and how businesses grow, and you're open to coaching and feedback.

  • A results-driven attitude: You enjoy working towards clear goals, experimenting with different approaches and understanding what works.

Nice to have

  • Experience working with HubSpot or other CRM tools.

  • Exposure to inbound lead follow-up, prospecting or sales processes.

  • Additional language skills such as Dutch, German, French, Spanish or Italian.

  • Familiarity with eCommerce, WhatsApp Business or customer communication platforms.

  • Experience using AI tools to research prospects, personalise communication or improve workflows.

⚙️ Our tech & AI mindset

AI is not a buzzword at Trengo — it’s part of how we build and operate. You’ll work with AI-driven features, automation, data, or tools that help us move faster and smarter. We value thoughtful use of AI that creates real value for customers and teams.

What’s in it for you?

This is what we carefully prepared for you:

  • 🚀 A key role where you’ll make a visible impact in a vibrant scale-up environment.

  • 🌍 Hybrid working + 2 months per year to work abroad.

  • 🏗️ A strong onboarding program with hands-on training and a dedicated buddy to set you up for success.

  • 🧘 Mental health support with free sessions from on-demand psychologists (OpenUp).

  • 📚 Learning budget + 2 extra days off to attend courses or conferences.

  • 🌴 28 vacation days to rest, recharge, and travel

  • 🚆 Travel reimbursement to our Utrecht HQ.

  • 📶 Monthly internet & phone allowance to stay connected.

  • 🗣️ Dutch courses for our international colleagues.

  • 🍴 Daily warm lunches prepared by our workplace experience team when you’re at our beautiful Utrecht office.

  • 💼 Pension contribution to help you plan for the future.

  • 🛫 Sabbatical: After two years, enjoy up to three months away (unpaid) to rest, recharge, or see the world.

🔍 Our hiring process

  1. Introductory call – First conversation with our Talent team.

  2. Manager interview – Deep dive into experience and expectations.

  3. Practical assignment – Role-related, real-world challenge.

  4. Team connection – Meet future colleagues and confirm mutual fit.

We aim to keep the process clear, fair, and timely, and we’ll keep you informed at every step.

Your next challenge starts here!

Join us in building the future of customer engagement — we’d love to have you on the team.

👉 Apply today and let’s grow together!

We believe great ideas come from diverse perspectives. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.

  • A proactive, solution-oriented attitude with a willingness to grow within a fast-scaling organization.

What you'll get:

🍎Free lunch

🧠 Plenty of opportunities for growth and learning

🚀 Chance to join and contribute to a company during its exponential expansion phase

jobs.title: Senior SEO & GEO Manager
jobs.description:
Who we are

We believe travel can create Citizens of the World. When people cross Europe slowly, by train, they come back more curious, more open and better able to understand people unlike themselves.

 

With colleagues from more than 50 countries, our diversity sparks curiosity, insight and a culture of openness, which is essential to understanding our travellers and one another.

 

Three values connect everyone at Interrail: we lead with our purpose, we own our impact, and we choose for growth.

 

We work in a hybrid way, from our office in Utrecht and our homes across the Netherlands.

 

Who we’re looking for

Someone who can shape how travellers discover Interrail, whether they’re typing into a search engine or asking an AI assistant to plan their trip. Exploring Europe by rail is one of the most transformative ways to travel, and there’s a big, untapped opportunity to make it even easier. With SEO and GEO, you’ll help travellers get inspired, plan and book their next rail adventure with an Interrail Pass in fewer steps.

 

Also, it’s good to know that the team has agreed to meet in the office every Tuesday and Thursday, so you’ll be expected to be in the office on these days to work side by side with your colleagues.

 

What you’ll be doing

You’ll be joining the Growth team (in a nutshell: the people who turn traveller curiosity into journeys booked), reporting to our E-Commerce Lead.

 

You’ll own the end-to-end SEO and GEO strategy, so that Interrail is found, cited and recommended wherever travellers research rail travel in Europe. Working across content, product, engineering and PR/brand, you’ll turn search and AI visibility insight into meaningful, measurable growth.

 

Strategy and leadership

  • Own and scale a unified SEO and GEO strategy and roadmap, aligned to commercial goals across our priority markets.

  • Prioritise investment across markets and languages based on search demand, commercial opportunity and local traveller needs.

  • Be our internal expert on how AI is changing travel discovery, embedding SEO and GEO thinking across marketing, content, PR/brand and product.

  • Partner with engineering, content and product to get the right work prioritised and shipped.

Technical SEO and architecture

  • Own technical SEO for our large, complex site and set the technical roadmap with product and content.

  • Lead our SEO architecture: hreflang at scale, domain and subfolder strategy, and localisation quality across languages.

  • Make sure search engines and AI systems can access and understand the site, with the right structured data and clear, consistent information on passes, pricing and eligibility.

  • Own our crawler access policy for AI bots together with legal and engineering, balancing visibility against content protection.

GEO

  • Own our GEO strategy and roadmap: how we earn mentions, citations and recommendations across markets and languages.

  • Build our GEO measurement framework, tracking brand presence, citation share, share of voice against competitors and sentiment.

  • Spot recurring inaccuracies in AI-generated answers, fix them at the source with the relevant teams and track whether accuracy improves.

  • Partner with PR, partnerships and social to strengthen the off-site signals AI models rely on, from trusted travel publications to community presence and review platforms.

  • Measure and attribute AI-referred traffic and conversions, and run structured tests to build repeatable GEO playbooks.

  • Assess emerging opportunities, such as AI agents that plan and book travel, and advise on what Interrail needs to be ready.

Content and topical authority

  • Shape content strategy and topical authority across destinations, routes, guides and inspiration, balancing discovery with pass and booking intent.

  • Make sure our content performs in both search results and AI answers, with clear factual structure and original rail expertise worth citing.

  • Be the SEO and GEO advisor to the content team, building a shared roadmap that connects visibility opportunity to editorial output.

  • Set and govern content quality standards (briefs, structure, internal linking, E-E-A-T) and upskill the team in SEO and GEO best practice.

  • Identify gaps, cannibalisation and refresh opportunities, and advise on what to create, update, consolidate or retire.

Measurement and reporting

  • Forecast organic and AI-driven performance, set KPIs across both, and report clearly to senior stakeholders.

What success looks like

  • Non-brand searches make up a growing share of organic traffic and revenue across our priority markets.

  • A GEO measurement framework is live, and our citation share and share of voice in AI answers are improving against key competitors.

  • The SEO and GEO roadmap is agreed with product, engineering and content and delivered as planned, including website and CMS changes that launch without loss of organic visibility.

  • Recurring inaccuracies about passes, pricing and eligibility in AI answers are identified, fixed at the source and measurably reduced.

What we’re looking for

Here’s what will help you in this role. If you don’t match every point, we’d still love to hear from you.

 

In terms of your experience and skills:

  • Demonstrated experience leading SEO strategy across content and technical, ideally in travel, e-commerce or a large content or marketplace environment.

  • Hands-on GEO experience, with examples of your approach, results, measurement limitations and the decisions that followed.

  • A working understanding of how AI search experiences select and cite sources, and how that differs from traditional ranking.

  • A strong track record in international and multilingual SEO at scale.

  • A solid technical foundation, including structured data, and the ability to influence engineering roadmaps.

  • Outstanding cross-functional collaboration: you align teams around a shared roadmap and take initiatives from idea to launch without direct authority, reviewing results together and applying the learnings.

  • A data-driven, commercial mindset: comfortable forecasting, sizing opportunity, attributing impact in a maturing channel and presenting to leadership.

  • A test-and-learn mindset, comfortable building new capabilities in a fast-changing environment.

  • Experience partnering closely with content, editorial, PR or brand teams.

  • Fluency with the core toolset: Google Search Console, GA4, an SEO platform such as Semrush or Ahrefs, a crawler such as Screaming Frog, log-analysis tools and GEO tracking tools.

  • Fluent English; another European language, ideally German, French, Italian or Spanish, is beneficial to have.

Our offer

  • A hybrid way of working, with some days each week in our Utrecht office and the rest from home.

  • A free NS train card, so you can travel across the Netherlands for work and in your free time.

  • A free Interrail Pass every year for you and a companion, so you can travel across Europe the way our travellers do.

  • Unlimited access to OpenUp, an online wellbeing platform.

  • A personal wellbeing allowance of up to €1,500.

  • A training allowance of up to €4,000 for learning that’s relevant to your role.

  • A variable annual bonus (target 4%), based on company and individual performance.

jobs.description:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès
Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean.
 
Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA.

Présentation de Theodo

Avec ses clients, Theodo conçoit, développe et déploie des produits digitaux ingénieux. Le groupe accompagne les entreprises dans leurs transformations digitales en mobilisant des expertises complémentaires en Design, Web, Mobile, Data & IA, Cloud et Serverless.

Grâce à ses différentes entités expertes et sectorielles, Theodo aide ses clients à concevoir des produits innovants, à accélérer leur développement et à répondre à leurs enjeux stratégiques et opérationnels.

Dans un environnement technologique en constante évolution, Theodo s’appuie sur une forte culture entrepreneuriale, une approche orientée résultats et une exigence élevée en matière de qualité et de satisfaction client.

Contexte du recrutement

Dans un contexte de développement et de transformation continue, Theodo France doit poursuivre sa croissance, renforcer son excellence opérationnelle et assurer l’alignement entre ses ambitions stratégiques et leur mise en œuvre au quotidien.

Pour accompagner Noémie Parker dans le pilotage de ses priorités et le développement de Theodo France, nous recherchons un(e) Chief of Staff, véritable bras droit, capable de faire le lien entre la vision stratégique, les décisions de la direction et leur exécution opérationnelle.

Au plus près des enjeux de l’entreprise, tu travailleras sur des sujets transverses à fort impact, en interaction avec les équipes de direction et les responsables opérationnels. Ton rôle sera de fluidifier la prise de décision, de structurer les initiatives prioritaires et de garantir leur bonne exécution.

Tes missions

Ton objectif : démultiplier l’impact de Noémie Parker et contribuer directement à la performance de Theodo France, en apportant un appui stratégique et opérationnel, tout en garantissant la bonne coordination des parties prenantes.

1. Contribuer à la définition et au déploiement de la stratégie

  • Préparer les revues stratégiques et contribuer à la formalisation des plans d’action.

  • Transformer les orientations stratégiques en objectifs clairs, mesurables et partagés par les équipes.

2. Accompagner la direction dans le pilotage opérationnel

  • Préparer et animer les réunions de direction : définition de l’ordre du jour, priorisation des sujets, suivi des décisions et des actions.

  • Structurer les processus de prise de décision et assurer le suivi des priorités.

  • Anticiper les points de blocage et faciliter la résolution des sujets transverses.

  • Organiser les temps forts de la direction : séminaires stratégiques, réunions d’équipe et moments de réflexion collective.

  • Préparer les supports de communication permettant de partager la vision, les priorités et les résultats avec l’ensemble des équipes.

3. Piloter les chantiers stratégiques et transverses

  • Identifier et structurer les projets prioritaires pour le développement de Theodo France.

  • Définir les objectifs, les indicateurs de suivi, les responsabilités et les échéances de chaque chantier.

  • Coordonner les parties prenantes et accompagner les responsables de projets dans leur exécution.

  • Suivre l’avancement des initiatives, identifier les risques et proposer des plans d’action correctifs.

  • Veiller à ce que les décisions prises par la direction se traduisent concrètement en résultats.

4. Contribuer à la performance et à l’excellence opérationnelle

  • Analyser les indicateurs clés de performance de l’activité et identifier les axes d’amélioration.

  • Préparer des analyses et recommandations pour éclairer les décisions de la direction.

  • Accompagner la mise en place de nouveaux processus et outils visant à améliorer l’efficacité collective.

  • Piloter des projets transverses à l’échelle de Theodo France, selon les priorités identifiées par la direction.

  • Faciliter la collaboration entre les différentes équipes et entités pour accélérer l’exécution des projets.

Tes perspectives

En devenant Chief of Staff, tu seras au cœur des décisions et des enjeux de développement de Theodo France.

Tu développeras une compréhension approfondie du fonctionnement d’une entreprise technologique, de la définition de sa stratégie à son exécution opérationnelle. Tu travailleras directement avec la direction sur des problématiques variées, avec un niveau d’exposition élevé et une forte autonomie.

Ce poste te permettra de développer des compétences solides en stratégie, en pilotage de la performance, en gestion de projets complexes et en leadership transverse.

À terme, cette expérience pourra ouvrir la voie à des fonctions de direction opérationnelle, de direction de business unit ou à d’autres rôles de leadership au sein d’un environnement entrepreneurial.

Profil recherché

  • Tu disposes de 3 à 6 ans d’expérience, idéalement avec une expérience significative en conseil en stratégie, en organisation ou en transformation.

  • Tu possèdes un excellent esprit analytique et sais structurer des problématiques complexes pour en tirer des recommandations concrètes.

  • Tu es organisé(e), rigoureux(se) et capable de gérer plusieurs sujets simultanément, sans perdre de vue les priorités.

  • Tu es un(e) véritable doer : tu sais passer de la réflexion à l’action et obtenir des résultats concrets.

  • Tu disposes d’un excellent relationnel et sais interagir avec des interlocuteurs variés, notamment des membres de la direction.

  • Tu es à l’aise pour challenger les idées, formuler des recommandations et faire avancer les décisions.

  • Tu apprécies les environnements exigeants, dynamiques et entrepreneuriaux, dans lesquels les priorités peuvent évoluer rapidement.

Ce qui fera la différence : ta capacité à combiner hauteur de vue stratégique, rigueur d’exécution et intelligence relationnelle pour transformer les ambitions de Theodo France en résultats tangibles.

Pourquoi rejoindre Theodo ?

jobs.title: Chief Financial Officer
jobs.description:
Most CFOs inherit a finance function.

This one gets to build it.

quinn is an app-based, managed payroll and employment-administration service. We run it for private households employing a cleaner, nanny, or caretaker, and for businesses that manage employment relationships at scale. The customer stays the legal employer — quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, and handles social insurance, taxes, and filings on their behalf, automated end to end.

Where everyone else sells software, quinn sells the outcome. We hold the power of attorney for every customer, take decisions, do the work, and take legal responsibility for the result.

The purpose behind it is simple: Fair employment. For all. That means making correct and fair employment simple and accessible for any employer and any employee, in any market quinn enters.

Where we stand

Thousands of clients rely on us. Last year alone, over CHF 200 million ran through our platform. We are at CHF 7 million ARR and growing. The Swiss business is profitable. We have acquired two new businesses in the last twelve months. A hungry team of over 50 people (and 5 dogs) in offices in Switzerland, Germany and the United Kingdom. And we are raising our next round.

We do not have a finance function yet. We have an external accountant, a signed audit, and a CEO and COO who know exactly what they need to run this company — but cannot build it alone.

That is the opening.

Tasks

What you will own

Everything financial:

  • Banking architecture across multiple currencies, countries, and entities. Monthly close that actually closes on time.
  • Compliance in multiple jurisdictions via external partners you recruit and manage.
  • The financial diligence in our roll-up strategy when we acquire — and the structuring of acquisition financing when deals need to be funded.
  • A financial model that investors love to look at. The data room when we raise.

You will report to David (CEO) and work closely with Lad (COO), who owns the P&L and will be your closest counterpart on the operational side. You will present to the board. You will be in the room for every capital allocation decision.

There is no team. There is no process to maintain. There is a blank sheet and a business that is ready to run properly.

The first year

Your first year at quinn is one of the rare opportunities where you get to make every decision that matters. Which tools. Which banks. Which partners. How we report, how we model, how we show up to investors. All of it is yours to design.

You will spend the first months getting under the hood — taking over the books, understanding the gaps, and fixing what needs fixing first. You will build the reporting infrastructure that gives leadership real visibility to steer the company across every product and revenue stream.

You will analyze the first potential merger and acquisition targets and sit in rooms where the financial direction of the company gets decided, and you will be the person with the numbers.

By the end of the year, you will have built something real: a finance function that works, a roll-up strategy that has financial legs, and a leadership team that trusts you completely. Most people at this level spend years waiting for that kind of ownership. Here it happens within months.

Requirements

Who we are looking for

You have been CFO or Head of Finance at a scale-up — a SaaS, marketplace, or tech-enabled services company. You have worked across more than one international market. You are comfortable closing the books yourself, not just reviewing what others produce. You have built financial infrastructure before — not inherited it.

You are equally at home in B2C and B2B — and you understand what it means to manage the unit economics, reporting, and compliance obligations for both within a single business.

You think in MRR, ARR, NRR, CAC payback, and LTV:CAC ratio. You have worked with investors. This is a hands-on role with real scope to shape the function as it grows.

Key responsibilities:

Commercial contracting

  • Draft, review and negotiate a high volume of commercial agreements: customer, distribution, reseller and OEM/ODM agreements; sales terms and EULAs; supply and manufacturing agreements (foundry, OSAT, component suppliers); technology and IP licences; software and SaaS agreements; evaluation, early access and development agreements; R&D collaboration and consortium agreements; services and vendor agreements; and MOUs, LOIs and partnership terms.

Legal operations

Collaboration

jobs.description:
About Zable

Zable (formerly Lendable) is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.

  • Founded in 2014, profitable since 2017, unicorn since 2021

  • The number one issuer of new credit cards and loans in the UK

  • Backed by Balderton Capital and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan

  • Loved by customers & our team with top reviews on Glassdoor and Trustpilot

Zable was founded on the belief that smarter technology is the solution to lower cost, more transparent consumer finance. Our proprietary foundation models analyse thousands of data points in seconds, drawing a more complete picture of individual financial behaviour. This means we can make better risk decisions, widening access and lowering prices.

The Zable credit card harnesses this technology to deliver better borrowing for three million people. Through our superapp, Zable connects this card to a single platform which makes it effortless to manage credit, get a loan, refinance existing borrowing, switch utilities, get a mobile plan and save more.

Zable is now the number one issuer of new credit cards and personal loans in the UK, but we’ve barely got started. Next, we’re taking our approach to some of the biggest markets in the world - the US and Mexico - where hundreds of millions of people are underserved by outdated bank processes.

Join us if you want to

  • Take ownership across a broad remit - you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Zable from day one

  • Work in small teams of exceptional people - who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo

  • Build the best technology in-house - using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

 

About the role

We’re entering a once-in-a-company moment: a major step-change in our D2C marketing investment, a full rebrand of the company and product under the Zable brand, and a marketing function being built out at pace under a newly-appointed CMO. This is one of the most exciting marketing builds in UK fintech right now, with the financial strength, customer base, and product depth to back it up.

Finding and signing new affiliate and influencer partners is the core of our growth engine going forward, and we’re building the team to power it. We’re looking for an Affiliate & Influencer Acquisition Executive whose core mission is sourcing brand-new partners — not just managing the ones we already have. Reporting to a Head of Growth Partnerships, you’ll own the full new-partner funnel end-to-end: mapping affiliates and influencers we don’t work with yet, running outbound outreach, and negotiating CPA or fixed-fee deals structured so every partnership delivers measurable, incremental customer acquisition.

This is an acquisition-first partnership seat: you’ll spend as much time prospecting and pitching new affiliates and influencers as you do modelling payback economics. If you think in CPA, fixed-fee and incremental CAC as naturally as you think in relationships, this role is built for you.

What we're looking for:

Essential:

• Proven track record sourcing and closing brand-new affiliate or influencer partnerships from scratch this is a new-business role, not just account management

• 2-3+ years in affiliate marketing, acquisition or performance marketing roles for a consumer brand

• Fluent in core acquisition performance metrics – CPA, fixed-fee, LTV, ROI and blended CAC and confident structuring CPA or fixed-fee deals that guarantee incremental acquisition

• Working knowledge of channel economics: payback period, cohort behaviour, and how partnership spend compares against other acquisition channels

• Direct experience running affiliate and/or influencer partnership end to end, including commercial negotiation (not just relationship management)

• Track record of running activations end-to-end and delivering measurable results

• Strong account / relationship management skills

• Comfortable with the data — channel economics, attribution and ROI

• Highly organised and detail-oriented — you can run multiple activations in parallel

• Strong commercial communicator — you can hold your own with senior partners

• Demonstrable use of AI in your workflow

Desirable:

• Experience in fintech or financial services

• Experience with sport, entertainment, media or large brand sponsorships

• Experience with an affiliate network or tracking platform (e.g. Impact, Awin, CJ, Partnerize, Income access) and reading platform-level reporting unassisted

• Experience building an affiliate or influencer programme from 0 to 1 in a consumer brand

You’re a good fit if you’re:

• An experienced affiliate marketer who has sourced new customer-acquisition channels, not just managed existing ones

• A natural relationship-builder — partners trust you, and so does your team

• Commercially literate first, relationship-led second – you measure success in growth, not vanity

• Data-fluent – you build your own view on what’s working from raw performance data, not just a dashboard summary

• Hands-on and resourceful — you make things happen

• Curious about AI and how it changes the partnerships discipline

What you'll be doing

New Partner Acquisition:

• Proactively map the affiliate and influencer landscape to identify new partners who can drive incremental customer acquisition

• Run outbound outreach and pitch new affiliates and influencers, building and working a pipeline of prospective partners

• Negotiate and close new commercial deals primarily CPA or fixed-fee structured so every new partner is measurably incremental

• Own onboarding and activation of every new partner, from signed deal through to first live campaign

Commercial & Performance:

• Negotiate commercial terms with affiliates, influencers and sponsorship partners —

prioritising CPA and fixed-fee structures that tie partner pay to genuine incremental customer acquisition — and know which model fits each partner

• Own the unit economics of every live partnership: track CAC by channel and partner against LTV, and flag anything trending the wrong way before it becomes a budget problem

• Build and maintain the channel-economics view that lets the team compare partnership spend against other acquisition channels

• Manage affiliate network/platform relationships (tracking, reconciliation, payout accuracy) and be the first port of call when number don’t match

Activation:

• Run sponsorship and partnership activations end-to-end — brief, plan, ship, measure

• Manage the day-to-day with partners: planning, comms, escalations

• Coordinate across creative, growth, lifecycle and legal

Affiliate Management:

• Own the affiliate relationship from first contact — be the trusted operator they call first, from outreach and onboarding through to ongoing management

• Manage budgets and timelines across activations

• Spot opportunities to expand existing partnerships based on their performance data

Performance & Optimisation:

• Track partnership performance against targets — CPA, CAC, LTV, ROI, Rev Share payout

• Build the playbooks and tooling that scale the function, including standard commercial terms by partner type

• Use AI to scale research, brief-writing and reporting

Cross-functional:

• Partner with creative on activation assets

• Partner with finance and legal on contracts and accruals and commission reconciliation

• Report on partnership performance to the Head of Growth Partnerships, with the numbers to back every recommendation

Life at Zable

  • The opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

jobs.title: Key Account Manager — Treasury Expert
jobs.description:
About Agicap
 
Créée à Lyon en 2016 par trois entrepreneurs français, Agicap est l'une des scale-ups avec la plus forte croissance d’Europe, avec plus de 8 000 clients, 700 employés et une croissance rapide du chiffre d'affaires (multiplié par 7 entre 2021 et 2024). Agicap fait partie du French Tech 120, qui récompense les startups les plus prometteuses de France.
 
Agicap permet aux directions financières des entreprises de taille intermédiaire de gérer et de prévoir efficacement leur trésorerie, de payer leurs fournisseurs et de se faire payer. En combinant un système de gestion de trésorerie avec des solutions de gestion des comptes fournisseurs et des comptes clients sur une seule plateforme, Agicap ambitionne de devenir la nouvelle référence en matière de gestion de trésorerie pour les entreprises de taille intermédiaire.
 
Nous avons levé 145 millions d’euros depuis notre création, auprès de fonds de capital-risque prestigieux tels qu’AVP, Greenoaks, Partech et BlackFin, avec un dernier tour en novembre 2024.
 
Ces ressources supplémentaires alimentent encore davantage notre innovation produit, nous permettant de croître significativement et d’accélérer notre expansion internationale à travers le monde.
 
Nous sommes convaincus que notre succès réside dans nos équipes passionnées et dévouées, engagées à bâtir une entreprise où chacun peut évoluer et construire sa carrière. Nous sommes constamment à la recherche de nouveaux talents, visant l’excellence et prêts à rejoindre notre aventure ambitieuse !
 
Home page
Customer Stories
Our Values

⚡️ Le rôle

Agicap est en pleine phase de scale-up : nous signons chaque mois de nombreux nouveaux clients, et développer et fidéliser nos clients existants est désormais tout aussi important. L'expansion et le churn font partie des premiers indicateurs suivis par notre board.

En tant que Key Account Manager, vous êtes responsable d'un portefeuille d'environ 150 comptes mid-market : des entreprises de plus de 50 M€ de chiffre d'affaires, souvent des groupes multi-entités, des sociétés en hypercroissance ou détenues par des fonds de private equity. Vous travaillez avec des DAF, directeur·rices financier·ères, trésorier·ères, responsables comptables et parfois des CEO.

Ce qui rend ce poste unique : vous apportez une vraie expertise en trésorerie. Vous ne vous contentez pas de comprendre les enjeux des équipes finance (maîtriser les prévisions de trésorerie, améliorer la performance financière, assurer la gestion quotidienne des paiements et de la liquidité, gérer la relation bancaire, intégrer et piloter toutes les entités d'un groupe) : vous savez les challenger. Vous êtes un·e véritable conseiller·ère de confiance pour vos clients.

Vous rejoignez une équipe de 7 KAM qui a obtenu d'excellents résultats cette année, avec un fort esprit d'équipe et des objectifs ambitieux.


🎯 Vos missions

🤝 Construire des relations solides avec les décideur·ses finance

  • Instaurer une relation de confiance avec les décideur·ses de vos comptes et cartographier toutes les parties prenantes clés, souvent sur plusieurs entités
  • Comprendre leur contexte business, leur organisation trésorerie, leurs process et leurs priorités, et les challenger avec les bonnes pratiques adaptées
  • Gérer les frictions et les situations complexes avec assurance

    • 📈 Développer votre portefeuille

  • Définir et piloter une stratégie de développement pour chaque compte : upsell, renouvellement, contrats pluriannuels, recommandation
  • Identifier de nouvelles opportunités : nouvelles entités, nouveaux cas d'usage, évolutions dans l'organisation ou le contexte business du client
  • Mener des découvertes et des démos produit centrées sur les cas d'usage trésorerie, construire des business cases et négocier les offres
  • Porter vos objectifs mensuels d'expansion et de rétention

    • 📊 Démontrer la valeur et sécuriser la rétention

  • Animer des Executive Business Reviews (EBR) pour vous aligner sur les enjeux stratégiques du client et mesurer son retour sur investissement
  • Détecter tôt les signaux faibles de churn et sauver les comptes à risque
  • Suivre et analyser votre performance avec votre manager pour progresser en continu

    • 🔗 Être la voix de la trésorerie chez Agicap

  • Trouver le bon équilibre entre la mise en avant du produit et le bon timing : notre produit évolue vite, à vous de fixer les bonnes attentes avec vos clients
  • Identifier les besoins d'activation ou de paramétrage et les transmettre à l'équipe Onboarding
  • Partager vos retours terrain avec les équipes CS et Produit pour améliorer nos process et notre produit

    • 👀 Votre profil
  • Vous avez une solide expertise en trésorerie / cash management, acquise en direction trésorerie, en conseil, en banque ou chez un éditeur de logiciels trésorerie / finance
  • Vous savez expliquer et challenger des sujets comme les prévisions de trésorerie, le BFR, le cash pooling, la connectivité bancaire ou la consolidation multi-entités
  • Vous avez fait vos preuves dans un rôle client avec des objectifs commerciaux (account management, upsell, renouvellements ou business development), et vous savez mener une bonne découverte
  • Vous êtes à l'aise avec des décideur·ses finance exigeant·es et vous savez conduire des négociations complexes
  • Vous êtes moteur de votre propre montée en compétences : résilient·e, vous aimez résoudre des problèmes et vous vous remettez en question en permanence
  • Vous êtes à l'aise dans un environnement qui va vite, où tout n'est pas encore parfait
  • Vous avez un fort esprit d'équipe et vous aimez partager vos connaissances
  • Vous parlez couramment français et anglais

    • ⭐️ Bonus : une expérience sur un TMS ou un ERP (Kyriba, SAP, Sage, Cegid…), une connaissance de l'environnement SaaS, de la rigueur dans l'utilisation d'un CRM (HubSpot / Salesforce)


    🔥 Pourquoi rejoindre Agicap ?
  • Mettre votre expertise trésorerie au cœur d'un rôle commercial, avec un produit conçu pour les équipes finance
  • Rejoindre une équipe à fort impact, dans une phase clé de structuration : un gros challenge et une vraie contribution à apporter
  • Un package fixe + variable, qui récompense à la fois l'expansion et la rétention — à confirmer
  • Du travail hybride depuis nos bureaux de Lyon, avec 2 jours de télétravail par semaine
  • Rejoindre une entreprise en forte croissance, aux ambitions internationales (France, Royaume-Uni, Allemagne, Espagne, et maintenant les États-Unis)

    • ⏳ Process de recrutement
  • Premier échange avec Eline, de l'équipe Talent Acquisition
  • Entretien 1 (visio) avec Myrtille, future manager
  • Entretien 2 (visio) : cas pratique avec Myrtille et Thomas, notre expert trésorerie
  • Entretien final dans nos bureaux de Lyon avec Philippe Cheron, Global COO
    • AGICAP s'engage à offrir des opportunités égales à tous, nous cultivons un environnement de travail inclusif qui valorise la diversité!

jobs.title: Responsable Sécurité Financière - LOD1 (F/H)
jobs.description:
Chez Younited, nous pensons que les services financiers devraient être aussi simples, rapides et transparents que tout ce qui fait partie de votre vie numérique.

C’est pourquoi nous concevons nos services financiers de cette manière. Nous combinons technologie, données et automatisation pour repenser la façon dont les gens empruntent, paient, épargnent et gèrent leur argent.

Aujourd'hui, plus de 1,5 million de clients nous font confiance et près de 500 collaborateurs contribuent à notre développement dans 4 pays européens.

Ce que nous construisons

    • Younited Credit : un crédit à la consommation instantané, directement accessible aux clients.
    • Younited Pay : des solutions de paiement en plusieurs fois et de financement intégrées aux parcours clients de nos partenaires.
    • Younited Cashback : du cashback et des offres personnalisées, enrichis par les données de l’open banking.
    • Everyday financial services : Avec helios by Younited, nous proposons des solutions pour aider chacun à mieux gérer ses finances, tout en construisant notre future offre bancaire du quotidien.
Notre ambition est de devenir un partenaire financier auquel les gens font véritablement confiance, en combinant simplicité, transparence et finance responsable. En tant qu’entreprise certifiée B Corp, nous intégrons les enjeux sociaux et environnementaux dans la manière dont nous développons notre activité.

Les 5 valeurs qui nous guident

    • Make it simple : privilégier la simplicité dans les produits, l’expérience client et notre organisation. Faire preuve de transparence.
    • Act as an entrepreneur : prendre ses responsabilités, jouer collectif, oser essayer et accepter l’échec.
    • Innovate or die : remettre en question le statu quo, aussi impossible que cela puisse paraître.
    • Faster is better : privilégier la rapidité à la perfection, et l’alignement au débat.
    • No limit : viser la lune tout en restant humble.
Nous offrons à des personnes passionnées par la résolution de problèmes l’espace nécessaire pour donner le meilleur d’elles-mêmes, au sein d’équipes diverses et inclusives réparties à travers l’Europe.

Contexte 📄

Rattaché(e) au Directeur des Opérations, tu pilotes l’équipe Sécurité Financière de 1ère ligne de défense (LOD1), en charge du traitement des alertes LCB-FT et de screening.

Depuis 2024, Younited a engagé sa transformation pour devenir un acteur bancaire global. Dans ce contexte, tu joues un rôle clé dans la structuration et la fiabilisation du dispositif de sécurité financière, en garantissant la qualité des analyses, le respect des délais et des procédures, ainsi que la maîtrise des risques opérationnels.
 
À la croisée des enjeux opérationnels, réglementaires et managériaux, tu fais le lien entre les exigences de conformité et leur mise en œuvre concrète par les équipes. Tu contribues ainsi à renforcer les contrôles de 1er niveau, à fiabiliser le pilotage de l’activité et à accompagner l’évolution des outils et des pratiques.
 

Missions 🚀 

1) Opérations de sécurité financière (LOD1)
  • Superviser les entrées en relation et les diligences KYC (KYC renforcé, revues périodiques) avec escalade des profils les plus risqués à l’équipe en charge de la LOD2 pour validation
  • Garantir le traitement de 1er niveau des alertes de transaction et de filtrage (sanctions, gel des avoirs, PPE) et l'escalade des alertes documentée vers l’équipe en charge de la LOD2
  • Piloter la gestion des comptes inactifs et le cycle de blocage, d'investigation et de clôture des comptes en lien avec l’équipe en charge de la LOD2
  • Superviser les flux sensibles (virements sortants, recalls, chargebacks)
  • Exécuter les saisies et piloter le prestataire externe en charge des réquisitions judiciaires

2) Pilotage de l'activité

  • Piloter les SLA par flux et s’assurer de leur respect
  • Piloter le prestataire externe et suivre la qualité du traitement des réquisitions judiciaires
  • Être l'interlocuteur opérationnel de l’équipe en charge de la LOD2 sur les sujets LCB-FT

3) Contrôle, remédiation et transformation

  • Piloter la remédiation des recommandations d'audit et de contrôle jusqu'à leur clôture
  • Suivre les audits et le contrôle permanent et les plans d'action associés
  • Déployer le plan de contrôle de 1er niveau et renforcer les contrôles insuffisants et les actions correctrices
  • Rédiger et maintenir l’ensemble des procédures et modes opératoires du département
  • Former et accompagner l'équipe sur le traitement des alertes de surveillance des opérations et à la rédaction des examens renforcés
  • Faire évoluer les outils et automatiser les traitements, en accompagnant l'équipe dans le changement
  • Participer à la consolidation des données pour les comités des risques

4) Reporting réglementaire

  • Coordonner avec, l’équipe en charge de la LOD2, la production de données fiables et leur analyse, pour les reportings et les demandes des superviseurs
  • Structurer et automatiser les indicateurs de l'activité

5) Management

  • Encadrer l'équipe et la faire monter en compétences
  • Organiser l'activité selon les risques ; piloter les délais, les stocks et la qualité
  • Appuyer l'équipe sur les dossiers complexes et sensibles avant escalade

À propos de toi 👇

  • Tu as 7 ans d’expérience minimum en sécurité financière et fraude dans un établissement bancaire, une fintech ou un cabinet de conseil, dont une expérience en management d’équipe opérationnelle
  • Tu as une expérience concrète de structuration ou de refonte d’un dispositif opérationnel : procédures, contrôles de 1er niveau et outils
  • Tu as déjà piloté la remédiation de recommandations d’audit ou de contrôle
  • Tu sais traduire les exigences de conformité en pratiques opérationnelles claires
  • Tu as une bonne connaissance de la réglementation bancaire, notamment du contrôle interne, de la LCB-FT, du RGPD et de la DSP2
  • Tu es capable de conduire un projet transverse, de prioriser les actions et d’accompagner le changement
  • Tu fais preuve d’autonomie, de rigueur d’analyse, de capacité de décision, de pédagogie et d’implication directe dans les travaux

Processus de recrutement 📅

  • Premier échange en visio avec Arthur, Lead Talent Acquisition Manager, pour apprendre à se connaître, échanger autour de tes motivations et te présenter plus en détail Younited (30 min)
  • Second échange en visio avec Antoine, ton futur manager et directeur des opérations chez Younited pour parler des attendus du poste de manière plus approfondie (60 min)
  • Une étude de cas à restituer en physique pour évaluer tes compétences au travers d’une mise en situation appliquée à une problématique liée au poste (60 min)
  • Un dernier entretien en visio avec Rémi, ton futur N+2 et CEO France chez Younited, pour valider l’alignement global sur le poste et les évolutions possibles (30 min)

🎁 Les avantages à rejoindre Younited ?

  • Des bureaux situés au cœur de Paris (9ème arrondissement)

  • Un environnement de travail international et l’opportunité de partir en mission dans nos bureaux à l’étranger (Barcelone, Lisbonne, Rome)

  • Un état d’esprit entrepreneurial et un fort esprit d’équipe

  • Un accompagnement managérial et RH individualisé pendant l’onboarding et tout au long de l’aventure Younited

  • Un environnement d’apprentissage continu avec la possibilité de bénéficier de formations externes et internes, plateforme de e-learning et des « Friday workshops » au sein de l'équipe Tech, pour accompagner le développement de chacun

  • Une attention particulière à l’équilibre vie pro / vie perso

  • Une charte de la parentalité pour soutenir tous les projets de famille à travers des mesures clés

  • Pour t’accompagner dans les moments clés de ta vie personnelle, des congés exceptionnels souvent bien plus favorables que les dispositions légales

  • Une politique de télétravail hybride 2 à 3 jours de télétravail par semaine selon les équipes et la possibilité d’une semaine de full remote deux fois par an

  • 33 jours de congés payés soit 8 de plus que les 25 jours légaux (à la place des traditionnelles RTT)

  • Un abonnement à la plateforme Wellpass, ex Gymlib (+4000 activités sport et bien-être partout en France) à un tarif préférentiel 

  • Carte tickets restaurant à hauteur de 10€ pris en charge à 60% par l'employeur

jobs.description:
Wil jij jouw commerciële carrière een vliegende start geven en energie halen uit het binnenhalen van nieuwe klanten? Bij ITIS Products in Barendrecht krijg je alle ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen tot succesvol softwareaccountmanager. Je richt je voornamelijk op new business, leert alles over onze innovatieve softwareoplossingen en bouwt stap voor stap aan jouw eigen klantenportefeuille. Ervaring met softwareverkoop is mooi meegenomen, maar jouw commerciële drive en enthousiasme zijn voor ons veel belangrijker.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Junior Accountmanager Software ligt jouw focus op het creëren van nieuwe commerciële kansen. Je gaat actief op zoek naar potentiële klanten, legt de eerste contacten en laat organisaties kennismaken met de softwareoplossingen van ITIS Products. Je krijgt hierbij de begeleiding van ervaren collega's, zodat je jezelf kunt ontwikkelen tot een zelfstandig accountmanager.

Je adviseert organisaties over SOFOS 360, onze software voor het registreren en beheren van gevaarlijke stoffen. Daarnaast werk je met Chemwatch, een internationaal toonaangevende softwareoplossing waarvoor ITIS Products exclusief partner is binnen de Benelux.

Jouw werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • Actief benaderen van nieuwe klanten en genereren van new business.

  • Opbouwen van jouw eigen klantenportefeuille.

  • Plannen van commerciële afspraken bij potentiële klanten.

  • Inventariseren van klantbehoeften en commerciële kansen.

  • Verzorgen van softwaredemonstraties, zelfstandig of samen met een productspecialist.

  • Begeleiden van het verkoopproces van eerste kennismaking tot opdracht.

  • Onderhouden en verder uitbouwen van klantrelaties.

  • Signaleren van marktontwikkelingen en nieuwe commerciële kansen.

  • Intensief samenwerken met consultants, productspecialisten en softwareontwikkelaars.

  • Stap voor stap doorgroeien naar een zelfstandig Accountmanager Software.

Wat wij je bieden

Ook wanneer je net aan het begin van jouw commerciële carrière staat en graag wilt leren, nodigen wij je van harte uit om te reageren.

Daarnaast beschik je over:

  • Enige commerciële werkervaring of een sterke commerciële drive.

  • Affiniteit met new business en acquisitie.

  • Interesse in software, IT of digitale oplossingen.

  • Een ondernemende, leergierige en resultaatgerichte instelling.

  • Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden.

  • Een klantgerichte en enthousiaste uitstraling.

  • Een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal. Engels is een pré.

ITIS Products en de VDK Groep

Wat ITIS Products onderscheidt:

VDK Groep, de razendsnel groeiende Topwerkgever van Nederland!

Daardoor profiteer je van de slagkracht, ontwikkelmogelijkheden en zekerheid van een grote organisatie, terwijl je werkt binnen de ondernemende cultuur van een compact en innovatief softwarebedrijf. Zo krijg je volop kansen om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen en mee te groeien met een organisatie die blijft investeren in mensen, technologie en innovatie.

jobs.title: (Senior) Recruiter - Growing Impact Scale Up
jobs.description:
Join us in Revolutionizing Supply Chains
We’re a fast-growing SaaS scale-up on a mission to shape a sustainable future for the food industry. With four years of continuous 100% year-on-year growth, our team is expanding quickly. We’re looking for a proactive, highly organised Recruiter to help us find the people who will drive that growth, and to help shape how we work as we scale. Join us and shape the future of food sustainability with us!

About Simvia

Ensuring responsible supply chains is one of the largest challenges of our time. At Simvia we are on a path to enable the food and consumer goods industry to become a force for good, by making it simple to prove that what we eat and use is safe, compliant, and sustainable. 

Several of Europe's largest retailers, from Albert Heijn to Edeka, have joined Simvia together with their suppliers, and our network now spans more than 200,000 suppliers in 130 countries. AI gives us a strong tailwind: our network holds unique data, and much of the manual work in compliance can now be automated. We are growing rapidly and keep scaling with a driven, international team of 75+ people in the heart of Amsterdam. 

About this role

You will be our first in-house Recruiter. There is no recruitment playbook yet, so you build it: the process, the guardrails and the habits that let us hire fast and well as we scale. That calls for someone who thinks "I'll find a way" rather than "what's the rule here?" 

Sourcing is the heart of the job. Most of your impact comes from finding and convincing great people who were not looking. Every person you bring in shapes the company we become, so we want someone who lives our culture, not only someone who can describe it. 

Who thrives here

Our culture is driven and kind, and it only works if you bring both. 

Driven by the mission. You set ambitious goals, own the outcome, and welcome a high bar. 

Frank. You say what you think and would rather hear the truth than a comfortable story. 

Open. You ask for feedback and change your mind when the facts change. 

Trusting. You build real relationships and give others room to own their work. 

If this sounds more draining than energizing, that is a useful signal too. 

What you will work on

  • Sourcing and approaching great people across sales, customer success, product and engineering, through LinkedIn, referrals and cold calls, so most of our hires come from you rather than agencies 

  • Building our recruitment process from scratch: clear steps, interview templates and scorecards that every hiring manager follows 

  • Running several hiring processes at once, from role profile to signed offer, with candidates always knowing where they stand 

  • Holding hiring managers, senior leaders included, to agreed timelines and fast feedback 

  • Tracking time to hire, source effectiveness and funnel conversion, and using the numbers to improve how we hire 

  • Helping our People & Culture team with in-house events and office life in quieter hiring periods 

What you bring

  • 3+ years as a recruiter, in-house or agency, with hires across SaaS or tech roles from sales to R&D 

  • Real sourcing strength: direct approach and cold calls give you energy, and you can point to hires you found yourself 

  • A builder's mindset: you enjoy setting up processes, templates and guardrails where none exist yet 

  • Highly organized: you run many roles and steps at once without dropping anything 

  • You enjoy speed, and you are assertive with senior stakeholders while staying warm with candidates 

  • You already use AI and automation in your work and are curious about the next tool

  • Fluent English, written and spoken 

Nice to have

  • German and/or Dutch, German being the most useful 

  • Experience in a start-up or scale-up 

  • Experience with an ATS and LinkedIn Recruiter 

What we offer

  • A high-paced organization with room to grow your career 

  • A meaningful mission: help the food and consumer goods industry become a force for good 

  • Training and support, a pension contribution and travel reimbursement 

  • Fresh lunch every day, monthly Thirsty Thursdays, hackathons, boat parties and our annual dance event 

  • At least three days per week in our Amsterdam city center office, with two rooftop terraces 

How we hire

An intro call with our People & Culture team, a conversation with the hiring manager, an assignment, a culture conversation and an offer. Every process includes an assignment, because we would rather see your work than hear about it. We move fast and keep you informed at every step. 

Diversity & Inclusion at Simvia

We hire people with different backgrounds, cultures, and views because it makes our work better. Whoever you are, wherever you are from, whoever you love and whatever you believe in, you are welcome here.

Turn support into insight

  • Act as the Customer Success team's eyes on support: flag critical tickets, recurring issues, and signs that a client is becoming dissatisfied, so CSMs can act early

  • Spot patterns across tickets and turn them into product feedback, doc updates or process fixes

Own the knowledge base

  • Own the K-Pro help center: write, update and remove articles as new issues are resolved

About you

  • A track record handling SLA-bound support with demanding customers, and staying calm under pressure

jobs.title: Clinical AI Research Lead
jobs.description:
We’re Heidi.

We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. Our platform has absorbed the administrative chaos of 175 million patient visits and supported 67 million clinical hours. Today, we support 2.8 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries, in 110 languages and over 200 specialties.

Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s capacity for care and strengthen the human connection at its heart.

We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.

We’ve grown annual recurring revenue from $1 million to $50 million in two years.

To go further, we’ve secured US$340 million: a $100 million Series C led by Blackbird, with Phoenix Court, Point72 Private Investments and Headline, alongside a $240 million growth investment led by General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund.

If you want to join us in doing work worth shipping, jump in.

The role

Heidi is building AI that works at the frontier of clinical practice. As we pursue medical device registration and expand our clinical trial portfolio and product portfolio, we need someone who can hold the full arc from regulatory strategy to research protocol to working prototypes and translate across all of them.

This role is designed for a rare profile: clinically trained, technically capable, and research-rigorous. You will own the innovation pipeline from problem identification through validated prototype, coordinate the company's clinical research programme, and serve as the internal bridge between product, regulation, and evidence. You will operate as a senior individual contributor with a small specialist team and broad cross-functional mandate.

 

What you’ll do

Research & Evidence Programme

  • Lead and support clinical trials and pilots adjacent to product development and regulation from protocol through analysis and dissemination

  • Design evaluations with research/publication-grade rigour: statistical power, confounder control, reproducible methodology

  • Provide analytical support company-wide - elevating ad hoc analysis to defensible evidence

Regulatory & Compliance Intelligence

  • Translate evolving UK and international medical device regulation into actionable product and development constraints

  • Generate and maintain technical documentation, clinical evaluation reports, and post-market surveillance artefacts - directly analytically supporting the regulatory team.

  • Partner with compliance to ensure regulatory soundness is built in, not bolted on, a strategic moat, not a checklist

  • Serve as the accessible regulatory resource for product, engineering, models and commercial teams: making regulation legible, usable and deeply embedded into all engineering practices.

  • This role is strategic support, and ownership of all product and regulatory adjacent research activities with a strong supporting team to drive progress and delivery.

Cross-functional AI & Research Support

  • Act as a senior research partner to product squads, commercial teams, and leadership, providing evidence, framing decisions, and raising analytical standards

  • Supporting commercial requests with tender applications etc…

 

What you'll need

Clinical

  • Qualified clinician with active understanding of clinical workflow, risk, and patient safety

  • Experience in medical device or clinical AI evaluation, including familiarity with MHRA, UKCA, and/or EU MDR frameworks

Research

  • Postgraduate research training in a relevant field (clinical informatics, AI/ML, health data science, or similar)

  • Demonstrated ability to design, execute, and disseminate clinical or applied research independently

  • Fluency in quantitative methods: statistical modelling, NLP evaluation, speech analytics, and performance benchmarking

  • Skills in implementation science and translational projects involving new technologies

Leadership & Communication

  • Strong written communication, capable of producing high-quality documentation for clinical, regulatory, and commercial audiences

  • Collaborative operator in a fast-moving environment; able to work across seniority levels and functions

  • Experience managing small teams or contractors; structured, outcome-oriented

How we show up

  • Build for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.

  • Lead, don't wait. We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.

  • Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.

  • Own the outcome. Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.

  • Ship, measure, go again. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.

  • Live in clinicians' reality. Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.

 

Why Heidi?

You’ll join a team measured on real-world impact, not press cycles. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we’d like to see. We’re medicos, engineers, builders and designers who’ve felt (on every side of the equation) what non-care feels like, the moral and practical toll as a provider or receiver.

Building what we’re building isn’t always easy. Standard tech playbooks routinely fail in healthcare, and the friction of the medical system will test your perseverance. But we didn’t choose easy, we chose a purpose-driven mission that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognize that the deeper question isn’t whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it.

True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally.

We take care of you.

We offer 25 days of paid time off per year, 24/7 mental health, coaching and wellbeing support through Sonder, a €100/month Healthy Heidi's wellness stipend, a €500 home office budget, a €700 annual learning and development budget, 26 weeks paid primary parental leave and 18 weeks paid secondary parental leave, fertility support up to €7,000, up to four weeks of work from anywhere per year, Recharge Days after major milestones and busy periods, 10 days per year of clinical leave for eligible clinical roles, and a hybrid working environment with 3 days in the office.

We chose to open-source our benefits hub, if you care to take a peek.

Heidi’s commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

Heidi is dedicated to creating an equitable, inclusive, and supportive work environment that brings people together from diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Our strength is in our differences. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are proud to welcome all applicants as we're committed to promoting a culture of opportunity for all.

jobs.title: Assistant General Counsel – Product and Regulatory Legal (EU)
jobs.description:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Join our Product and Regulatory Legal team, embedded with Kraken's Product, Design and Engineering teams to ship novel products and experiences that accelerate the global adoption of crypto. We are a tight, experienced group of lawyers from a diverse range of tradfi, fintech and crypto backgrounds who move fast, stay curious and take pride in the commercial accountability of our advice, partnering directly with Product, senior leadership and Compliance to chart clear, defensible paths to launch and to keep our licensed entities running smoothly.

This is a senior product-facing legal role for the European Union. You will be the lawyer the business trusts on questions that cut across several regimes at once: for example, a single product such as a tokenised equity, a card, or an institutional custody and prime brokerage service can touch the Markets in Financial Instruments Directive ("MiFID II"), the Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation ("MiCA"), the Payment Services Directive ("PSD2"), the Electronic Money Directive ("EMD2") and banking rules at the same time. You will bring clarity on which regime applies, what it requires, and how to launch within it.

 

The opportunity

Reporting to the Head of Product Legal, you will act as a senior legal adviser to European leadership on new products, licensing structure and regulatory strategy.

  • Own cross-functional product counselling for European Union launches from discovery to design, launch and iteration, giving Product, Engineering, Compliance and leadership decision-ready advice with clear options and risk trade-offs

  • Advise on the regulatory perimeter and classification of new offerings across MiFID II and the Markets in Financial Instruments Regulation ("MiFIR"), MiCA, the European Market Infrastructure Regulation ("EMIR"), payment services and electronic money rules, and banking regulation, including where an instrument or service falls between regimes (for example tokenised securities, crypto-asset derivatives, margin and financing, and stablecoin-linked products)

  • Advise on payments and electronic money offerings, including the Krak card and account propositions, safeguarding, open banking and account-access obligations, and the developing Payment Services Directive 3 and Payment Services Regulation framework

  • Advise on banking-related questions that arise in the European Union, including bank partnerships and sponsor-bank arrangements, deposit-taking and lending perimeter questions, the Capital Requirements Regulation and Directive, and the interaction of these rules with our custody, prime brokerage and financing products

  • Monitor and interpret European Union legislative and supervisory developments, take part in consultations and industry association work where appropriate, and translate their significance for the business proactively

  • Draft and negotiate client-facing terms and conditions, taking clear, business-aligned positions

  • Act as gatekeeper for European Union outside counsel engagements: scope the work, estimate and manage cost, and sign off before matters go externally

  • Mentor and develop more junior lawyers in the team, set quality standards for plain-English, risk-based advice, and act as a senior sounding board for colleagues across the Regulatory Legal team

  • Use AI-assisted tools (for example Enterprise GPTs) to speed up regulatory analysis, first drafts and matter tracking, and to build self-service tools that let stakeholders answer commoditised legal and regulatory questions themselves

  • Advise on anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing requirements affecting products, including the Transfer of Funds Regulation ("Travel Rule") and the new European Union anti-money laundering package, and on market abuse, conduct, outsourcing and operational resilience obligations, including the Digital Operational Resilience Act ("DORA")

  • Lead or oversee licensing, authorisation and variation workstreams in the European Union, including scoping requirements, mapping pathways, supervising outside counsel, preparing application materials and managing regulator interactions

 
 

What you bring

  • Qualified lawyer admitted in Ireland, England and Wales, or another European Union Member State

  • 15 or more years' post-qualification experience ("PQE") in financial services regulatory law, gained at a regulated financial services institution (for example a bank, payment institution, broker-dealer, exchange, central counterparty or crypto services provider) or at a leading law firm supporting such clients, ideally with in-house or direct product counselling experience

  • Deep, current knowledge of several of the following, with real depth in at least two: MiFID II and MiFIR (investment services, market structure, derivatives and conduct), MiCA (crypto-asset services, custody, trading platforms and stablecoins), European Union payment services and electronic money regulation, and European Union banking regulation

  • Demonstrated ability to analyse novel products against overlapping regimes and give a clear view on classification and perimeter, including in areas where the rules are unsettled or supervisors have not yet spoken

  • Direct experience managing senior regulator relationships, including notifications, information requests, supervisory correspondence and examinations

  • Working knowledge of anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing, outsourcing and operational resilience obligations, including DORA

  • Proven ability to instruct, supervise and manage the cost of outside counsel across multiple jurisdictions

  • Outstanding analytical, drafting and organisational skills, with crisp, plain-English writing

  • Ability to distill complex legal and regulatory issues into clear, actionable guidance for non-lawyer stakeholders and for senior leadership

  • A pragmatic, commercially accountable approach to legal and regulatory risk that gives stakeholders a useful range of options and a clear recommendation

  • Experience mentoring or managing lawyers, and the judgement to know when to escalate

  • Comfort operating with a high degree of autonomy in a fast-moving, remote environment

  • Familiarity with using AI tools such as Enterprise GPTs to increase the efficiency of legal services

 
 

Nice to haves

  • Experience advising on tokenised securities and the European Union Distributed Ledger Technology Pilot Regime

  • Experience with EMIR, including the clearing obligation, margin for non-centrally cleared derivatives and transaction reporting

  • Experience with prime brokerage, securities financing, margin lending or institutional custody

  • Experience advising on the United Kingdom cryptoasset regime or other non-European Union frameworks that intersect with European Union operations

  • Experience supporting regulatory aspects of corporate transactions, such as change-of-control notifications and entity migrations

  • Experience with European Union data protection and consumer protection rules as they apply to financial products

  • Fluency in a second European language

  • An authentic interest in crypto and digital assets, and familiarity with Payward's and competitors' products

 
 
 

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

jobs.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

About the role

We're hiring a Strategic Value Engineer (Presales) to shape and win enterprise ERP automation decisions: you reframe problems, quantify the cost of inaction, and prove value through tailored workshops and demos. Partnering with an AE, you own technical leadership, value articulation, and de-risking security/integration, building alignment across CFO/CIO-led buying committees.

 

What you'll own

Insight-led discovery and deal shaping

  • Practice insight selling: challenge the customer's initial framing, introduce a sharper point of view on where value is actually trapped (exceptions, approvals, master data, controls), and reframe urgency using cost-of-inaction.

  • Lead discovery across CFO/CIO/Shared Services/Procurement to uncover operational bottlenecks and decision friction, and translate that into a crisp target-state narrative and mutual action plan.

Solution design and technical leadership

  • Architect a tailored solution: scope, rollout approach, integration pattern, security posture, and success criteria.

Demos, workshops, and executive storytelling

  • Deliver high-impact demos that map to customer workflows (P2P, AP, S2P) and prove outcomes, not features.

Value engineering (business case support)

Competitive positioning

What we're looking for

Must-haves

  • 3–8+ years in Value Engineering / Presales / Solution Consulting / ERP process consulting (or equivalent in finance/procurement operations with strong customer-facing chops).

Strong plus

  • SAP exposure (S/4, ECC, Public/Private Cloud) or multi-ERP environments.

Language

Location: London - Hybrid

 

What you'll get

  • A product that wins. blp's solution consistently outperforms competitors. Your job is to open more doors.
